title: Principal Automation Developer
description:
**About The Role**
TTEC is scaling its Automation & AI portfolio to move beyond manual, ticket-by-ticket process work toward an agentic framework that can right-source work across business units. This role is central to that shift — building the multi-agent systems, integrations, and evaluation rigor needed to deploy AI agents safely and at scale across TTEC's technology and business operations.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design and implement multi-agent workflows using Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), including agent orchestration, tool routing, and memory/context management
* Build integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP) to expose internal systems (Jira, SharePoint, ServiceNow, internal APIs, etc.) as discoverable tools that agents can call at runtime
* Develop and maintain evaluation frameworks to measure agent accuracy, task completion rate, and safety — both pre- and post-deployment
* Design, build, and optimize conversational and task-based agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio, integrating with Power Platform (Power Automate, Dataverse) and enterprise data sources
* Apply strong prompt engineering practices — structured prompting, few-shot design, guardrails, and iterative evaluation — to improve agent reliability and reduce hallucination/drift
* Architect and deploy agentic solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (Vertex AI, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, IAM) with attention to scalability, cost, and security
* Partner with business unit stakeholders to identify manual, repeatable processes suitable for agent-based automation, translating business requirements into technical agent designs
* Collaborate with the Automation & AI team on reusable patterns, shared tooling, and governance standards (security review readiness, access control, data handling)
* Contribute to internal enablement — documentation, training, and knowledge transfer so the broader team can build and extend agentic solutions
* Monitor deployed agents in production, iterating based on performance data, user feedback, and evaluation results

**Required**
**What You'll Bring**

* Hands-on experience building with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or comparable agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI)
* Practical experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) — building or consuming MCP servers/tools
* Strong prompt engineering skills, including evaluation-driven prompt iteration
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio for building and deploying enterprise agents/bots
* Working knowledge of GCP services relevant to AI workloads (Vertex AI, Cloud Functions/Run, IAM, logging/monitoring)
* Solid software engineering fundamentals — Python (preferred), API design, version control
* Understanding of LLM evaluation methodology: accuracy, task completion, safety/guardrail testing

**Primary Location**
India-Telangana-Hyderabad

title: Staff Software Engineer – Kubernetes & Golang
description:
**Scope**
Design, build, and evolve cloud-native platform capabilities leveraging Kubernetes, Golang, and Azure. Develop platform automation and reusable services while driving scalability, reliability, security, and operational excellence across engineering teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Staff Software Engineer – Platform Engineering to design, build, and evolve the next generation of cloud-native platform capabilities. This role requires deep technical expertise in Kubernetes, Networking, and Go (Golang) to develop scalable, secure, and high-performance platform solutions that empower engineering teams.
  
  
As a Staff Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across multiple initiatives, drive architecture and design decisions, mentor engineers, and be accountable for the successful delivery of critical platform engineering projects. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and SRE teams to build reusable frameworks, automation, and platform services that improve developer productivity, reliability, and operational excellence.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on cloud-native platform engineering.
* Kubernetes (Expert): Deep expertise in Kubernetes architecture, controllers, CRDs, Operators, networking, storage, security, RBAC, Helm, and production-scale cluster operations.
* Networking (Expert): Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, Load Balancing, Ingress, CNI, Network Policies, routing, firewalls, and troubleshooting distributed networking.
* Go (Golang): Extensive experience building scalable backend services, Kubernetes Operators, controllers, and automation frameworks.
* Azure & AKS: Extensive experience designing, deploying, and operating production workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), including managing and operating hundreds of AKS clusters at scale.
* Kubernetes Operators: Proven experience developing and maintaining Kubernetes Operators using Operator SDK or Kubebuilder.
* CI/CD & GitOps: Strong experience with GitHub workflows, CI/CD pipeline design and implementation, and GitOps practices using Argo CD.
* Platform Engineering: Experience designing and building scalable, high-performance platform frameworks, internal developer platforms, and reusable engineering services.
* Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ownership of architecture and technical decisions, accountability for team deliverables, and experience conducting code reviews and mentoring engineers.

**Good To Have**

* Experience with Cloudflare CDN, edge networking, WAF, DNS, and traffic management.
* Experience with MongoDB, including high availability, replication, sharding, and performance tuning.
* Knowledge of cloud security best practices, including IAM, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault/Secrets Management, RBAC, network security, and Zero Trust principles.
* Hands-on experience with GitOps workflows and deployment automation.
* Experience implementing observability solutions using Elastic Stack, Logstash, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar monitoring and logging platforms.
* Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio.
* Exposure to multi-cluster Kubernetes, disaster recovery, backup and restore strategies, and platform resilience.
* Experience with performance optimization, capacity planning, scalability, and cost optimization for cloud-native platforms.
* Knowledge of container security, image scanning, vulnerability management, policy enforcement, and software supply chain security.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable platform engineering solutions.
* Design and build reusable platform frameworks, services, and automation to improve developer experience and operational efficiency.
* Develop cloud-native applications, Kubernetes Operators, controllers, and platform services using Go (Golang).
* Design, develop, and maintain Kubernetes Operators using Operator SDK or Kubebuilder.
* Drive technical decisions and establish engineering best practices across platform teams.
* Own the technical roadmap for platform initiatives and be accountable for architecture, code quality, and successful delivery.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, Infrastructure, Security, and SRE teams to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient platform capabilities.
* Perform architecture reviews, design reviews, and code reviews to maintain high engineering standards.
* Mentor and coach junior engineers through technical guidance, design discussions, and code reviews.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues involving Kubernetes, networking, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure.
* Continuously improve platform scalability, performance, reliability, security, and observability through automation and engineering excellence.

**What We're Looking For**

* A platform-first mindset with a passion for building scalable, reliable, secure, and automated engineering platforms that enhance developer productivity.
* Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable leading technical initiatives in a fast-paced, collaborative engineering environment.
* Strong ownership mindset with accountability for technical decisions, architecture, and delivery outcomes.
* Ability to solve complex engineering challenges with pragmatic, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Passion for mentoring engineers, driving engineering excellence, and raising the technical bar across the organization.

**Our Values**
If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

**Description**
Amazon Shipping is our externalized business providing small parcel transportation services to sellers and shippers. Amazon Shipping leverages many of the above foundational systems together with operations capabilities to pick up packages from shipper warehouses and inject them into the AFN outbound transportation network to provide an end-to-end parcel delivery product we can sell.
  
  
The Sr. PE in this space will develop deep understanding of Amazon’s end-to-end fulfilment and transportation operations in order to support small-parcel transportation for all Amazon marketplaces, its subsidiaries, merchants and off-Amazon shippers.
  
  
This role will need to understand not only how a large set of technical services within Carrier Integration Services (CIS) and Amazon Shipping work together, but also how they interface and enable the adjacent functions, capabilities and programs across First Mile, Middle Mile and Last Mile as we transition to being an end-to-end carrier.
  
  
The Sr. PE will establish the strategy and execution plan to achieve convergence of multiple legacy systems in the carrier space, gracefully manage this transition while both legacy and new systems coexist in production, and strike the right balance between feature velocity and not blocking business launches yet also avoiding accrual of technical debt and throwaway work.
  
  
To do this effectively requires setting a strategy that provides value in both the near and long-term, and aligning 5 to 6 VP stakeholders on the vision and plan. The Sr. PE must possess a broad and deep understanding of the transportation architecture and operations, and create scalable solutions to support heterogeneous functions at scale, such as FC package labeling and sorting, sort center processing, line haul, air and last mile delivery as well as an ever-growing number of programs (e.g., Sub-Same Day, AmazonDay, Roar, Pharmacy) and advanced capabilities (disruption management, replanning, problem solve, Redirect to Locker).
  
  
The Sr. PE will need to understand not just the technical and product capabilities but the nuances of the businesses they are supporting, and helps to understand and balance conflicting stakeholder objectives, while simultaneously building trust and demonstrating empathy with their customers’ needs
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* You lead the definition, design, architecture quality, implementation, and delivery of the most advanced, most difficult, most cross-cutting, and/or most ambiguous challenges spanning across ATS. You may own one or more critical components.

* You exert influence over multiple teams, increasing their productivity and effectiveness. You hold peers and teams to a high bar.
* You are considered to be an authority on technical issues by both the technical and business community and are frequently consulted for making difficult trade-off decisions. You are respected for your technical expertise and have credibility with others based on your accomplishments. You drive awareness about the impact and consequences of technical decisions on the business.
* You relentlessly simplify. You demonstrate significant innovation, creativity, and judgement when solving challenging problems.

* You actively mentor senior and Principal engineers. You develop and institutionalize best practices

**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of professional software development experience
* 8+ years of programming experience with at least one modern language such as Java, C++
* 8+ years contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

Two Circles is a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best. We help clients understand and influence how fans spend, which events they attend, which channels they respond to and what content they watch.

Our platforms and services are trusted by 1,000+ clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL and the Board of Control for Cricket India (BCCI).[RB1]  We're 1,000+ people across 15 offices.

**The role**

Join our global squad of software and data engineers building the Audience Intelligence Platform, the leading data management and analytics platform for the sports industry. You'll build the React frontend and .NET services that let teams, leagues and rights holders explore fan data, build audiences and act on insight, increasingly through AI-powered experiences.

You'll work in an AI-augmented way: using tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to ship faster, and building AI features directly into the product.

**What you'll do**

* Design, build and test scalable React/TypeScript applications and .NET APIs (C#, ASP.NET Web API/MVC).
* Build AI-powered UI features such as natural-language audience building, conversational analytics, AI-generated insights and summaries, and smart recommendations.
* Design interfaces for AI interactions: streaming responses, loading and error states, citations and confidence cues, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Build APIs that expose fan behaviour analytics to the UI and to AI services.
* Use AI coding assistants in your daily workflow, and help the team shape good practice: prompting, code review of AI-generated code, testing and guardrails.
* Work closely with product and marketing to turn data into high-value features.
* Write clean, tested, maintainable code with accessibility and performance in mind.

**Requirements**

* Strong React and TypeScript experience, including component architecture, state management, and performance.
* Strong HTML5 (semantic, accessible) and CSS3/SCSS (responsive, themeable).
* Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot or similar) in day-to-day development, with a clear view of their strengths and limits.
* CI/CD experience with Azure DevOps pipelines or GitHub Actions.
* Familiarity with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), prompt design, tool/function calling, or MCP.

* Experience implementing AI features in a UI: LLM-backed chat or copilots, generative UI, or AI-assisted search and filtering.
* Experience testing and evaluating non-deterministic features, and handling latency, cost, privacy and safety.
* Clear communication, including explaining blockers and timelines to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred**

* Strong C# and experience building APIs in modern .NET (Core/6/8/10); awareness of .NET Framework migration considerations.

**What matters most**

Skills can be learned. Attitude and the ability to learn quickly matter most in this team, especially as AI changes how we build software.

**Benefits**

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We're hiring a Senior Full Stack Engineer who can take a messy problem, break it down, and design a system that holds up at scale. You'll build backend services in Java and Node.js and the web interfaces that sit on them, for products used by millions of learners and thousands of enterprise customers.

This is a hands-on role with real architectural ownership. You'll write production code every week, and you'll also shape how our services are designed, split, and evolved.

**What you'll do**

• Design, build, and own end-to-end features across Java (Spring Boot) and Node.js services and React front ends.

• Turn ambiguous product and business problems into clear technical designs, with written trade-offs, before writing code.

• Contribute to architecture decisions: service boundaries, API contracts, data models, caching, and event-driven flows.

• Build scalable, secure REST and event-based APIs, and integrate with third-party platforms (payments, CRM, LMS, communication).

• Improve performance, reliability, and observability of production systems; find and fix bottlenecks in code, queries, and infrastructure.

• Write clean, tested, maintainable code and raise the bar through design reviews and code reviews.

• Debug complex production issues across services, and drive root-cause fixes rather than patches.

• Mentor engineers on problem solving, design thinking, and engineering practices.

• Work closely with Product, Design, QA, and DevOps to ship reliably and iterate quickly.

**Must-have skills**

**Problem solving and architecture**

• Strong data structures, algorithms, and analytical problem solving; you can reason about complexity and edge cases out loud.

• Proven experience designing distributed systems: microservices vs. modular monolith, sync vs. async, consistency, idempotency, and failure handling.

• Solid grasp of design patterns, SOLID, domain-driven design basics, and clean API design.

• Ability to write and defend a design doc or ADR with clear trade-offs.

**AI-native engineering**

• Hands-on, daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor across the development lifecycle: design, coding, refactoring, testing, debugging, and code review.

• Able to break work into well-scoped tasks for AI agents, write effective prompts and context files, and review generated code critically for correctness, security, and maintainability.

• Track record of using AI tools to measurably speed up delivery, and of sharing those practices with the team.

**Backend**

• 4+ years building production backends in Java (11+/17, Spring Boot) and Node.js with TypeScript (Express or NestJS): REST APIs, Spring Data/JPA, security, async patterns and the event loop, and testing.

• Relational databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL): schema design, indexing, query tuning.

• NoSQL (MongoDB) and caching (Redis).

• Messaging or streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS).

**Frontend**

• Working proficiency in React, modern JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Understanding of web performance, state management, and SSR basics (Next.js a plus).

**Engineering practice**

• Cloud experience, preferably AWS (EC2/ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFront).

• Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based workflows.

• Unit, integration, and contract testing; comfort with monitoring and logging tools.

• Clear written and verbal communication.

**Good to have**

• Experience in EdTech, e-commerce, or other high-traffic consumer or B2B SaaS platforms.

• Multi-tenant SaaS architecture and enterprise integrations (SSO/SAML/OIDC, LTI).

• Infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation) and Kubernetes.

• GraphQL, gRPC, or WebSockets.

• Experience building product features on LLM APIs (RAG, agents, evaluations).

• Open-source contributions, tech blogs, or talks.

title: Calling all Software Engineers!
description:
**About ValGenesis**
ValGenesis is a leading digital validation platform provider for life sciences companies. ValGenesis suite of products are used by 30 of the top 50 global pharmaceutical and biotech companies to achieve digital transformation, total compliance and manufacturing excellence/intelligence across their product lifecycle.
  
  
Learn more about working for ValGenesis, the de facto standard for paperless validation in Life Sciences: https://www.valgenesis.com/about
  
  
About the Role:
  
  
**🚀 We're Hiring Engineers Across All Levels! 🚀**
Are you ready to build the future with us? At
**ValGenesis**
, we're scaling rapidly and expanding our engineering teams across multiple functions. Whether you're a seasoned expert or an emerging talent, we have exciting opportunities for you to grow, innovate, and make an impact.
  
  
**Location:**
Our Offices are in the following locations:
  
  
Chennai: Taramani, Chennai
  
  
Bengaluru: Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
  
Hyderabad: Ranga Reddy, Telangana
  
  
🔧 What We’re Hiring For 🔧:
  
  
We’re looking for engineers with
**2 to 12 years of experience**
across a variety of disciplines, including but not limited to:
  
  
**Software Engineering**
(Frontend, Backend, Full Stack)
  
  
**DevOps & Infrastructure**
**Data Engineering & Analytics**
**Machine Learning & AI**
**Quality Assurance & Automation**
**Embedded Systems & Hardware**
**Product & Platform Engineering**
🌟 What You’ll Do 🌟:
  
  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, build, and scale cutting-edge solutions.
  
  
Solve complex technical challenges with creativity and efficiency.
  
  
Contribute to a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  
  
🎯 What We’re Looking For🎯 :
  
  
Proven experience in engineering roles (2–12 years).
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for technology.
  
  
Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  
  
Experience with modern tools, frameworks, and methodologies relevant to your domain.
  
  
**Ready to take the next step?**
Apply now. Let’s build something amazing together.
  
  
**We’re on a Mission**
In 2005, we disrupted the life sciences industry by introducing the world’s first digital validation lifecycle management system. ValGenesis VLMS® revolutionized compliance-based corporate validation activities and has remained the industry standard.
  
  
Today, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation ― enhancing and expanding our portfolio beyond validation with an end-to-end digital transformation platform. We combine our purpose-built systems with world-class consulting services to help every facet of GxP meet evolving regulations and quality expectations.
  
  
**The Team You’ll Join**
Our customers’ success is our success. We keep the customer experience centered in our decisions, from product to marketing to sales to services to support. Life sciences companies exist to improve humanity’s quality of life, and we honor that mission.
  
  
We work together. We communicate openly, support each other without reservation, and never hesitate to wear multiple hats to get the job done.
  
  
We think big. Innovation is the heart of ValGenesis. That spirit drives product development as well as personal growth. We never stop aiming upward.
  
  
We’re in it to win it. We’re on a path to becoming the number one intelligent validation platform in the market, and we won’t settle for anything less than being a market leader.
  
  
**How We Work**
Our Chennai, Hyderabad and Bangalore offices are onsite, 5 days per week. We believe that in-person interaction and collaboration fosters creativity, and a sense of community, and is critical to our future success as a company.
  
  
ValGenesis is an equal-opportunity employer that makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. Our goal is to have the best-qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristics protected by local law.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Senior Software Engineer - (C/C++)
description:
**About ScienceLogic…**
ScienceLogic is redefining IT operations for the modern enterprise. Our AIOps platform empowers organizations to achieve Autonomic IT — where systems are self-healing, self-optimizing, and seamlessly aligned with business outcomes. We help enterprises and service providers gain unified visibility across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, automate workflows, and unlock performance at scale.
  
  
We’re accelerating digital transformation through the power of automation, AI, and analytics — giving IT and business leaders the tools to deliver superior customer experiences, drive efficiency, and innovate with confidence.
  
  
Senior Software Engineer – (C/C++)
  
  
ScienceLogic, Inc. is seeking Senior Software Engineer with a focus on C/C++ agent development on Windows and Linux. Ideal candidates will be able to take a lead role in reviewing/accepting requirements, building new data collection and manipulation functionality, and resolving complex defects within the software.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years software development experience in: C/C++
* Programming experience with C# is a plus
* Knowledge of OS architecture and interactions with Windows and Linux (Ubuntu/Redhat); AIX/Solaris is a plus
* Experience with deployment of patches remotely that involve in-place upgrades
* Experience with interacting with REST API calls
* Experience with .NET framework, PowerShell and Microsoft Visual C++ redistributable
* Familiarity with host metrics (CPU, RAM, disk, network, etc.)
* Experience with creating and running software both under administrator and non-administrator accounts
* 6+ years Linux
* 6+ years of MySQL, including exposure to views, stored functions, and stored procedures.
* Experience developing multi-threaded or multi-process software
* Basic working knowledge of: SNMP, SOAP
* Demonstrated ability to incorporate AI coding assistants into daily workflow.
* Experience reviewing AI produced code and designs for accuracy.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, from requirements through delivery.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Preference for AI DLC experience.
* Experience in the area of network or systems management is a major plus.
* Experience with network observability or monitoring platforms
* Experience working in Agile environments

**Key Skills & Abilities**

* Strong analytical skills
* Troubleshoot complex issues across software and network layers
* Contribute to system architecture, ensuring high availability and performance
* Write clean, reusable, and well-documented code following best practices
* Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives
* Exposure to distributed systems and large-scale data processing
* Build and maintain highly scalable C/C++ agent processes for the purpose of data collection, manipulation, pruning, etc
* Review requirements submitted by product managers and take a lead role in implementing said requirements.
* Review and correct and/or delegate resolution of defects
* Participate in feature hand-off demos to provide internal exposure to emerging features and functionality

At ScienceLogic, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which you are applying.*

title: Engineer III Software
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
As we continue to scale our global platform, the Software Engineer III — Commerce Applications & Integrations will play a critical role in building and operating the applications that power our wholesale commerce experience end-to-end.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Software Engineer III — Commerce Applications & Integrations to build, operate, and continuously improve the applications that power our wholesale commerce experience — including product and catalog workflows, cart and checkout, order processing, account management, and the internal tools our operations teams rely on every day. This is a full-stack role with real end-to-end ownership spanning application development, APIs and integrations, data processing, cloud infrastructure, production support, incident resolution, security remediation, and operational readiness. The Software Engineer III — Commerce Applications & Integrations delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  

* Partner closely with Product, Business Operations, Platform, Security, Data, and Support teams to align on technical decisions, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and ship reliable solutions collaboratively.
* Contribute to architecture discussions, modernization initiatives, and technical discovery, bringing well-reasoned perspectives on schema design, system design, and next-generation commerce capabilities.
* Participate in production support rotations and serve as a dependable technical resource for time-sensitive ordering escalations and cross-functional issue resolution.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Build and enhance wholesale commerce portal capabilities across catalog, cart, checkout, order confirmation, account, product, and user-experience workflows that customers and internal teams depend on daily.
* Support order and fulfillment business rules — including inventory availability, account configuration, ship-window and cancellation dates, and downstream order interfaces — to ensure a seamless ordering experience.
* Improve application reliability through monitoring, alerting, deployment health checks, and release validation so that customer-facing systems perform consistently and at scale.
* Participate in resolving customer access issues and account setup problems, reducing friction in the wholesale commerce experience.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Design and develop scalable APIs, integrations, and supporting services using Go, Python, Node.js, and React/TypeScript that keep end-to-end business workflows reliable and extensible.
* Develop scalable data-processing solutions for product, catalog, account, and order workloads, including batch and asynchronous processing pipelines built on AWS services such as SQS/SNS, EventBridge, and Lambda.
* Contribute to application modernization efforts, including schema migration, platform refactoring, and the adoption of infrastructure-as-code practices via Terraform and GitHub Actions.
* Explore and apply emerging tools, patterns, and AI-enabled capabilities to continuously improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of commerce systems.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Take end-to-end ownership of ambiguous problems through design, implementation, testing, release, and ongoing operational support across the full commerce application stack.
* Troubleshoot production issues using structured logs, metrics, distributed traces, application behavior, and data analysis; drive root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes rather than patches.
* Address application security and software supply-chain findings — including dependency vulnerabilities, authorization gaps, CI/CD hardening, and least-privilege access — with rigor and urgency.
* Reduce recurring production issues over time by improving monitoring, operational documentation, and the underlying reliability of data and integration workflows.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 3–6 years of professional software engineering experience with a strong track record delivering production software as an individual contributor, including full-stack ownership across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, data, and operational concerns.
* Proficiency with React and TypeScript for building customer-facing web applications, and proficiency in at least one backend language among Go, Python, or Node.js with willingness to work across the others.
* Production experience on AWS, including compute (ECS/EKS, Lambda), storage (S3), managed databases (RDS), and messaging services (SQS/SNS, EventBridge).
* Experience designing scalable APIs, data workflows, batch and asynchronous processing pipelines, and system integrations in a production environment.
* Strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills using logs, metrics, traces, and data, with the ability to implement durable fixes rather than short-term patches.
* Solid understanding of secure coding practices, dependency management, authorization models, secrets handling, and CI/CD security hardening.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively alongside product, business, platform, security, and support partners on ambiguous, end-to-end problems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in wholesale commerce, order management, catalog, product, inventory, or fulfillment domains.
* Exposure to Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC) or the broader Salesforce commerce ecosystem.
* Experience with relational database design, query optimization, and schema migration at scale using PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Experience with messaging and event-driven integration patterns such as Pub/Sub, SQS/SNS, Kafka, or EventBridge.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK) and GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD tooling.
* Experience with application modernization, architecture, or platform migration initiatives.

WORK LOCATION
  
  
Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in
**Hyderabad**
, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence IN-OFFICE SCHEDULE — Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday
  
  
*At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.*
**About Us**
*Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.*
**About The Team**
*Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, www.fanatics.com.*
*Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).*

* Build Championship Teams
* Obsessed with Fans
* Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit
* Determined and Relentless Mindset

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
At Teradata, we're not just managing data; we're unleashing its full potential. Our Teradata AI Studio platform and pioneering Enterprise Vector Store are empowering the world's largest enterprises to derive unprecedented value from their most complex data. We're rapidly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with Artificial Intelligence, especially in the exciting realm of
**autonomous and agentic systems**
We’re building intelligent systems that go far beyond automation — they observe, reason, adapt, and drive complex decision-making across large-scale enterprise environments. As a member of our AI engineering team, you’ll play a critical role in designing and deploying advanced AI agents that integrate deeply with business operations, turning data into insight, action, and measurable outcomes.
  
  
In this role, you’ll architect foundational components for production-grade AI systems — from agent frameworks and LLM pipelines to observability and evaluation layers that ensure reliability, accountability, and performance. You’ll be responsible not just for building models, but for making them measurable, debuggable, and trustworthy in real-world, high-stakes deployments.
  
  
You’ll work alongside a high-caliber team of AI researchers, engineers, and data scientists tackling some of the hardest problems in AI and enterprise software — from scalable multi-agent coordination and fine-tuned LLM applications, to real-time monitoring, drift detection, and closed-loop retraining systems.
  
  
If you're passionate about building intelligent systems that are not only powerful but observable, resilient, and production-ready, this role offers the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise AI from the ground up.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain robust backend microservices and APIs (REST, gRPC) to support Teradata AI Studio capabilities.
* Build, orchestrate, and deploy autonomous AI agents using frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
* Implement tool calling, dynamic routing, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations for multi-agent workflows.
* Manage full application lifecycles, including application-level observability (e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Langfuse) and production incident resolution.
* Integrate and optimize stateful data layers, including vector databases and relational databases (e. g. , PostgreSQL) for agent memory and RAG pipelines.
* Implement AI-specific observability and tracing for LLM pipelines and multi-agent workflows to monitor performance, token usage, and response quality.

**Who You'll Work With**
Imagine collaborating daily with some of the brightest minds in the company – individuals who champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to our success. You'll be part of a cohesive force, laser-focused on delivering high-quality, critical, and highly visible AI/ML functionality within the Teradata Cloud platform. Your insights will directly shape the future of our intelligent data solutions.
  
  
You'll report directly to the inspiring Sr. Manager, Software Engineering, who will champion your growth and empower your contributions.
  
  
**What Makes You A Qualified Candidate**

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field – your academic foundation is key.
* Core Programming: 3+ years of experience with any of the backend languages (Python, Go).
* Agent Frameworks: Hands-on experience building agents using frameworks like LangGraph, Langchain, CrewAI, etc. and integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
* Direct experience building applications with LLM frameworks and multi-agent orchestration systems.
* Data Management: Direct experience managing relational databases (PostgreSQL) and Vector stores.
* API Design: 2+ years in building and managing REST or gRPC APIs and microservices for the application layer.

**What You'll Bring**

* Hands-on experience with LLM observability, tracing, and evaluation platforms (e. g. , Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or OpenTelemetry for AI).
* Experience with LLM-specific tools and frameworks (LangChain, vector databases, prompt engineering).
* Experience with infrastructure security and compliance standards.
* Contributions to open-source projects or technical communities.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a collaborative team environment.
* Ownership mindset with a focus on reliability, scalability, and continuous improvement.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Sr  Zoho CRM Developer
description:
**Role Overview**

The
**Zoho CRM Developer**
is a highly skilled technical specialist responsible for the design, development, configuration, integration, and ongoing optimisation of Zoho CRM and associated Zoho ecosystem platforms. The role focuses on delivering scalable, secure, and intelligent customer relationship management solutions that streamline business processes, improve customer engagement, and enable data-driven decision-making.

This role requires deep expertise in
**Zoho CRM configuration, Deluge scripting, custom functions, REST APIs, webhooks, workflow automation, custom widgets, Zoho AI capabilities, enterprise integrations, HTML, CSS, SQL, Node.js, and JavaScript**
. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, solution architects, business analysts, and engineering teams to build innovative CRM solutions aligned with business objectives.

**What will you do?**

* Design, configure, and customise Zoho CRM and Zoho Desk to deliver customer service platforms with AI-powered capabilities.
* Develop advanced Deluge scripts and custom functions to extend both platforms, automate complex business logic, and integrate with third-party systems.
* Build custom widgets and UI components using Deluge to enhance sales dashboards, customer portals, and support agent interfaces.
* Create sophisticated automation workflows combining Deluge scripting with pipeline management and customer support operations.
* Implement AI-powered capabilities using Zoho's AI offerings and external AI services.
* Manage data migrations, synchronisation, cleansing, deduplication, and governance activities.
* Integrate agent-based AI architectures and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers with Deluge-powered custom logic for intelligent automation.
* Manage seamless data synchronisation and integrations between Zoho CRM, Zoho Desk, and external systems using Deluge APIs, webhooks, and custom connectors.

Collaborate with Sales, Support, Operations, and Product teams to translate business requirements into integrated, intelligent Zoho solutions.
**Key Responsibilities**

Deluge Scripting & Custom Development

* Develop advanced Deluge scripts for custom automation, business logic, and complex workflows across Zoho CRM and Desk.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-documented Deluge code following best practices and coding standards.
* Build custom functions for lead scoring, deal management, ticket processing, routing logic, data transformations.
* Implement error handling, logging, and performance optimisation in Deluge scripts for production reliability.

Custom Widget & UI Development

* Design and develop custom widgets using Zoho Widget Framework and Deluge to enhance CRM and Desk interfaces.
* Build interactive sales dashboards, agent consoles, customer portals, and management views with custom widgets.
* Integrate widgets with AI models and data services to display AI-powered insights, recommendations, and analytics.
* Customise page layouts, views, and configurations across both platforms to align with business workflows.
* Design CRM Canvas experiences, widgets, kiosks, and forms that create efficient user journeys across CRM and support processes.

Zoho CRM Configuration

* Configure and manage Zoho CRM modules, fields, layouts, workflows, approvals, blueprints, assignment rules, notifications, views, page layouts, and pipeline workflows.
* Implement sales automation, lead management, deal tracking, and forecasting capabilities aligned with strategy.
* Design and optimise Zoho CRM dashboards and reports for team performance monitoring and pipeline visibility.
* Develop reports, dashboards, KPIs, analytical data models, and where required, SQL queries to support operational visibility and business decision-making.

Zoho Desk Configuration & Support Operations

* Configure and manage Zoho Desk modules, channels, workflows, and SLAs for multi-channel support operations.
* Implement email, chat, phone, social media, and portal integrations for seamless customer service.
* Design and optimise Zoho Desk dashboards for support team performance monitoring and KPI tracking.

AI-Powered Sales & Customer Service

* Implement AI capabilities in Zoho CRM: AI lead scoring, sales predictions, opportunity recommendations, and AI-assisted deal closure.
* Deploy AI features in Zoho Desk: AI-powered ticket routing, categorisation, sentiment analysis, and agent recommendations.
* Build AI chatbots and virtual agents for lead qualification, customer support, and self-service using Deluge logic.
* Explore and implement agent-based AI architectures, MCP servers, and AI orchestration frameworks across both platforms.

Advanced Automation & Workflows

* Design and implement sophisticated automation rules, workflows, and SLAs using Deluge for complex sales and support logic.
* Build intelligent escalation logic, conditional routing, and AI-triggered workflows across CRM and Desk.
* Optimise Deluge scripts and workflows for performance, maintainability, and reliability.

CRM & Desk Integration & Data Synchronisation

* Design and implement seamless bi-directional synchronisation between Zoho CRM and Desk for unified customer view.
* Develop custom APIs, webhooks, and Deluge connectors to integrate with third-party systems and AI services.
* Connect Zoho applications with operational systems and external services, including API mapping, authentication, monitoring, and error handling.
* Ensure reliable, secure integrations with proper authentication, error handling, and performance optimisation.
* Maintain solution designs, configuration records, integration specifications, data dictionaries, and support runbooks to enable reliable delivery and operational support.

Data Management

* Manage data quality, integrity, and migrations across Zoho CRM and Desk using Deluge data processing and ETL scripts.
* Perform data mapping, transformation, imports, record updates, deduplication, validation, profiling, reconciliation, cleansing, duplicate identification, and ongoing data quality rule implementation.
* Build data pipelines to feed AI models with quality sales and support data for insights, predictions, and recommendations.
* Monitor Zoho Desk and CRM performance, Deluge execution times, widget rendering, and system reliability.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of professional experience with Zoho CRM and/or Zoho Desk, including configuration, customisation, and implementation.
* Expert-level proficiency in Deluge scripting language with hands-on experience building complex business logic.
* Strong experience designing and developing custom widgets using Zoho Widget Framework and Deluge.
* Deep expertise in Zoho CRM configuration: modules, fields, workflows, automations, sales pipelines, and dashboards.
* Deep expertise in Zoho Desk configuration: automation rules, workflows, SLAs, multi-channel setup, and ticketing.
* Hands-on experience with Zoho AI capabilities: AI lead scoring, sales predictions, AI routing, sentiment analysis, chatbots.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, Deluge API calls, and system integration patterns.
* Proficiency with databases (SQL), data transformation, ETL concepts, and Deluge data processing functions.
* Experience with different integration platforms and building custom connectors.
* Knowledge of customer service operations, and support metrics (response time, SLA management).
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, code quality focus, and ability to work independently and in teams.
* Advanced Deluge expertise including meta-programming, reflection, and advanced data structure manipulation.
* Experience building reusable widget libraries and contributing to Zoho marketplace widget ecosystems.
* Hands-on experience implementing and optimising Zoho AI features across both CRM and Desk platforms.
* Experience with agent-based AI architectures, MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, and Deluge-based AI orchestration.
* Experience with Zoho Creator or other Zoho low-code platforms for additional integration capabilities.
* Zoho certifications or equivalent credentials.
* Experience with HTML, CSS, SQL, Node.js, and JavaScript for advanced UI customisation, widget enhancement, integrations, and analytical query support.
* Familiarity with CRM best practices, sales operations, and omnichannel customer experience.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Integrated CRM and Desk platforms deliver unified sales and customer service experiences with seamless data flow.
* Deluge-powered automation and custom widgets enhance sales dashboards and support interfaces with rich, intuitive UX.
* AI capabilities drive measurable improvements: higher sales conversion, improved forecast accuracy, better CSAT, reduced response times.
* Complex business logic in clean, maintainable Deluge code enables sales and support teams to focus on value-added activities.
* Integration ecosystem is mature, performant, and enables seamless data flow via Deluge connectors and APIs.
* AI-powered lead qualification, deal recommendations, customer support automation, and self-service reduce manual effort.
* You contribute to a high-performing technical team through knowledge sharing on Deluge best practices, widget development, and AI integration.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
**Description**
Anaqua is seeking a Senior Java Developer to take ownership of core backend services on RightHub, our distributed, domain-driven Java platform on GCP. In this hands-on senior role, you will own services end-to-end, design domain events and service integrations, and set the technical bar for the engineers around you. This role suits someone with strong distributed-systems instincts and a track record of mentoring.
  
  
**You'll Love This Job If You Like To**

* Own services end-to-end on a modern Java + Spring Boot platform — design, implementation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Design domain events and the integrations between services — event types, processors, idempotency, and eventual-consistency boundaries.
* Extend the shared platform libraries — auth, async tasks, common infrastructure — that every service in the company depends on.
* Write code that is genuinely tested — strong unit, integration, and contract testing as part of the development loop.
* Drive performance and reliability work, including query optimisation, debugging distributed flows, and capacity planning.
* Raise the engineering bar through code review, technical design docs, and mentoring mid-level engineers.
* Work across a modern stack: Java (latest LTS), Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Cloud GCP, Kubernetes (GKE), PostgreSQL with a domain-event model, and contract-first APIs with OpenAPI.
* Work closely with frontend engineers on the Next.js application when shipping features that cross the boundary.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful**

* 5+ years of senior-level Java engineering with proven production ownership of services real users depend on.
* Strong Spring Boot in production — fluent on transactional boundaries, connection pools, JVM tuning, and how things break under load.
* Distributed-systems thinking — async messaging, idempotency, retries, ordering, eventual consistency, and clean bounded contexts.
* Comfort with domain-driven design and event-sourcing patterns, designing domain events that capture state transitions.
* Contract-first API design with OpenAPI, deep PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, migrations under load).
* Production experience running services on Kubernetes, with hands-on experience on a major public cloud (GCP preferred).
* Strong testing discipline and extensive experience converting business requirements to technical requirements.
* Track record of mentoring, raising the engineering bar, and excellent written and spoken English.
* Spring Cloud GCP/Pub/Sub/Cloud Run, reusable internal libraries, React/Next.js knowledge, or IP/legal-tech/regulated B2B SaaS exposure all an advantage.

The company’s global operations are headquartered in Boston, with offices across the U.S., Europe, Asia, and Australia. For additional information, please visit anaqua.com, or on LinkedIn.

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
  
  
Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!
  
  
**About the role:**
Enterprise Technology builds and operates software that supports critical business capabilities across the organization. As a Software Engineer III, you will independently own complex engineering projects, significant features, services, integrations, and technical workstreams from design through production.
  
  
You will take on problems where the path is not always obvious, help clarify requirements, make project-level technical decisions, and use business and customer context to guide your approach. You will use AI coding agents to move faster on complex work and help other engineers use them effectively and responsibly.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* Own significant features, services, integrations, or project workstreams from problem definition and design through production support.
* Solve complex and ambiguous engineering problems and design maintainable APIs, data models, workflows, components, and user experiences.
* Help define project scope, technical approach, success criteria, and delivery milestones.
* Make project-level technical decisions and recommend improvements within established architecture.
* Strengthen quality through design reviews, code reviews, automated testing, observability, documentation, and secure engineering practices.
* Use AI coding agents and other AI-assisted tools to improve delivery and quality, while applying strong judgment about when human review or deeper validation is needed.
* Diagnose complex production issues, identify root causes, and improve reliability, performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Guide other engineers through technical problem solving, review, knowledge sharing, and project collaboration.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 5+ years of progressive software engineering experience.
* Experience independently owning complex features, services, integrations, or technical project workstreams.
* Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript and solid software engineering fundamentals.
* Strong experience with cloud environments, preferably GCP, including CI/CD, monitoring, debugging, security, performance, and reliability.
* Experience making technical design decisions and recognizing when broader architectural implications require escalation.
* Experience building production systems with strong automated testing, observability, maintainability, and security.
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted software development tools and understanding their strengths, limitations, and appropriate use.
* Clear communication and the ability to explain trade-offs, navigate ambiguity, and influence project-level decisions.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with modernization, refactoring, migrations, or technical debt reduction.
* Experience owning complex enterprise applications, workflow platforms, integrations, or data-intensive systems.
* Experience building reusable components, developer tooling, observability tooling, or internal platforms.
* Experience with SOX controls, compliance-sensitive systems, or audit-heavy environments.
* Domain experience in media, streaming, or content supply chains.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll
  
  
In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:
  
  

* Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.
* Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.
* Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance
* Health Saving Account HSA program
* Health care and dependent care FSA
* 401(k) plan, with employer match
* Employer paid commuter benefit
* Support program for new parents
* Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!

title: Senior Infrastructure Developer
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
As a Software Engineer, you will design, implement, and operate multi-agent workflows that bring automation and intelligence to accelerate asset management.
  
  
**What You Get To Do In This Role**

* Design and build intelligent agent workflows that coordinate specialized AI agents through controlled orchestration frameworks.
* Engineer end-to-end multi-agent pipelines — from data retrieval and reasoning to evaluation and decision-making.
* Integrate frontier AI models (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude), or fine-tuned internal models for reasoning, enrichment, and contextual decision-making — select and switch models based on complexity, cost, and accuracy trade-offs.
* Design, develop and maintain existing features, and enhance platform capabilities based on user feedback. Develop robust back-end services and APIs (Python or ServiceNow Scripting).
* Collaborate closely with SAM/HAM domain experts, product managers, and engineers to translate automation goals into resilient inbound agentic systems to deliver content at scale.
* Build intuitive UIs and dashboards in Service Portal, React, or Angular
* Leverage retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) strategies to ground AI reasoning in factual context from data sources — ensuring decisions are traceable and verifiable.
* Apply observability, logging, and traceability across all agent workflows to ensure reproducibility, reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Participate in code reviews, post-deployment analysis, and production debugging to maintain system quality and stability at scale.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 6-8 years of software development experience with strong command on a any object oriented language Java/Python.
* Hands-on experience developing LLM-powered or agent-based systems using frameworks for production use cases.
* Deep understanding of REST APIs, event-driven systems, asynchronous workflows, and back-end design.
* Experience implementing frontier AI models in enterprise workflow applications.
* Strong problem solving & foundation in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and design patterns, with attention to performance and scalability.
* Experience deploying AI or automation systems in production, emphasizing versioning, traceability, and performance monitoring.
* Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector stores, and prompt optimization.
* Working knowledge of the ServiceNow platform and JavaScript (ES6+) or willingness to learn these.
* Strong focus on code quality, observability, logging, and traceability — these are non-negotiable.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage or critically evaluate AI integration in work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving — including using AI-powered coding tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, and exploring AI's impact on business functions.

Additional Information
  
  
**Work Personas**
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
  
  
**Accommodations**
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
  
  
**Export Control Regulations**
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Syncade Developer
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Position: Sr. Software Engineer – AI Engineer**
At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients’ lives through science. Each of our colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change.
  
  
Scope
  
  
The EMES Core Platform, Its Components, Interfaces, Data Layer And Tools – Material And Inventory, Order Management, Equipment And Instrument Integration, Sample Management, Patient Scheduling System Integration, Label Printing, Recipe Authoring And Execution, Electronic Batch Records, And Batch Reporting And Analytics – Together With
  
  

* AI and GenAI services embedded in manufacturing workflows: assistants, retrieval over controlled documents, anomaly detection and decision support.
* Web applications and operator-facing interfaces across shop-floor, quality and supply-chain personas.
* Enterprise data models, databases, audit-trail architecture and reporting data flows; cloud migration and adoption of next-generation manufacturing systems.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
**AI Engineering**

* Design, build and operate production-grade AI services – not prototypes – including retrieval-augmented generation over SOPs, batch records, deviations and equipment documentation, and agentic workflows that act against MES systems under human oversight.
* Own the retrieval architecture (chunking, embedding selection, vector storage such as pgvector or OpenSearch, hybrid search, re-ranking, citation fidelity) and LLM application patterns: structured output and tool calling, MCP servers over enterprise systems, orchestration, cost controls and guardrails.
* Establish AI evaluation and observability: golden datasets, offline and online evals, regression gates in CI, hallucination and drift detection, tracing and human-in-the-loop review.
* Apply classical ML where it is the better tool (anomaly detection, forecasting, predictive quality) and ensure responsible, compliant AI: data classification, IP and PII protection, model and prompt versioning, reproducibility and validation evidence for GxP-relevant use.

**Web Application Development**

* Deliver full-stack applications: React with TypeScript front ends, component libraries and design systems, and responsive, accessible (WCAG) interfaces built for gloved, time-pressured shop-floor use as well as office users.
* Build backend services in Python (FastAPI) and/or Java (Spring Boot) exposing REST and GraphQL APIs with OpenAPI-first contracts, secured with OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, SSO and fine-grained RBAC, and write the data access layer with the same rigour as the API (deliberate query design, sound ORM boundaries, pagination, no N+1 access, idempotent writes).
* Implement real-time and AI-assisted experiences – WebSockets/SSE for live batch and equipment status, token streaming with inline citations – alongside validation-rich workflows including e-signature interaction patterns.
* Own quality and performance end to end: automated tests across the stack (pytest, Jest/Vitest, Playwright), load testing, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD) with GitOps delivery of application and database changes together against measured p95 targets.

**System and Data Architecture**

* Lead the design of distributed, multi-tenant systems: bounded contexts and Domain-Driven Design, service decomposition, API and event contracts, and evolution strategy. Own the data model end to end – conceptual, logical and physical design, deliberate normalization, and referential integrity, constraints and domain invariants enforced in the database rather than only in application code.
* Demonstrate advanced relational expertise: complex SQL, window functions, CTEs, stored procedures (PL/pgSQL, PL/SQL), partitioning, deliberate indexing strategy, and performance diagnosis from execution plans, statistics, lock contention and pool exhaustion.
* Apply correct transaction design (isolation levels, concurrency control, idempotency, retry semantics) and migration discipline (Flyway/Liquibase/Alembic, expand-contract zero-downtime rollout, tested rollback), and run databases as production assets on AWS: RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, Multi-AZ, read replicas, pooling, PITR and DR.
* Design regulated-grade data integrity – immutable, append-only audit trails (including hash-chained designs), e-signature records, ALCOA+, retention and archival – satisfying GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 and GAMP 5 (2nd edition, incl. AI/ML guidance) by design, not documentation alone.
* Design event-driven systems with Kafka (partitioning and ordering guarantees, transactional outbox, CQRS and event sourcing, sagas) and enable analytics without burdening the transactional system through change data capture (Debezium) and dimensional models for batch reporting.
* Reason rigorously about non-functional requirements – capacity, scalability, SLOs, failure modes, circuit breakers, backpressure, graceful degradation when a site link is down – and define caching, queuing and throttling strategy (Redis, SQS/SNS, idempotency keys).
* Architect for hybrid deployment (on-premise and near-line where shop-floor latency demands it, AWS for scale) using Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/ECS) and IaC; instrument for observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry); and apply security by design, mitigating the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

**Collaboration and Leadership**

* Partner with Manufacturing, MS&T, Quality, Automation and site IT to translate process needs into system and data design; produce and defend the artifacts of real architecture work (ADRs, design documents, data models, sequence and data-flow diagrams, threat models) and run design reviews; and communicate integration contracts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Mentor engineers, review code and designs, and raise the bar on clean code, TDD/BDD and craftsmanship – including governed AI-assisted development that improves throughput without weakening review rigour or compliance – while driving continuous improvement through Agile/Scrum across global teams.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, with 10-12 years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years building and operating web applications and 2+ years delivering AI/ML or GenAI capabilities into production (prototypes alone will not qualify).
* Expert-level SQL and relational data modeling with deep hands-on PostgreSQL (or Oracle/SQL Server): schema design, indexing, query tuning, transactions and migrations.
* Demonstrable system design capability at the level of a multi-service, multi-tenant platform – bounded contexts, API and event contracts, consistency and failure modes, capacity and scaling – with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/ECS), cloud-native architecture on AWS, infrastructure as code and Kafka-based event streaming.
* Strong hands-on Python 3.x with FastAPI and TypeScript with React; Java/Spring Boot experience is a strong advantage.
* Practical experience with the LLM application stack: model APIs, embeddings and vector search, RAG, tool calling, prompt and context engineering, and evaluation. Agent frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph) and MCP server development are an advantage.
* Working knowledge of MES/EMES platforms, pharmaceutical manufacturing and regulatory compliance – ISA-88 and ISA-95, electronic batch records, recipe execution – or demonstrated ability to ramp quickly in a regulated domain.
* Solid grounding in application and data security (OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, SSO, RBAC, TLS, secrets management), automated testing, CI/CD and observability tooling.
* Clear written communication (design documents, ADRs, API documentation) and strong collaboration across global teams.

Senior Power BI Developer –

Exp: 7 + Years ( SAL2)

1. Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade Power BI reports and dashboards that provide actionable business insights and support data-driven decision-making.

2. Develop optimized semantic models using dimensional modelling techniques, including star schemas, fact/dimension structures, and appropriate relationship design.

3. Create advanced DAX measures and calculated columns for KPIs, time intelligence, financial calculations, trend analysis, and complex business requirements.

9. Optimize report, DAX, and semantic-model performance using tools and techniques such as Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio, query optimization, model optimization, and aggregation strategies.

10. Design scalable data models and reporting architectures capable of supporting large datasets, incremental refresh, reusable semantic models, and enterprise analytics workloads.

11. Publish and manage Power BI content across development, test/UAT, and production environments, following controlled deployment and release-management practices.

12. Configure and support Power BI Service capabilities including workspaces, apps, gateways, refresh schedules, subscriptions, permissions, and deployment pipelines.

13. Collaborate with business analysts, data engineers, architects, product owners, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical designs, KPIs, and reporting solutions.

14. Establish development standards and perform code/design reviews, documentation, troubleshooting, data validation, source-to-report reconciliation, and production support to maintain reporting quality.

15. Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex business problems and translate them into effective BI and reporting solutions.

16. Should be independent and show strong ownership and accountability, taking responsibility for solutions from requirement gathering and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.

17. Demonstrate a continuous-learning mindset, staying current with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, DAX, data modeling, visualization, and modern BI engineering practices.

Senior Power BI Developer responsible for designing and delivering scalable enterprise BI solutions using Power BI, DAX, Power Query, semantic modeling, Paginated Reports, and Microsoft data platforms, with strong emphasis on performance, security, data quality, governance, and production-ready reporting.

title: Software Development Engineer - CFD
description:

**Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on programming experience in C/C++, with the ability to develop maintainable and production-quality software.
* Proficiency in Python and/or Tcl scripting for automation, customization, and engineering workflows.
* Experience developing GUI-based applications, with a good understanding of user interface design and software interaction patterns.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex requirements and translate them into practical software solutions.
* Working knowledge of both Linux and Windows operating systems and experience developing or supporting software in a multiplatform environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with software developers, engineering experts, and end users.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Qt and/or OpenGL.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and common CFD workflows.
* Experience with Simcenter HyperWorks or other CAE/engineering software.
* Experience with CAD modeling or visualization software.
* Knowledge of Finite Element Method (FEM) and structural analysis.
* Experience developing software for engineering, scientific, simulation, or visualization applications.
* Familiarity with scripting-driven engineering workflows and application customization.

description:
**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**
With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places.
