At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. **Role Overview**

This role includes developing Angular web screens, Node.js backend services, real-time communication features, REST APIs, and Linux-based deployment support. The developer will work closely with product, engineering, QA, DevOps and global R&D teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

Angular Web Client
  
  

* Build and maintain Angular web pages using TypeScript.
* Create user-friendly screens for configuration, monitoring, alarms, events and diagnostics.
* Connect the web application with backend REST APIs and WebSocket services.
* Ensure the interface is responsive, reliable and easy to use.

Node.js Web Backend
  
  

* Develop backend services using Node.js and TypeScript.
* Design and maintain REST APIs for the Angular web client.
* Support real-time communication using WebSockets and socket connections.
* Handle authentication, authorization, logging and error handling.

Linux Deployment and Support
  
  

* Deploy and support Node.js services on Linux.
* Configure services so they start and recover automatically.
* Troubleshoot application, network, server and performance issues.
* Maintain secure settings, logs, certificates and deployment procedures.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong experience in full-stack web application development.
* Good knowledge of Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS and responsive design.
* Good experience with Node.js, REST APIs and WebSockets.
* Understanding of authentication, authorization and secure coding practices.
* Experience with Linux environments, command-line tools and service deployment.
* Experience with Git or SVN, Jira, Jenkins or similar development tools.
* Ability to write unit, integration and automated UI tests.

Testing Responsibilities
  
  

* Create automated tests for frontend and backend features.
* Test APIs, WebSocket communication and socket connections.
* Support integration testing, product verification and code reviews.

**Experience And Technical Qualifications**

* 8-12 years of software development experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with enterprise web applications.
* Experience building scalable, secure and maintainable software.
* Ability to work across frontend, backend, database, testing and deployment areas.

Behavioural Competencies
  
  

* Takes ownership and delivers work on time.
* Communicates clearly with team members and stakeholders.
* Works well independently and as part of a team.
* Shows curiosity, accountability and willingness to learn.

Security Responsibilities
  
  

* Follow secure coding practices.
* Protect credentials, tokens, keys and configuration secrets.
* Use secure communication methods such as HTTPS and TLS.
* Support security logging, auditing and vulnerability checks.

Desirable Experience
  
  

* Experience with security, access-control, alarm or industrial-control systems.
* Experience with real-time event processing and dashboards.
* Knowledge of automated security and dependency-scanning tools.

Architecture Responsibilities
  
  
The developer will be responsible for maintaining clear boundaries between:
  
  

* Keep frontend, backend, real-time communication and deployment components well organized.
* Design software that is reliable, secure, scalable and easy to maintain.
* Document interfaces, protocols, deployment steps and system behavior clearly.

The system should remain cohesive and maintainable, with only the independent modules required to provide reliability, security, scalability and clear separation of responsibilities.
  
  
Personal Attributes
  
  

* Able to work effectively across frontend, backend, protocol and Linux environments.
* Strong attention to protocol accuracy, security and data integrity.
* Able to diagnose issues across the browser, application, network and operating-system layers.
* Focused on reliability, maintainability and predictable system behaviour.
* Comfortable working with real-time, high-volume security information.
* Able to translate complex technical functions into clear operator interfaces.
* Capable of working within an established architecture.
* Able to collaborate with embedded, mobile, test and product-development teams.
* Capable of documenting interfaces, protocols, deployment processes and system behaviour clearly.

**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

* Improve query reliability and performance across a multi-tenant distributed SQL deployment serving 50+ customers
* Build and operate services on AWS (EKS, IAM/STS, S3) with infrastructure-as-code practices
* Implement security controls for user-supplied connection parameters (JDBC URL validation, SSRF prevention, hostname allowlisting)
* Build materialized view scheduling, execution, and lifecycle management features
* Design and implement deployment automation — canary deployments, progressive rollouts, observability integration
* Collaborate with the NRDB/Dirac team on the internal connector bridging federated queries to New Relic's native telemetry engine
* Participate in on-call rotation and incident response for production systems

**What**
**We're**
**Looking**
**For**

* 5+ years of professional Java development .
* Strong experience building cloud-native applications on AWS.
* Experience designing and operating containerized microservices on Kubernetes
* Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. title: Senior SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Developer – ABAP Cloud / BTP
description:
**Senior SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Developer – ABAP Cloud / BTP**

**Experience:**
6-8 years in SAP ABAP development, with significant hands-on ABAP Cloud, RAP and S/4HANA Public Cloud project experience

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Hybrid

**About Accel4**

Accel4 Inc. is a high-growth IT services company and SAP Gold Partner headquartered in Santa Clara, California, specializing in SAP Cloud ERP, AI-powered analytics and cloud migration. This position is part of our delivery team in Hyderabad.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on Senior SAP Developer who has successfully designed, developed and delivered
**custom enhancements, applications, reports, APIs and integrations for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition**
.

The ideal candidate brings deep ABAP expertise combined with practical experience in
**ABAP Cloud, RAP, CDS views, SAP BTP and clean-core extensibility**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and deploy custom applications, extensions, reports and APIs for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition using ABAP Cloud and RAP.
* Build RAP business objects, including CDS view entities, behaviour definitions and implementations, service definitions, and OData service bindings.
* Develop and consume OData V2/V4 and other supported APIs to enable integrations between SAP S/4HANA and external systems.
* Design and implement in-app developer extensions and side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP, selecting the appropriate approach based on technical constraints and business requirements.
* Implement custom business logic, validations, enhancements and BAdIs using SAP-released extension points and APIs.
* Work with SAP standard APIs, communication scenarios, communication arrangements, authentication and connectivity configurations.
* Develop CDS-based reporting solutions and custom data models, including associations, access controls, annotations and performance optimization.
* Collaborate with functional consultants to translate business requirements into technically feasible solutions while adhering to clean-core principles.
* Troubleshoot complex development and integration issues, including API errors, authorization issues, data inconsistencies and performance bottlenecks.
* Own technical delivery from solution design through development, testing, deployment and production support.

**Must-Have Technical Skills**

**1. Strong ABAP Development Foundation**

* 6-8 years of hands-on ABAP development experience.
* Strong ABAP Objects, ABAP SQL, debugging and performance optimization skills.

**2. ABAP Cloud and RAP**

* Practical experience developing RAP-based applications or APIs delivered to production.
* Working knowledge of managed/unmanaged RAP scenarios, behavior implementations, actions, validations and determinations.
* Strong experience with CDS view entities, service definitions and service bindings.
* Hands-on experience using ABAP Development Tools (ADT).

**3. SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition**

* Direct project experience developing solutions for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.
* Understanding of ABAP Cloud restrictions, released objects/APIs, and clean-core development principles.
* Experience implementing developer extensibility and/or supported custom logic and enhancements.
* Ability to identify when a requirement needs an in-app extension, a side-by-side extension or a different supported approach.

**4. APIs and Integrations**

* Proven experience developing and/or consuming APIs for integrating SAP with external applications.
* Understanding of OData, REST, JSON, authentication, integration testing and error handling.
* Experience working with SAP standard APIs, communication scenarios and communication arrangements.
* At least one successfully delivered end-to-end integration involving SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.

**5. Technical Ownership**

* Ability to independently analyze requirements and propose workable technical solutions.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Experience supporting testing, deployment and production issues.
* Ability to clearly explain technical design decisions, limitations and alternative approaches.

**Good to Have**

* SAP BTP ABAP Environment (Steampunk) and side-by-side application development.
* SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration (CPI), including API-based integration flows.
* SAP Business Application Studio and Fiori elements development.
* SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP), Node.js or Java.
* SAP Build, event-driven integration and SAP Event Mesh.
* Experience integrating AI services using SAP AI Core, generative AI hub or other enterprise AI platforms.
* Classic ABAP development on S/4HANA Private Cloud or on-premise systems.
* SAP ABAP Cloud or BTP development certification.

description:

**Your Team's Impact**
**AI Foundry - BU Deployed Engineer**
****Role Overview****
The AI Foundry Forward Deployed SBU Engineer serves as the bridge between AI platform capabilities and real-world financial workflows. This role combines deep domain expertise in capital markets with strong AI engineering skills to rapidly design, prototype, deploy, and scale AI-native solutions for specific business units and strategic client opportunities.
  
  
Unlike a traditional software engineer, this individual is expected to operate at the intersection of product, engineering, consulting, and financial workflows. They must understand how investment professionals, advisors, bankers, analysts, portfolio managers, and relationship managers work, and be capable of helping existing teams translate their applications from legacy systems to modern AI-native designs. The ideal candidate is comfortable with tackling large open-ended problems, designing agent workflows with product teams, integrating APIs and MCPs with engineers, and demonstrating solutions directly to clients.
  
  
****What You'll Do****
**Business Unit Solution Ownership**

* Partner directly with Banking, Wealth, Buy-Side, and Research teams to identify high-value AI opportunities.
* Design AI-native workflows that solve real user problems rather than simply embedding AI into existing products.
* Deconstruct existing products and applications into key high-value primitives to fuel AI agents and workflows (APIs, MCPs / Tools, Agents, and more).
* Serve as the technical lead for strategic pilots, proofs of concept, and forward-deployed engagements.
* Develop reusable patterns that can transition from custom solutions into scalable platform capabilities.

**AI Solution Development**

* Build agentic workflows using Foundry platforms, APIs, MCPs, evaluation frameworks, and agent infrastructure.
* Design prompt, tool, memory, and workflow architectures.
* Create deterministic, auditable workflows suitable for institutional financial clients.
* Leverage evaluation frameworks to improve quality, repeatability, and trustworthiness.
* Prototype and validate new solutions rapidly with end users.

5+ Years experience building applications in Finance.

* Asset Management
* Buy-Side Research
* Institutional Portfolio Management

* Fixed income
* ETFs
* Mutual funds
* Alternative investments
* Portfolio analytics
* Risk analytics
* Benchmarks
* Performance attribution

1+ Years experience building AI-based applications.

* Web Development or Python
* APIs, MCP Implementations, and Tool Calling Architectures
* LLMs
* Prompt engineering
* Agent architectures
* Vector search / RAG
* Evaluation frameworks
* Workflow orchestration
* Cloud-native development

**Preferred:**

* Multi-agent systems
* Knowledge graphs
* Retrieval systems
* Fine-tuning concepts
* Agent memory systems
* AI governance frameworks

**Engineering Fundamentals**
10+ Years experience building software applications.
  
  
**Required:**

* Solution architecture
* Security and governance
* Software development lifecycle
* Production deployment experience
* CI/CD
* Containerization

**Product Builder Mindset**
Enjoys creating ambiguous zero-to-one solutions.
  
  
****What's In It For You****

* At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

+ The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
+ Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.

+ A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
+ Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
+ Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

* Learn more about our benefits here. Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

****Company Overview:****
FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. title: Native / Desktop Engineer
description:
TTEC Digital seeks a Native / Desktop Engineer to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!
  
  
**The work:**
We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.
  
  
This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
  
  
**Who we hire — the DNA:**

* Self-starters and do-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.
* No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**

* Build Desktop Intercept — the native Windows driver and app that acts as a virtual mic/speaker, replaces audio in real time, and (Phase 1 Phase C) reads the DOM and drives Computer Use
* This is the hardest engineering on the platform and the deepest moat. Everything you build feeds a high-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency distributed platform — voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI combined — so you think in latency budgets, throughput, and efficiency, not just features
* Startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast and move forward.

**What you'll own:**

* Windows native driver (WASAPI, virtual audio devices, kernel-adjacent hooks)
* real-time bidirectional audio routing
* The user-space app (audio router, DOM scraper, MCP server)
* The desktop-to-cloud path onto the event bus (NATS-class, WebSocket) under a sub-300ms budget
* AV co-existence and mass-deployment
* Your committed timelines.

**Who you are:**

* Self-starter, hacker, grit
* You consider yourself exceptional at the systems level and can show it
* You love new technology, adapt fast when it changes, demonstrate ideas with working code, and use AI tools daily to multiply your velocity
* Team player who makes and hits committed timelines
* Loves solving the problems nobody else can — and winning.

**What You Will Bring:**

* 8+ years systems / native development; shipped a Windows desktop agent at real scale (>10k seats) with audio.
* Strong C/C++ — mandatory. Strong Go for the service side — mandatory.
* Comfortable building and interacting with drivers — virtual audio devices, virtual microphones/speakers, WASAPI / Core Audio, kernel-adjacent hooks.
* Real-time audio pipelines under a sub-300ms budget — buffering, resampling, drift, glitch-free capture/playback.
* Understands high-efficiency systems end-to-end — event-driven architecture, pub/sub, WebSocket streaming, and what state, race conditions, and locking mean at the native layer (lock-free audio buffers, real-time threads, priority inversion).
* macOS / Linux native experience is a huge +++++ — cross-platform desktop is where this goes next.
* Browser / DOM internals and process injection a strong plus (Phase C).
* Enterprise mass-deployment craft — MSI/installer engineering, silent deploys, fleet upgrades across 10k+ locked-down seats.
* Driver/code signing and AV/EDR co-existence — WHQL, EV certs, and staying invisible to CrowdStrike-class agents without tripping them.
* Crash-dump and telemetry discipline — WinDbg/minidumps, symbolized crash reporting from the field; you debug machines you'll never touch.
* Security posture — least-privilege service design; this app hears customer audio and reads screens, so it must be provably tight.
* A master debugger at the systems level — kernel logs, crash dumps, audio glitches, AV interference; you see it.
* SIP / RTP a strong plus. Mid-tier or better hands-on AI-in-product experience a plus (the desktop app hosts an MCP server and drives Computer Use).

* 3 years of experience building software for data privacy or security (e.g., identity and access management).
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience in security systems, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.
* Experience as a technical lead with a proven track record of leading teams.
* Experienced in navigating high-ambiguity environments and defining technical strategy for engineering teams.

**About The Job**
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer (L5) on the detection and response AI team, you will take end-to-end ownership of different workstreams across the Detection AI space. You will operate with high autonomy, translating ambiguous organizational goals into clear technical roadmaps. You will research, identify, and lead critical problems for the team to solve. Partnering alongside a peer Tech Lead, you will carve out multi-quarter technical initiatives, establish architectural direction, and multiply the output of a talented pool of L3 and L4 engineers.
  
  
This team build multi-agent systems to autonomously triage, investigate, and remediate security events, and architect governance frameworks, evaluation pipelines, and observability dashboards for security AI. We operate key enterprise platforms (Brief, Incident Communications) orchestrating critical communications during major Alphabet incidents.
  
  
The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Scope out problems in detection and response space and enable the organizational strategy to move left in the detection pipeline.
* Set technical direction, author comprehensive design documents, and lead design reviews for complex, multi-quarter features within the team.
* Partner closely with cross-functional peers and sister SWE teams to resolve architectural dependencies and align project timelines.
* Guide, mentor, and delegate tasks to adjacent junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a collaborative engineering culture.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Shipping is the starting line. We want engineers who stay for the finish.**
Launching a feature is the easy part. What separates strong engineers from the rest is what they do when the pager goes off, when a traffic surge hits unexpectedly, or when a client’s revenue depends on your service staying up. At Techdome, we hire people who treat production as their responsibility, not someone else’s problem.
  
  
We design and deliver production-ready platforms for clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, SaaS, Logistics, and EdTech. The domains change; our bar doesn’t. Everything we build must be dependable, secure, and ready to scale. We’re now hiring a Senior Software Engineer who can architect, build, and operate systems using Node.js, React, MongoDB, and TypeScript, and who stays invested in how those systems perform long after launch.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Responsible For**

* The full lifecycle of your features: Drive everything from early design through development, deployment, and long-term upkeep, and remain accountable well beyond go-live.
* Resilient APIs and applications: Build secure, well-tested, scalable services that stay stable under real production traffic.
* Raising the engineering standard: Lead meaningful code reviews and set the practices that keep our codebases healthy and reliable.
* Production firefighting: Step into incidents hands-on, bring services back quickly, and lead root-cause analysis so the same problem never returns.
* Architectural direction: Help shape system design and the major technical decisions that guide our platforms.
* Developing your teammates: Mentor and coach fellow engineers to strengthen the whole team.
* Working across functions: Collaborate closely with product, design, QA, and DevOps, with hands-on work in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, containers, and observability tooling.
* Learning each client’s world: Rapidly grasp the business, users, and constraints behind every project and translate them into the right technical approach.

**How Your First Three Months Look**

* Days 1–30: Get to know our codebases, delivery workflow, and people, and ship your first meaningful contribution.
* Days 31–60: Take end-to-end ownership of a feature or service, and become a visible contributor in code reviews and technical discussions.
* Days 61–90: Become a trusted engineer on a core client product, operate confidently in production, and begin guiding those around you.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* Strong working knowledge of Node.js, React, MongoDB, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Solid foundation in REST API design, database architecture, authentication and authorization, testing, and application security.
* Proven experience operating production applications at scale, not only building them.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Comfort with CI/CD, Git, Docker, and production monitoring and debugging.
* Experience across different industries or product types, with the ability to ramp up quickly on unfamiliar domains.
* Demonstrated leadership and a record of stepping up when ownership matters.

**Nice to Have**

* Depth in system design, distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architecture.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code.
* Experience with compliance and security frameworks such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, or SOC 2.
* Experience integrating third-party services such as payment gateways (Stripe, Braintree, Adyen), CRMs, or analytics platforms.
* Background in a consultancy or product studio, handling several clients and products simultaneously.
* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot.

**Why Join Techdome?**

* Independent and profitable: We’re bootstrapped, with no investor pressure and no growth-at-any-cost targets. We build for the long haul.
* A truly global team: Work alongside 80+ engineers spread across five hubs around the world.
* Constant variety: Move across industries and products, so there’s always something new to learn.
* Real influence: Your input directly shapes our technical direction, and your role goes well beyond closing tickets.

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. This Role deals with in-house software development for InfoSec groups (primarily, but not exclusively, for Cyber Operations personnel). The team-member will partner with members of cyber operations, information security and the larger business to design, develop, test, and deploy strong automation use-cases. More so, the ideal candidate will be capable of critical thinking and problem solving with a customer-first attitude.

* Partner with technology leaders in adherence to technology strategy and roadmap.
* Skillfully gather and analyze requirements from requesting parties and stakeholders.
* Design, develop, and release new use cases to maximize the benefits and efficiencies from a SOAR platform.
* Develop automations using no-code, low-code, and traditional code approaches, in that order.
* Engineer for software quality through sound manual and automated testing, peer review, and customer acceptance.
* Develop and maintain custom security apps and tools via python web development.
* Improve performance and efficiency of existing automation solutions.
* Participate in diagnosing and resolving production support issues as directed.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4 to 5+ years of software engineering within Information Security or Intelligence contexts; OR in lieu of degree, 6 to 7+ years of software engineering within Information Security or Intelligence contexts
* Demonstrated competence in Python, particularly HTTP client programming.
* SOAR platform engineering and development preferred.
* Intimate familiarity with the Agile Manifesto preferred.
* Able to communicate complex information, concepts, or ideas in a confident and well-organized manner through verbal, written, and/or visual means.

**Desired Skills & Knowledge**

* Applicable Information Security professional certifications (e.g., SANS, AWS Security and Developer based certifications) and tool-specific certifications.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
* Highly analytical, detail-oriented, and strong problem solving with a common-sense approach to resolving problems.
* Expertise to clearly define complex issues despite incomplete or ambiguous information.
* Strong oral and written communications skills.
* Strong interpersonal and critical thinking skills.
* Prior SOC, cyber intelligence, or incident response experience is a plus.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor’s degree with 4 to 5+ years of software engineering within Information Security or Intelligence contexts; OR in lieu of degree, 6 to 7+ years of software engineering within Information Security or Intelligence contexts
  
  
**Work Timings: 4:00 AM to 12:00 PM ET**

This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs)

actively scaling and supporting their infrastructure.

**Customer First, Integrity, Transparency, and Innovation**

When you join Prodigy, you will experience:

* **Warm, brilliant colleagues**
  who push you to be your best engineering self.
* **A humble management team**
  that is fiercely committed to doing the right thing.
* **An environment of radical documentation:**
  We live by a strict operational doctrine:
  **"Over-communication is a mandatory requirement."**
  We heavily utilize Microsoft Teams, Emails, and written technical specs.
  **If it is not in writing, it never happened.**

**Role Description & Intent**

**We are looking for a powerhouse, battle-tested Senior Consultant / Principal Engineer (IC)**
who can single-handedly pull the engineering weight of an entire team. This is a high-throttle street—the work is highly demanding, intensely fast-paced, yet deeply rewarding.

This is strictly a
**production-code-producing role**
. You will not be limited to high-level whiteboard architecture; you must actively write, optimize, compile, and ship the code you design. You will be responsible for tearing down a legacy enterprise stack and rebuilding it from scratch using state-of-the-art Generative AI acceleration.

**Core Responsibilities & Technical Expectations**

* **Production Code Execution:**
  Massively produce clean, scalable, production-grade code leveraging
  **Microsoft .NET Core (C#)**
  and advanced
  **SQL Server**
  engineering.
* **AI-Autonomous Engineering:**
  Operate as an AI-augmented developer. You must natively orchestrate autonomous AI software agents (like
  **Devin**
  ) and advanced tools (
  **ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf**
  ) within sandboxed environments to multiply development speed.
* **Spec-Driven Development (SDD):**
  Write software exclusively against rigorous, unambiguous technical specifications. Code is only written once the spec is perfect.
* **Architectural Rigor:**
  Strictly apply
  **SOLID principles**
  and decoupled design patterns to ensure the new stack is easily maintainable.
* **High-Scale Engineering:**
  Design, implement, and maintain systems built to handle
  **0.5 Million+ active customers**
  and scale smoothly through
  **5 Million+ transactions daily**
  with bulletproof stability.
* **Hybrid Infrastructure Management:**
  Engineer code optimized to run seamlessly within a primary
  **On-Premises Data Center**
  while managing low-latency replication and automated failover pipelines to
  **AWS Disaster Recovery (DR)**
  .
* **Observability & Instrumentation:**
  Build world-class distributed log instrumentation and tracing setups to ensure zero blind spots across the On-Prem/AWS boundary.
* **Cost-Sensitive Engineering:**
  Demonstrate a relentless focus on minimizing cloud operational spend, compute overhead, and execution costs per transaction.

**Core Skills & Competencies**

* **Primary Stack:**
  Microsoft .NET C#, .NET Core, Advanced SQL Server (Query optimization, locking, indexing structures).
* **AI Engineering:**
  Cognition Devin orchestration, ChatGPT prompt engineering, Cursor, Windsurf.
* **Methodologies:**
  Spec-Driven Development (SDD), SOLID Principles, Test-Driven Development (TDD).
* **Infrastructure:**
  Hybrid Data Centers, AWS Core Services (EC2, S3, RDS, DR automation).
* **Observability:**
  Advanced Distributed Logging, Telemetry, and APM Instrumentation.
* **Industry Knowledge:**
  Prior experience in the
  **Texas Energy & Utilities sector**
  (ERCOT, smart grids, or deregulated market clearing) is a massive plus.

**Rigorous 4-Round Interview Evaluation Process**

1. **Round 1: Elite Core Engineering & Architecture Deep-Dive**

* *Focus:*
  Severe testing of .NET/C# memory allocations, asynchronous programming models, multi-threading, and SQL Server transactional plan internals.

1. **Round 2: The AI-Augmented Hyper-Velocity Coding Challenge**

* *Focus:*
  A live, 60-minute, hands-on programming test. Candidates must leverage Generative AI tools (Devin/Cursor paradigms) to modernize a complex legacy code block into fully instrumented, spec-driven code.

1. **Round 3: Scale, Hybrid Infra & Cost-Sensitive Systems Design**

* *Focus:*
  Whiteboard scenario cracking. Designing for 5M daily transactions, maintaining sync across On-Prem and AWS DR, and proving compute-cost efficiency.

1. **Round 4: High-Throttle Executive & Cultural Fit**

* *Focus:*
  Evaluation of written and verbal communication fluency, mental stamina under high pressure.

title: Principal, Tech (Middleware)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a senior technologist to join our Messaging Middleware team based in the firm’s offices in Hyderabad, Bengaluru or Gurugram. The team is responsible for building and evolving a framework for real-time data streaming web applications used across the firm. This framework enables partner teams to focus on business logic while relying on a robust shared platform to handle the complexity of real-time messaging, data delivery, scalability, resiliency, observability, and developer ergonomics. As a principal-level individual contributor, you will help shape the technical direction of a core platform, make key architectural and implementation decisions, contribute directly to high-impact systems, and raise the engineering bar through technical leadership, mentorship, and example.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will design, build, and enhance a framework that powers real-time data streaming web applications across the firm. You will work on capabilities that improve platform efficiency, robustness, scalability, observability, and ease of use for application teams. You will partner closely with framework users to understand their requirements and translate them into reusable platform capabilities that support low-latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant application behavior. You will drive performance tuning across the stack, including messaging, serialization, transport, concurrency, backpressure handling, and client/server interactions. You will help design resilient systems that handle failures gracefully, including network interruptions, traffic spikes, and partial service degradation. You will also contribute directly to the implementation of critical components, review architecture and code, troubleshoot production issues, and drive improvements in testing, operability, and long-term design health. As a senior technical leader on the team, you will mentor junior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and day-to-day collaboration. You will influence engineering culture by setting a high bar in technical rigor, ownership, and execution, and periodically providing clear updates to senior stakeholders on technical direction, system health, key deliverables, and important risks or trade-offs.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical discipline with a strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, distributed systems, and object-oriented programming
* The candidate should have 7+ years of software engineering experience building high-performance, real-time distributed systems
* The candidate should have strong experience with messaging middleware, event-driven systems, and low-latency data streaming architectures
* Proven experience designing and building production-grade frameworks, platforms, or shared infrastructure
* The candidate should have strong understanding of performance, scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance in distributed systems
* The candidate should have hands-on experience with technologies such as Kafka, Solace, NATS, RabbitMQ, Pulsar, WebSockets, SSE, or gRPC streaming
* The candidate should have strong software design, debugging, testing, and code quality fundamentals
* The candidate should have experience with production observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational support
* The candidate should have demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring experience as a senior individual contributor
* The candidate should have excellent written and oral communication skills
* The candidate should be comfortable working in a language-agnostic environment
* Candidates with experience in browser-facing real-time applications, serialization and wire protocols, resilience patterns, or large-scale performance testing will have an added advantage

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PrncplMiddlewareApr26

title: Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer – Residential Gateways (prplOS & Wireless)
description:
**Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer – Residential Gateways (prplOS & Wireless)Role**
**Overview**
We are looking for a Lead Embedded Firmware Developer with 12+ years of experience to drive the architectural direction, optimization, and scaling of our next-generation Residential Gateway products. Our software architecture leverages prplOS, making our platform inherently SoC-independent across diverse silicon, including Broadcom and MaxLinear SoCs.
  
  
In this role, you will serve as the technical authority for our embedded firmware and wireless stack. You will own the Linux wireless architecture, scaling our platform to support cutting-edge Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 capabilities, while ensuring carrier-grade stability through deep system-level profiling and optimization using tools like perf and Valgrind. Additionally, you will champion automation by using Python scripting to build robust testing and unit testing framework methodologies that ensure code quality across the entire lifecyle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & Architecture: Lead the architectural design of resilient, hardware-agnostic gateway firmware, mentoring engineering teams and establishing embedded development best practices.
* Test Automation & Scripting: Architect and implement automated testing and unit testing frameworks using Python to validate system components, APIs, and overall firmware reliability.
* Performance Profiling & Optimization: Use perf, Valgrind (Memcheck, Massif, Helgrind), and kernel utilities to profile OS memory and CPU management, eliminate memory leaks, resolve race conditions, and minimize CPU bottlenecks.
* Wireless Stack & Driver Integration: Design, configure, and optimize Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 features using hostapd, wpa\_supplicant, and iw sub-systems.
* Firmware Development: Architect, develop, and maintain high-performance firmware in C and C++ across various gateway hardware platforms.
* SoC Abstraction: Leverage prpl APIs to maintain hardware-agnostic implementations across multiple carrier-grade SoCs.
* Inter-process Communication (IPC): Develop and maintain scalable services utilizing ubus and/or iMTP to ensure reliable internal bus communication.
* Network Stack Management: Design and troubleshoot robust Layer 2 and Layer 3 network stacks to ensure optimal routing, bridging, and packet forwarding.
* Service Management & Provisioning: Implement and maintain device management and service models, including TR-181 data models and USP (User Services Platform / TR-369).
* Containerization & Lifecycle Management: Configure and manage containerized microservices and virtual execution environments using Docker and prpl LCM (Lifecycle Management).
* Version Control: Manage source code, branching strategies, and firmware release pipelines using Git.

**Must-Have Requirements**

* Experience: 10+ years of hands-on embedded firmware development experience in the telecom, networking, or residential gateway industries.
* Languages: High proficiency in C and modern C++ programming within resource-constrained embedded systems.
* Platform Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Embedded Linux development within OpenWrt or prplOS ecosystems.
* Device Management: Deep, production-level expertise with broadband management standards, explicitly TR-181 data models and USP (TR-369).
* Containerization: Demonstrated experience deploying, isolating, and configuring containerized microservices using Docker and lifecycle tools like prpl LCM.
* Advanced Linux Wireless: Deep knowledge of the Linux Wireless stack, including hostapd, wpa\_supplicant, iw, and Linux wireless drivers.
* Networking Protocols: Deep understanding of Layer 2/3 networking and core routing/bridging concepts.
* Profiling & Debugging: Hands-on experience with Linux profiling and debugging tools, specifically perf and Valgrind.
* Version Control: Strong expertise managing source code and branching strategies via Git.

**Good-to-Have Requirements**

* Next-Gen Wi-Fi: Experience implementing, configuring, or debugging next-generation wireless features like Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7.
* Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Python for creating automated test scripts, hardware validation, or test execution.
* Testing Frameworks: Experience building or maintaining unit testing frameworks (e.g., CUnit, Unity, PyTest) in an embedded context.
* IPC Frameworks: Deep familiarity with OpenWrt ubus and message bus architectures like iMTP.
* Hardware Abstraction: Hands-on experience developing abstraction layers on Broadcom or MaxLinear residential gateway SoCs.

40

**Role Description: Hands On Data Lead & Systems Integrator**
We are seeking a
**Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS)**
to serve as a primary technical execution lead across our core data platform and its application integration interfaces.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. While operating within the overarching platform architecture established by Principal Engineers, you will own the delivery of high-impact data engineering projects, build resilient pipelines, and ensure data products seamlessly plug into downstream applications, web tools, and agentic workflows. You will bring deep expertise in core data engineering (Python, Snowflake, dbt, SQL) complemented by solid working knowledge of the app development ecosystem (Node.js, APIs, microservices) to bridge data platforms with full-stack systems. You will lead project-level execution, mentor senior engineers, and translate complex requirements into production-ready software.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Data Engineering Project Leadership & Execution: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of end-to-end data pipelines for batch and event-driven workloads. Own project-level technical delivery, write high-performance production code, and guide team members to deliver scalable data products on schedule.
* Data Platform & Product Design: Define patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and storage using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. Establish standards for data contracts, semantic consistency, lineage, and reusable data assets to support both business analytics and AI applications.
* App Ecosystem & Integration Layering: Design and maintain lightweight API integration components, Node.js services, and middleware that expose data platform capabilities to full-stack applications, web dashboards, and external enterprise platforms (Salesforce, AWS).
* Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration: Implement enterprise-controlled agentic capabilities and AI-enabled workflows. Integrate autonomous agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into application endpoints and data pipelines, ensuring structured outputs, context retrieval, and clear human-agent handoffs.
* Verification & Production Reliability: Establish testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, performance tuning, and operational observability across both data pipelines and app integration services. Define and enforce SLOs/SLAs for pipeline availability, data freshness, and API endpoint performance.
* Cross-Team Leadership & Quality Standards: Conduct code and design reviews. Mentor Senior and Associate Engineers, championing engineering standards for clean code, automated testing, and documentation across both data and application interfaces.

**Technical Profile**

* Core Data Engineering Foundations:
* Deep expertise in Python and advanced SQL, with a strong background in operating production data platforms.
* Extensive experience with data stack technologies: dbt, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, and Snowflake (including query optimization, performance tuning, cost management, and complex troubleshooting).
* Command of distributed systems, dimensional/domain-oriented data modeling, batch/streaming patterns, and Data Mesh / data-as-a-product concepts.
* Application Ecosystem & Integration Knowledge:
* Practical experience with Node.js and TypeScript / JavaScript for building lightweight backend services, microservices, or integration layers.
* Hands-on knowledge of designing and consuming REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and event queues (Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS).
* Understanding of web app integration patterns, API gateways, and enterprise authentication protocols (OAuth2, SSO).
* AI & Agentic Engineering:
* Practical experience building or integrating AI-enabled workflows using frameworks like LangGraph or LangChain.
* Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, structured outputs, context engineering, vector stores, and retrieval mechanisms.
* Effective use of AI-native developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) with rigorous review and testing of generated code.
* Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure:
* Hands-on experience operating on cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Familiarity with Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS), serverless deployment (Lambda), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

**Qualifications**

* Experience: Typically 10 to 14+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or Platform Engineering (or equivalent demonstrated technical depth).
* Execution Leadership: Proven track record of leading complex data projects from requirements through architecture, deployment, and ongoing operation.
* Hybrid Systems Knowledge: Ability to serve as the bridge between core data platform engineering (Python/SQL/Snowflake) and web application developer teams (Node.js/APIs).
* Business & Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical implementation choices into business outcomes, work closely with product managers, and communicate effectively across engineering teams.

title: Design System/UX Engineer
description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
  
  
TTEC Digital seeks a Design System/UX Engineer to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!
  
  
**The work:**
We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.
  
  
This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
  
  
**Who we hire — the DNA:**

* Self-starters and do-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.
* No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**

* Own the design system in code and the UX of the wedge — the Agent UI shell, slide-out / pill, Control UI, and the per-module panels
* UX here ships as code, not Figma hand-offs. This is not a look-pretty job: the UI renders live voice, desktop, and AI event streams in real time, and you have to understand the technology underneath — events, WebSocket state, latency, plugin loading — so what you design flows and works, not just looks good
* Startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast, move forward.

**What you'll own:**

* The design system as a real component library — templates and patterns developers implement without friction
* Agent UI / Control UI interaction patterns
* Active Listening and Agent Handover UX
* The graphics language of the product (iconography, motion, data visualization)
* Accessibility (Lighthouse a11y > 90) and keyboard-first agent flows
* Your committed timelines.

**Who you are:**

* A self-starter with taste and grit — a designer who ships
* Show-me mentality: you demo working UI on Fridays like every other engineer
* You think from the developer's seat: every component you design, you've already thought through how the squads will implement, extend, and theme it — your design system makes them faster, never slower
* You love new technology, adapt fast when the product shifts weekly, use AI tools daily to multiply velocity, consider yourself exceptional, and like winning.

**What You Will Bring:**

* 7+ years of product design with real front-end engineering — you ship React + TypeScript, not just specs.
* Strong graphics experience — ++++ on visual craft: iconography, motion design, canvas/SVG data visualization, rendering dense live data beautifully and legibly.
* Has owned a design system as a living component library in a fast-shipping product — versioned, documented, themed, adopted.
* Strong templating discipline — reusable patterns and layout systems built for developer implementation; you understand component APIs, composition, and what makes a pattern cheap or expensive to build.
* Understands the tech underneath — WebSocket-driven state, event ordering, render performance, module federation/plugin loading — well enough that your designs never fight the architecture.
* Strong on dense, real-time, professional-tool UX (think trading terminals, not marketing sites) — an agent lives in this UI 8 hours a day.
* Accessibility and keyboard-first design as defaults, not afterthoughts.
* Perceived-performance craft — skeletons, optimistic updates, motion that masks latency; the UI must feel instant even when the network isn't.
* Design tokens as the theming backbone — enterprise customers will want branding; tokens make that config, not a rewrite.
* Overlay/extension constraints fluency — designing UI injected over a host page (pill, slide-out) with its size, z-index, and isolation realities.
* Usability evidence at startup speed — lightweight session recordings and agent feedback loops instead of month-long studies.
* A debugger in the browser — you profile the render, find the jank, and fix your own component.

description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. **About Lilly**
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
**About The Technology Organization**
At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Hyderabad builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.
  
  
**About The Business Function**
From molecule to market, Global Manufacturing plays an important role in every step along a product’s lifecycle. Most of our customers never see the scientific and technical resources behind our medicines. But customers experience, every day, the performance of our high-quality products and global supply network.
  
  
Global Manufacturing comprises a core group of functions that drives the production and supply of high-quality products: Engineering; Manufacturing Information & Control Systems (Technology@Lilly); Quality & Labs, Technology Services/Manufacturing Science; Global Health, Safety and Environment; and Supply Chain.
  
  
**Role: Senior Technical Engineer – LabVantage Master Data**
The Senior Technical Engineer will be leading designing, building, and automating analytical test methods and associated data and specifications within LabVantage LIMS, and for developing or coordinating the development of instrument drivers and integrations that enable direct data capture into LIMS from laboratory instruments.
  
  
This role combines domain expertise in laboratory processes and analytical methods with technical leadership in LIMS MD configuration & Custom development. The incumbent will play a key role in advancing the organization’s digital laboratory ecosystem, driving data integrity, automation, and compliance in GxP systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**What**
**you’ll**
**be doing:**
**LabVantage MD Development & Build**

* Develop the configuration, creation, and lifecycle management of analytical test methods in LabVantage LIMS (i.e. All interconnected MDs to support entire workflow for test method to work as per expectations).
* Implement test templates, specifications, and parameter lists ensuring standardization and scalability across products and sites.
* Define and maintain Test method metadata structures for automation (units, limits, calculations, result entry templates).
* Custom Script development for data transfer or verifications
* Implement Test method versioning, review, and approval workflows in accordance with organisational data governance and validation policies.
* Partner with functional SMEs to ensure test methods adhering with GxP, ALCOA+, and analytical method validation principles.
* Build test scenarios/ documents and Test method templates

**Technical Maintenance and Master Data Support**

* Triage, analyze and resolve issues through root cause analysis, harnessing both business and technical knowledge to minimize downtime.
* Driver L3 Engineering with global data team, site team and ensuring timely completion
* Develop and maintain scripts, business rules, and LabVantage SDK components to automate data processing and workflow activities.
* Enable service improvement through fixes of incidences
* Support and analyze instrument integrations (e.g.,Lab Application - Empower, Chromeleon, SmartLab, Darwin, Complex instruments) and maintain data exchange with ERP, ELN, QMS, EM and analytics systems.

**Automation & Digital Integration**

* Develop automation frameworks to reduce manual effort in test method setup and instrument data handling.
* Support initiatives for automated test method build from structured templates or upstream systems (ERP/PLM).
* Collaborate with analytics teams to make instrument and method data analytics-ready for dashboards and trending.

**Governance, Validation & Documentation**

* Support for versioned MD, and auditable as part of GxP compliance and following regulatory and Lilly IT quality standards (CSV-Computer System Validation).
* Create design documents, configuration specifications and technical SOPs for test method.
* Support QA in CSV, change control, and periodic review activities.
* Active participation in audits and ensure all automation components meet 21 CFR Part 11 and Annex 11 requirements.
* Prepare and maintain design specifications, configuration documentation, and validation test scripts for IQ/OQ/PQ activities along with installation procedures
* Support change control, release management, ensuring compliance and stability in a multi-environment setup.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Strong technical SME for LabVantage test method management
* Collaboration with site-level LabVantage data stewards to lead test methods management
* Partner with global digital, quality, and IT SMEs to define and implement standards for method and instrument onboarding.
* Enable process improvement through automation, template standardization, and adoption of new technologies

**How You Will Succeed**

* Reduced manual effort and faster development of new test methods.
* Improved data flow between LabVantage and analytical instruments in secured environment
* Compliance with global lab data governance and validation standards.
* Enablement of analytics-ready, high-quality laboratory data.

**What You Should Bring**

* Strong analytical and critical thinking.
* Technical proficiency in LIMS MD development, management and delievrables
* Understanding of analytical lab workflows and instruments.
* Excellent documentation and verbal communication
* Ability to work across global teams (IT, Quality, Lab Operations).
* Strategic outlook to connect lab automation initiatives with enterprise digital goals.

**Basic Qualifications And Experience Requirement**

* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Computer Science/ Instrumentation /Chemical Engineering / Analytical Chemistry, or related field.
* 8+ years of experience in laboratory informatics, preferably in the pharma, biotech, or chemicals industry.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience configuring and deploying LabVantage LIMS Master Data (i.e. test methods, specifications, calculations, and workflows).
* Experience integrating LabVantage with chromatography and analytical instrument systems (Empower, Chromeleon, Microplate readers, etc.).
* Strong knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and data integrity principles (ALCOA+).
* Familiarity with ETL/middleware tools and system validation (CSV/SDLC) practices.
* Exposure to data analytics or digital lab transformation projects is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with JIRA, ALM, Git and ServiceNow (SNOW) for requirement tracking, defect management, and change control activities in regulated environments.

title: Applied Scientist I, Worldwide Returns & Recommerce - Science
description:
**Description**
Welcome to the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon.com.
  
  
WWR&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. Our goal is to achieve the three zeroes: zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects. We do this by developing products and driving truly innovative operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon – Returns & ReCommerce.
  
  
Amazon WWR&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop highly respected product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.
  
  
You will help create everything from customer-facing and vendor-facing websites to the internal software and tools behind the reverse-logistics process. You can develop scalable, high-availability solutions to solve complex and broad business problems.
  
  
We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
  
  
Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WWR&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and evaluate highly innovative models for Natural Language Programming (NLP), Large Language Model (LLM), or Large Computer Vision Models.
* Use SQL to query and analyze the data.
* Use Python, Jupyter notebook, and Pytorch to train/test/deploy ML models.
* Use machine learning and analytical techniques to create scalable solutions for business problems.
* Research and implement novel machine learning and statistical approaches.
* Mentor interns.
* Work closely with data & software engineering teams to build model implementations and integrate successful models and algorithms in production systems at very large scale.

**About The Team**
When a customer returns a package to Amazon, the request and package will be passed through our WWRR machine learning (ML) systems so that we could improve the customer experience, identify return root cause, optimize re-use, and evaluate the returned package. Our problems touch multiple modalities spanning from: textual, categorical, image, to speech data.
  
  
We operate at large scale and rely on state-of-the-art modeling techniques to power our ML models: XGBoost, BERT, Vision Transformers, Large Language Models.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience with SQL and an RDBMS (e.g., Oracle) or Data Warehouse

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing algorithms using both toolkits and self-developed code
* Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
  
  
We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
  
  
**Role description:**
Arcadis Development teams within our Intelligence division deliver complex solutions and push the limits of technology solutions. Our talented groups of systems professionals do more than just write code and debug – they make a significant impact on the design and development of state-of-the-art projects. We are looking for a Senior .NET Developer to join our growing and dynamic product team at Arcadis.
  
  
**Role accountabilities:**
**Design and Development:**
Work closely with product managers to align on product strategy, vision, and roadmap. Create detailed functional design documents, user stories, and technical specifications for feature development.
  
  
**Collaboration and Leadership:**
Engage in collaborative work with project managers, technical architects, solution architects, and the development team. Lead the technical aspects of projects, ensuring the optimal technical solution is delivered on time.
  
  
**Innovation and Problem Solving:**
Research and analyze business domains or problems. Gather functional requirements and contribute to the creation of innovative solutions that enhance user experience and meet project goals.
  
  
**Quality Assurance and Documentation:**
Support testing activities, including integration tests, and ensure documentation is comprehensive and clear, covering technical specifications, deployment plans, and user guides.
  
  
**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science with programming experience, or a degree in a related discipline
* 10+ years experience with .NET, C# and ASP.NET along with web development covering HTML, JavaScript, React/Typescript, CSS/SCSS, and Web debugging DevTools.
* Professional experience with Visual Studio Code, Visual Studio Professional and SQL Server Management Studio.
* Familiarity with React, Ionic, PWAs and Microsoft Reporting.
* Comfortable with working in a dynamic team environment and flexible with working across time zones.
* Proven experience in working with Offshore teams
* Should be able to lead, hire and mentor Junior Developers independently
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* A self-motivated, self-starter.
* Experience in Agile Product Development and SDLC.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills.
* A technical degree or equivalent professional qualification.

Why Arcadis?
  
  
We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
  
  
You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
  
  
Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
  
  
Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.
  
  
Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging
  
  
We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why equality and inclusion is at the forefront of all our activities. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer; women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. We are dedicated to a policy of non-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, caste, creed, colour, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, and gender identity.

title: Sr Engineer, IT Software - M365 [T500-30341]

title: Junior GPU Software Engineer
description:
**Junior GPU Software Engineer**

**Hyderabad, Telangana | On-site**

**Experience: 1–4 Years**

**About OXMIQ**

OXMIQ provides complete hardware and software GPU IP, so our customers can build their own AI silicon. Our OxCore architecture combines scalar, tensor and SIMT engines on one platform. It delivers CUDA compatibility alongside a flexible, fully programmable architecture. OxPython, our software stack, runs on top of it and lets CUDA-optimized models run unmodified on Oxmiq’s GPU IP, giving day-zero support for new AI models. We have an established software team and a working stack. We’re now moving from development to production delivery, hardening the platform and scaling it to meet real customer demands.

You’ll join the OXMIQ software team as an early-career engineer working on the GPU software stack. You’ll work closely with senior engineers and architects to build, test and optimize the kernels, runtime and enablement layers that bring high performance to our customers’ AI workloads.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, test and optimize GPU software within OxPython, the OXMIQ software stack, across the kernel, runtime and framework integration layers.
* Write and tune GPU kernels (CUDA, Triton-based and custom ops) for AI workloads such as GEMM, attention, convolution and memory-bound operators.
* Profile and benchmark workloads, identify performance bottlenecks and help close the gap to peak hardware utilization.
* Learn and apply SIMT and parallel compute concepts, including thread/warp scheduling, divergence, occupancy and efficient use of the memory hierarchy.
* Help enable new models, operators and customer workloads on Oxmiq GPU IP, including bring-up on pre-silicon and emulation platforms.
* Work with compiler engineers on how kernels are lowered and mapped onto Oxmiq hardware through MLIR/LLVM.
* Support software/hardware validation through test development, debugging and issue triage.
* Carry out root cause analysis for functional and performance issues in kernels and runtime code.
* Contribute to tooling, automation and documentation that make the stack easier to develop, test and ship.
* Take part in design and code reviews, and learn from senior engineers across the kernels, runtime and frameworks teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–4 years of experience in GPU, systems or performance-focused software, including internships, research or graduate project work.
* Strong fundamentals in C/C++ and systems programming.
* Hands-on experience with GPU programming, including CUDA, from coursework, research, internships or projects.
* Understanding of SIMT and parallel compute fundamentals: threads/warps, divergence, synchronization, occupancy and memory hierarchies.
* Interest in performance work, plus basic experience with profiling and optimizing code.
* Familiarity with computer architecture and operating systems concepts.
* Exposure to ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, ONNX) and how deep learning workloads run on GPUs.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, eagerness to learn, and a bias toward shipping. You prototype, measure and iterate quickly.

* **Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience writing or optimizing GPU kernels such as GEMM, convolution, reductions or attention.
* Exposure to Triton or similar high-level GPU kernel frameworks.
* Familiarity with compiler infrastructure such as LLVM or MLIR.
* Exposure to GPU profiling tools such as Nsight or similar.
* Experience with Claude Code or equivalent AI-assisted development workflows.
* Coursework, research or projects in parallel computing, GPU architecture, compilers or high-performance computing.
* Background in AI workloads and software stacks: LLM inference and training, attention and KV-cache optimization, distributed and multi-GPU execution, or serving frameworks such as vLLM and SGLang.
* Contributions to open-source GPU, compiler, runtime or ML-framework projects such as LLVM, MLIR, Triton or PyTorch.

**Education**

B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech/MS/Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

**Why OXMIQ**

You’ll join a fast-growing company with an established team and a proven stack, as we scale it into a production platform in customers’ hands. You’ll work directly with the people designing the hardware it runs on. This role suits an early-career engineer who wants to build deep GPU software skills, learn from experienced engineers and architects, and work across an entire SIMT compute platform rather than just one layer of it.

**Compensation & Benefits**

OXMIQ offers a competitive compensation package, including base salary, equity participation, comprehensive medical coverage, and the opportunity to contribute to foundational silicon and software technology.

***OXMIQ is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.***
