title: Software Engineer
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
  
  
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
**Want to be part of it?**
Role Summary
  
  
As a Software Engineer (IC2) at Keyloop, you will be a productive and increasingly independent member of an engineering team building the connected auto retail ecosystem. You will deliver medium-sized features with growing autonomy, write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code, and actively contribute to team culture and knowledge sharing. We are tech stack agnostic: we believe a strong engineer with solid fundamentals and AI-assisted tooling can thrive on any technology. This role is ideal for engineers who have moved beyond foundational learning and are ready to take ownership of meaningful deliverables within a collaborative, agile environment.
  
  
**Competency Expectations**
Aligned with the Keyloop Engineering Career Framework, this role is assessed across five core competency domains:
  
  
**Competency Domain**
**What We Expect**
**Technical Mastery & Innovation**
Demonstrates proficiency in the team's tech stack. Writes clean, maintainable, well-tested code with minimal guidance. Follows established patterns and contributes to code quality.
  
  
**Execution & Delivery**
Independently owns the delivery of medium-sized features. Accurately estimates tasks and provides reliable status updates. Manages own workload effectively within sprints.
  
  
**Leadership & Influence**
Is a positive influence on team culture. Onboards new team members. Begins to mentor interns or IC1 engineers, helping them ramp up and grow.
  
  
**Communication & Collaboration**
Clearly articulates technical concepts to peers. Writes clear and concise documentation. Participates actively in team discussions, code reviews, and design sessions.
  
  
**Product & Business Impact**
Understands the "why" behind their work, including the customer problem and business outcome. Connects technical decisions to user value and product goals.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain software features across the Keyloop platform with increasing independence
* Write clean, well-structured, and thoroughly tested code that meets team coding standards and best practices
* Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and incorporating feedback from peers
* Collaborate with Product, Design, and QA to translate requirements into technical solutions
* Contribute to sprint planning, estimation, and retrospectives within an Agile/Scrum framework
* Troubleshoot and resolve defects, contributing to the operational health of the team's systems
* Create and maintain technical documentation for features and components you own
* Onboard new team members and begin mentoring more junior engineers (IC1s, interns)
* Proactively identify and suggest improvements to code quality, tooling, and development processes
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, learning, and adapting to new technologies and codebases

**Technical Skills & Qualifications**
**Required:**

* .net AWS cloud .NET 8+, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API,Entity Framework
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and object-oriented/functional programming principles
* Proficiency in at least one programming language, with the ability and willingness to learn new languages and frameworks as needed
* Experience writing unit tests, integration tests, and practicing test-driven or test-informed development
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines
* Understanding of core software architecture concepts: APIs, services, databases, and modern application design
* Comfortable working in Agile/Scrum development environments
* Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate coding, debugging, and learning new technologies
* A tech stack agnostic mindset: we value engineers who can adapt to any technology with strong fundamentals and AI-assisted tooling

**Qualifications:**

* 4-6 years of professional software development experience

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience working across multiple programming languages or tech stacks
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containerization, or modern infrastructure concepts
* Experience with AI-driven development workflows, including prompt engineering for code generation and automated testing
* Experience in the automotive, DMS, or SaaS product domain
* Demonstrated ability to quickly ramp up on unfamiliar codebases or technologies using AI-assisted tools

**Soft Skills & Behaviours**

* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills in English
* A collaborative mindset with a positive attitude toward team culture and knowledge sharing
* Willingness to give and receive constructive feedback openly
* Curiosity and a strong desire to learn and grow technically
* Ability to manage own workload, estimate tasks accurately, and deliver reliably
* An understanding of the user/customer perspective when making technical decisions

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within the first 3 months, you are shipping features independently and contributing clean, well-tested code with minimal rework
* Within 6 months, you are accurately estimating your own work, reliably delivering within sprint commitments, and onboarding new team members
* Within 12 months, you are a trusted contributor who proactively improves code quality and team processes, and you are beginning to mentor IC1 engineers
* You consistently demonstrate the ability to pick up new technologies and codebases quickly, leveraging AI-assisted tools to accelerate your learning curve
* Your peers and manager see you as a positive influence on team culture, someone who collaborates openly and gives constructive feedback

**What Sets This Role Apart**

* Tech stack agnostic philosophy: you will not be boxed into a single language or framework. We invest in engineers who master fundamentals and adapt to any technology with AI-assisted tooling
* AI-first engineering culture: you will work within Keyloop's AI-Driven Development Program, using cutting-edge AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow, not as an afterthought
* A clear, transparent career framework with defined competency expectations and multi-track progression pathways (Technical, Leadership)
* Real product impact: you will contribute to the Fusion Automotive Retail Platform, connecting every phase of the vehicle lifecycle for dealers and consumers worldwide
* Continuous growth support through a Personal Development Plan (PDP), regular coaching, and access to the AI Champions enablement program
* A global, collaborative engineering community grounded in the values of Bold, Authentic, and United

**Our Guiding Principles**
**We are Bold:**
We challenge the status quo, explore new technologies, and champion high standards for quality.
  
  
**We are Authentic:**
We engage in open, honest, and respectful dialogue. We admit when we are wrong and are transparent about risks.
  
  
**We are United:**
We adopt a platform-first mentality, collaborate seamlessly across teams, and actively mentor others to elevate the entire team.
  
  
**Why join us?**
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space - and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
  
  
**An inclusive environment to thrive**
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles - not just on key days, but every day.
  
  
**Be rewarded for your efforts**
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
  
  
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
  
  
**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply**

Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

is a core technology function within CIBC Capital Markets, responsible for building and supporting mission critical platforms that enable Equities Trading, Prime Services, and Clearing operations. The team delivers scalable, resilient, and secure technology solutions across the trade lifecycle, including data movement and in house processing that supports downstream reporting, controls, and integrations. Solutions are designed to operate in a high throughput environment while meeting regulatory, operational, and audit requirements across global markets.

**JOB PURPOSE:**

Drives the overall software development lifecycle (SDLC) for in-house
**Python**
applications and services supporting
**Equities Trading, Prime Services, and Clearing**
. Works across functional teams to transform business requirements into production-ready features by translating user needs into technical specifications, preparing design artefacts, writing high-quality code, and leading testing, release, and ongoing maintenance. Supports system design decisions (including security requirements), debugs production systems and service applications, and applies strong knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and programming languages to build reliable, performant, and auditable solutions aligned to enterprise standards (tools, platforms, and patterns).

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

* Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and stakeholders to clarify requirements, define acceptance criteria, and translate business needs into technical designs and implementation tasks.
* Design and develop Python applications/services and data processing components, producing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code aligned with architecture patterns and technology standards.
* Create and maintain technical design artefacts and developer documentation (e.g., JIRA/Confluence) to support delivery, onboarding, and auditability.
* Implement and integrate with relational databases using SQL; ensure data quality, controls, and performance for end-to-end processing.
* Build automated tests (unit/integration/regression) and support quality activities to ensure production readiness.
* Ensure solutions meet non-functional requirements (security, logging, error handling, resiliency, and performance) and contribute to secure-by-design practices.
* Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback; continuously improve code quality, standards, and reusable components.
* Support CI/CD and deployment activities (including Azure environments where applicable); monitor and troubleshoot issues across development, test, and production.

As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines and controls.

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Leads in house Python application engineering that supports
  **Equities Trading, Prime Services, and Clearing**
  , with heavy
  **Oracle**
  dependency and scheduled/batch workloads.
* Accountable for reliable daily/weekly processing: batch schedules, SLAs, data correctness, and fast recovery when things break.
* Sets the modern delivery approach for the team by introducing
  **Agentic SDLC**
  practices, raising engineering standards, and coaching others while operating in a controlled, audit-friendly environment.

**Technical Skills:**

* **Mandatory Core Skills:**
  Hands-on experience with
  **Agentic AI**
  , end-to-end
  **SDLC**
  , AI-assisted development using
  **Copilot**
  ,
  **Linux**
  , and
  **RabbitMQ/Kafka/MQ**
  .
* **SQL Server — Mandatory:**
  In-depth expertise in T-SQL, complex queries, stored procedures, functions, views, indexing, query execution plans, performance tuning, transactions, data modelling, security, backup and recovery, and high-availability concepts.
* **Oracle — Mandatory:**
  In-depth expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, packages, procedures, functions, triggers, materialized views, partitioning, indexing, query optimization, execution plans, performance tuning, transactions, data modelling, and database troubleshooting.
* **Python — Mandatory:**
  Strong hands-on experience with core Python, object-oriented programming, data structures, exception handling, decorators, generators, context managers, memory management, clean code, packaging, performance optimization, and automated testing.
* Experience building scalable RESTful APIs and microservices using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Proficiency in data processing and manipulation using Pandas and NumPy, including validation, transformation, and optimization of large datasets.
* Hands-on experience with asynchronous programming, multithreading, multiprocessing, and performance profiling for high-throughput Python applications.
* Experience with Python dependency management, virtual environments, reusable modules, logging, configuration management, and secure coding practices.

  **Azure**

  **Visual Studio**
  ,
  **JIRA**
  , and
  **Confluence**
  .

  familiarity is a nice to have.

* Experience with testing practices (unit, integration, regression) and supporting releases/production issues (triage, diagnosis, and root-cause analysis).
* Experience with
  **Azure**
  services and modern integration patterns (web services, APIs) is an asset.

  **Oracle**
  databases (e.g., Oracle SQL/PL/SQL) analyzing data and writing complex procedures and materialized views.

This role operates within a normal office environment with little exposure to adverse working conditions.

title: Lead Software Engineer (C#/APL)
description:
**Lead Software Engineer (C#/APL) – Portfolio Analysis**
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
As our new Lead Software Engineer, you will join SimCorp’s Product Division, a full-scale agile organization. You will be working in an agile team of about 5-7 people. The team works on our SimCorp Dimension product. In your daily work you will – together with your team - understand and challenge customer requirements, discuss solutions, implement and test the chosen solution, and support it. We use a variety of tools, but the main ones are C#, APL and an Oracle database. You will mainly be working with backend and APIs.
  
  
The present and near future main topics are good maintainability, high system performance, continuous integration and delivery, and reshaping our product for the cloud.
  
  
In addition to implementing customer features, it is essential for us to continuously improve on all levels: company, division, product area, team, and individual. Your daily work life will thus also include topics such as “how can we reduce our build time”, “how can we rearchitect this component to perform significantly faster”, and “how can we work together in a more fun and effective way”.
  
  
We encourage your personal development, and you will be able to spend 20% of your time on experimenting with new technologies and implementing your ideas.
  
  
We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer to join an agile team in Portfolio Analytics Product Area.
  
  
We use a multitude of tools and technologies such as Visual Studio, C#, Dyalog APL, Azure DevOps within the areas of development and software configuration management.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
In your daily work, you will - together with your team
  
  

* Work with the product team to understand and refine client requirements
* Design and implement solutions that are scalable, secure and in line with the product architecture
* Contribute to continuous improvements to core engineering practices in the product area to ensure readable, secure, and testable code as well as effective ways of working
* Over time, become a recognized product expert in at least one domain of our product and have the curiosity to develop knowledge in more domains.

We expect you to be good at several of the following and are interested in learning the rest.
  
  

* Advanced C# skills and insight into the .NET framework
* Be able to learn additional technologies (like APL)
* Experience with developing and integrating middle and backend services and APIs
* You are interested and able to work within the architecture of an enterprise solution
* Actively work with improvements relating to tool stack and engineering practices (CI/CD pipelines, test-driven development, telemetry, etc)
* You have good English skills and thrive in an international work environment
* You have an M.Sc. in Computer Science or a similar field, or an equivalent level of experience
* Practical experience within financial instruments and financial investment systems is of course an advantage, but not a prerequisite for the job. It is more important that you take an interest in learning this field. We will bring you up to speed using technical and domain discussions, training, and a comprehensive onboarding program.

**What We Value**
Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest.
  
  

* Taking ownership and achieving results
* Trying new approaches to both new and old challenges
* Working with others to leverage the strengths of everyone in the team
* Learning new skills and improving upon existing ones
* Continually looking for ways to improve what we do and how we do it

**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose, you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and Innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
* Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**Who We Are**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Software Developer (Veeva Vault CRM / X-Pages)
description:
Acuitas is hiring a software developer with 1–2 years of hands-on coding experience to build custom applications and dashboards on Veeva Vault CRM (X-Pages) for life-sciences clients.

Job title- Software Developer (SDE) – Veeva Vault CRM / X-Pages

Alternate titles- Veeva Developer, Software Development Engineer – Veeva

Department- Product Development / Technology

Location- Hyderabad, India

Experience-1–2 years in software development

Education- B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA in Computer Science, IT or related field

Employment type- Full-time

About the role

This is a core software engineering role, not a configuration or admin role. You will write production JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML and CSS to build custom pages, dashboards and tools that run inside Veeva Vault CRM on browser, iPad and iPhone.

You will work with pharmaceutical commercial data — accounts, calls, territories, products — and turn business requirements into reliable, well-tested code. We are looking for strong programming fundamentals first; Veeva platform knowledge can be built on the job.

You will work closely with senior developers, Veeva CRM consultants and client stakeholders across the full software development lifecycle: requirements, design, development, testing, deployment and support.

Key responsibilities

**Development**

•      Design and build custom X-Pages (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript) using the Veeva JS library, including dashboards, pre-call planning views and field activity trackers.

•      Write clean, modular, maintainable code with proper error handling, input validation and performance in mind.

•      Query and combine CRM data (Accounts, Calls, Territories, Products and custom objects) and implement the business logic behind KPIs, aggregations, filters and date ranges.

•      Build pages that work reliably both online and offline on iPad/iPhone and in the browser.

•      Integrate with REST APIs and external data sources where required.

**Data and dashboard logic**

•      Understand CRM data models, object relationships and field-level data before building on them.

•      Translate business metrics (call activity, reach, frequency, execution) into correct calculations.

•      Reconcile dashboard numbers against source data or existing reports (e.g. Tableau, Power BI) and explain differences.

**Software lifecycle**

•      Participate in requirement discussions and break features into tasks with realistic estimates.

•      Use Git for version control, raise pull requests and take part in code reviews.

•      Write and run unit and integration tests; support UAT and production smoke testing.

•      Package and deploy X-Pages across sandbox, QA and production environments; validate behaviour in each.

•      Debug issues using browser DevTools (console, network, payloads) and fix root causes rather than symptoms.

•      Document technical design, deployment steps and known issues.

**Collaboration and quality**

•      Work with senior developers and Veeva consultants on architecture and design decisions.

•      Follow secure coding practices and handle client and commercial data in line with access-control and compliance requirements.

Required qualifications and skills

**Education and experience**

•      Bachelor's in Computer Science, IT or a related engineering field.

•      1–2 years of professional software development experience (internships with shipped code count).

**Programming fundamentals (must-have)**

•      Strong JavaScript (ES6+): async/await, promises, closures, array/object manipulation, modules.

•      Solid HTML5 and CSS3, including responsive layouts.

•      Strong problem-solving and programming logic: data structures, algorithms, debugging.

•      Working knowledge of REST APIs and JSON.

•      Good SQL fundamentals: joins, filtering, grouping, aggregations.

•      Git and a standard branching/pull-request workflow.

**Engineering practice**

•      Understanding of the software development lifecycle (Agile/Scrum preferred).

•      Habit of writing readable, tested code and following code review feedback.

•      Comfort with browser DevTools for debugging UI, network and data issues.

**Domain and platform awareness**

•      Basic understanding of CRM concepts: accounts, contacts, activities, objects, fields and relationships.

•      Exposure to Veeva CRM, Veeva Vault or Salesforce, or a clear willingness to learn them quickly.

•      Ability to understand the business logic behind a dashboard metric, not just display data.

**Soft skills**

•      Clear written and spoken English for working with distributed teams and clients.

•      Ownership, attention to detail and willingness to ask questions early.

Preferred Qualifications

•      Hands-on experience with Veeva Vault CRM X-Pages, Veeva CRM MyInsights, or X-Pages Studio.

•      Familiarity with VQL (Vault Query Language) or Salesforce SOQL, Apex or Lightning Web Components.

•      TypeScript and a modern front-end framework (React, Vue or similar).

•      Charting libraries (Chart.js, D3, ECharts) and dashboard design.

•      Node.js, build tooling (npm, Vite/Webpack) and basic CI/CD.

•      Exposure to Power BI, Tableau, Snowflake or Databricks.

•      Awareness of offline-first design for mobile/iPad apps.

•      Understanding of life-sciences/pharma commercial operations (field force, HCPs, territories).

•   
Awareness of data privacy and regulated environments (e.g. 21 CFR Part 11, GxP).

description:

At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

**BUSINESS UNIT DESCRIPTION:**

**Equities Market Technology**
is a core technology function within CIBC Capital Markets, responsible for building and supporting mission critical platforms that enable Equities Trading, Prime Services, and Clearing operations. The team delivers scalable, resilient, and secure technology solutions that support front office, middle office, and back office workflows, including trade capture, lifecycle processing, risk, reporting, and downstream integrations. Solutions are designed to operate in a high throughput, low latency environment while meeting regulatory, operational, and audit requirements across global markets.

**JOB PURPOSE:**

Designs, builds, and maintains
**Power BI**
reporting and analytics solutions that enable Operations and business teams to make data-driven decisions. Works with stakeholders to define requirements and KPIs, translates needs into curated datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and actionable insights, and contributes to the data foundation through
**SQL**
and
**Databricks**
(light-to-medium transformations and curated data layers) as needed. Ensures analytics assets are accurate, performant, well-governed, and easy to use.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

* Partner with Operations and business stakeholders to understand processes, KPIs, and reporting needs; translate requirements into user-friendly analytics solutions.
* Develop and maintain
  **Power BI**
  dashboards and reports with strong visual design, performance optimization, and clear storytelling for executive and operational audiences, including building reusable
  **measures**
  , KPI cards, and (where appropriate) leveraging
  **custom visuals/components**
  to improve usability.
* Build curated datasets and analytical models using
  **SQL**
  and
  **Databricks**
  (e.g., notebooks/ETL/ELT) to support trusted, reusable reporting and self-service analytics.
* Design semantic models in Power BI (data modeling, relationships, measures) and develop robust
  **DAX**
  calculations (measures, time intelligence, and reusable KPI logic) aligned to agreed KPI definitions.
* Implement data quality checks, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure accuracy and consistency across sources, models, and reports.
* Apply governance and security best practices (workspace/dataset access, row-level security where applicable), documentation, and change control for analytics products.
* Perform exploratory analysis to derive insights, identify trends/anomalies, and provide recommendations that improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.
* Enable self-service analytics by creating curated datasets, data dictionaries, and usage guidance; coach end users on interpreting dashboards and metrics.
* Identify creative ways to deliver insights (e.g., interactive storytelling, narrative summaries, alerts, and guided self-service) and support capability uplift by enabling business users on available analytics features (including
  **Databricks Genie**
  where applicable).
* Support production reporting by troubleshooting issues, performing root-cause analysis, and delivering enhancements with minimal disruption to stakeholders.

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* Partners with Operations and business teams to define KPIs, reporting requirements, and decision workflows.
* Collaborates with data engineering and platform teams to align on data sourcing, transformations, and modeling in SQL/Databricks environments.
* Works with technology, risk, and information security partners to ensure appropriate access controls, data handling, and compliance for analytics assets.
* Partners with product owners and project teams to prioritize analytics roadmaps and deliver incremental value.
* Engages with BI administrators/support teams for workspace management, deployments, and operational support.
* Coordinates with data owners and subject-matter experts to validate definitions, lineage, and data quality.

**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines and controls.

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Individual contributor role focused on delivering analytics products (datasets, dashboards, insights) that support operational and business decision-making.
* Works across multiple data domains and sources; responsible for shaping data into trusted, consumable models for reporting and self-service analysis.
* Acts as an advisor to stakeholders on KPI definition, data interpretation, and dashboard usage to improve adoption and outcomes.

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:**

**Technical Skills:**

**Mandatory Skills:**

* **Agentic AI integrated across the SDLC**
  , including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and implementation of AI agents and agent-driven workflows.
* Experience using
  **Copilot assistants**
  to improve development, analytics, automation, and user productivity.
* **Expert-level SQL and Power BI expertise is mandatory**
  , with demonstrated ownership of enterprise analytics solutions from source-data analysis and SQL transformation through semantic modeling, DAX development, dashboard delivery, deployment, governance, and production support.
* Advanced hands-on
  **SQL development**
  and
  **optimization**
  , including complex joins, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, stored procedures, views, indexing strategies, execution-plan analysis, query tuning, and troubleshooting performance across large, multi-source datasets.
* Advanced
  **Power BI solution development**
  , including star-schema and dimensional modeling, complex DAX and time intelligence, Power Query, reusable semantic models, row-level security, incremental refresh, dashboard performance optimization, workspace management, deployment pipelines, and governed self-service analytics.

**Additional Technical Skills:**

* Experience with
  **Python**
  (e.g.,
  **pandas**
  ) for analysis, automation, and data validation is expected.
* Experience with
  **Databricks**
  for data engineering/analytics (notebooks, transformations, orchestration patterns) and working with large datasets.
* Understanding of data governance fundamentals (data definitions, lineage, access controls, and privacy/security considerations).
* Familiarity with source control and release practices for analytics (e.g., Git), and documenting requirements, logic, and metric definitions.
* Experience with data visualization libraries/tools (e.g.,
  **Plotly**
  , Python visualization libraries) is a plus.

**Experience:**

* Minimum
  **4+ years**
  of experience in BI/data analytics and reporting in an enterprise environment.
* Proven experience delivering dashboards end-to-end: requirements, data sourcing, modeling, visualization, validation, and rollout/adoption.
* Experience partnering with Operations teams and/or working with regulated data and controls (financial services preferred) is a strong asset.

**Soft Skills:**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; able to translate complex data into clear
  **storytelling**
  , recommendations, and decision-ready insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Analytical and detail-oriented; comfortable working in ambiguity, prioritizing requests, and iterating quickly to improve dashboard usability, stakeholder adoption, and operational efficiency.

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

This role operates within a normal office environment with little exposure to adverse working conditions.

**Privacy:**

By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

title: Software Engineer ( Python + PySpark + Agentic AI ) - 5 + Years
description:
**Department:**
Development
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Description**
We are looking for an experienced Python + PySpark Developer with a strong background in designing, developing, and optimizing large-scale data processing solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, PySpark, SQL, and big data technologies. You will build the large-scale data pipelines and agentic AI features that power our platform on AWS. You will apply strong Python and PySpark skills to data processing on EMR on EKS, and build LLM-based agents that assist and automate work on our data under human oversight.
  
  
**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**

* Write and tune PySpark jobs on EMR (EMR on EKS) and Delta Lake to prepare and transform data at scale
* Design and build LLM-powered agents that plan tasks, call tools, and propose or apply actions against our services and data, under confidence thresholds and human-in-the-loop review
* Define the tools and APIs agents can use, and connect agents to internal systems (e.g., via Model Context Protocol)
* Build retrieval-augmented (RAG) pipelines: chunking, embeddings, vector search, and grounding responses in our data
* Design agent workflows with clear guardrails, confidence gating, human-in-the-loop exception handling, and fallback behavior
* Write prompts and evaluation harnesses; run evaluation in CI and measure agent quality, cost, and latency, then iterate
* Build and maintain Python services and shared libraries, and Kafka producers/consumers for moving data between services
* Serve agents behind APIs and monitor them with LLM/agent observability (quality, cost, latency, failures)
* Write design docs and collaborate with engineers and data scientists on architecture decisions
* Use AI coding agents in your own day-to-day workflow while owning correctness and quality

**Basic Qualifications**

* These are the core skills we screen for. A strong candidate has all three.
* Python 3 — solid experience writing production code, with strong fundamentals and readable, tested code, using a web framework such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django
* PySpark & SQL — hands-on experience writing and tuning Spark jobs on EMR (we run EMR on EKS), reading/writing Delta Lake tables, and strong SQL for large-scale data
* Agentic AI — hands-on experience building LLM or agent-based features: tool/function calling, multi-step agent workflows, RAG, and grounding output in real data.
* Experience writing production Python 3, including designing and optimizing large-scale data processing solutions
* Experience building services or APIs with a Python web framework such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django
* Hands-on experience with Spark / PySpark, ideally on EMR (EMR on EKS a plus)
* Strong SQL and familiarity with big data technologies
* Hands-on experience building LLM or agent-based features (tool calling, function calling, or multi-step agent workflows)
* Experience with an agent or LLM framework or platform such as Amazon Bedrock, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or the OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs
* Experience with RAG: embeddings, vector search, and grounding model output in real data
* Practical prompt engineering and experience evaluating LLM/agent output for quality and reliability
* Experience handling sensitive data and PII responsibly, including data-governance and privacy considerations when sending data to external LLMs
* Experience with at least one database (MongoDB/DocumentDB, PostgreSQL, or similar)
* Experience with AWS services such as S3 and EMR
* Experience writing tests with pytest (or similar) and working with Git
* Comfortable with Docker and Linux
* Practical experience using AI coding assistants or agents (e.g., Kiro, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) in real projects
* Strong communication: able to write design docs and collaborate across teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or wiring agents to external tools and data sources
* Experience keeping LLM systems reliable: guardrails, evaluation pipelines, cost/latency tuning, caching
* LLM/agent observability and lifecycle experience: prompt/version management, monitoring, and quality regression detection
* Solid ML fundamentals and quality metrics (precision, recall, F1); familiarity with scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy
* Delta Lake, AWS Glue, and Athena
* Kafka streaming pipelines
* Kubernetes / EKS, Helm, and GitOps deployment
* Experience in a polyglot microservice environment (Node.js / Python / Java)
* Awareness of bias and explainability in AI systems

* Apply statistical and machine learning techniques such as Linear/Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost/LightGBM, clustering, and time-series modeling.
* Perform feature engineering, feature selection, model tuning, validation, and performance analysis.
* Build reusable and scalable ML pipelines for real-world business applications.

Deep Learning
  
  

* Develop deep learning solutions using frameworks such as PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.
* Work with neural network architectures including CNNs, RNN/LSTMs, Transformers, and other modern deep learning architectures.
* Evaluate and optimize deep learning models for accuracy, latency, and scalability.

Generative AI & LLMs
  
  

* Design and develop GenAI applications leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Build solutions using techniques such as

+ Prompt engineering
+ Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
+ Embeddings and vector search
+ LLM orchestration
+ Function/tool calling
+ AI agents and multi-step workflows
+ Fine-tuning / parameter-efficient fine-tuning where appropriate

* Work with structured and unstructured enterprise data to create domain-specific GenAI applications.
* Develop evaluation frameworks for LLM applications covering response quality, hallucination, groundedness, relevance, latency, and cost.
* Implement appropriate guardrails and responsible AI practices for production GenAI solutions.

Computer Vision
  
  

* Develop and deploy computer vision solutions for use cases such as

+ Image classification
+ Object detection
+ Image segmentation
+ OCR and document/image understanding
+ Visual inspection and defect detection
+ Product/image recognition

* Work with modern computer vision architectures and pretrained/foundation models.
* Experience with OpenCV, YOLO, CNNs, Vision Transformers, or multimodal models is desirable.

Supply Chain & Operations Analytics
  
  
Develop AI/ML solutions addressing supply-chain and operational problems such as
  
  

* Demand forecasting
* Sales forecasting
* Inventory optimization
* Stock-out / overstock prediction
* Replenishment recommendations
* Lead-time prediction
* Supply and demand imbalance detection
* Logistics and transportation analytics
* ETA prediction
* Warehouse analytics
* Supplier performance and risk analytics
* Product allocation and assortment optimization
* Anomaly detection
* Scenario planning and decision-support solutions

The candidate should be able to work closely with supply-chain stakeholders to convert business requirements into analytical and AI/ML solutions.
  
  
Model Deployment & MLOps
  
  

* Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy ML and GenAI solutions into production.
* Develop APIs, batch pipelines, or real-time inference services for model consumption.
* Apply good software engineering practices including modular development, version control, testing, documentation, and code reviews.
* Understand concepts such as model monitoring, drift detection, model versioning, experimentation, and retraining.
* Experience with Docker, CI/CD, MLflow, Kubernetes, or similar MLOps technologies is desirable.

**Required Technical Skills**
**Programming**

* Strong Python programming skills
* SQL and data manipulation
* Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn

**Machine Learning**

* Scikit-learn
* XGBoost / LightGBM or equivalent
* Statistical modeling
* Time-series forecasting
* Feature engineering and model evaluation

**Deep Learning**

* PyTorch and/or TensorFlow
* Transformers
* CNNs and modern neural-network architectures

**Generative AI**

* LLMs and foundation models
* RAG
* Prompt engineering
* Embeddings
* Vector databases
* LLM evaluation
* Agentic AI concepts
* Frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent

**Computer Vision**

* OpenCV
* Object detection / segmentation models
* CNNs / Vision Transformers
* OCR and image-processing techniques

**Data & Cloud**

* Experience working with large datasets and cloud-based data platforms.
* Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Familiarity with Databricks, Spark, Snowflake, or similar platforms is an advantage.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Approximately 4–7 years of relevant industry experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI.
* Strong hands-on experience developing end-to-end ML solutions.
* Practical experience with at least one of Generative AI, Computer Vision, or advanced Deep Learning, with willingness and ability to work across all areas.
* Experience solving supply-chain, retail, manufacturing, logistics, or operations-related problems is strongly preferred.
* Experience taking ML models beyond proof-of-concept into production or business adoption.

What We Are Looking For
  
  
The successful candidate will demonstrate
  
  

* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Solid understanding of ML fundamentals rather than reliance solely on pre-built GenAI APIs.
* Ability to select the right approach across statistical methods, traditional ML, deep learning, computer vision, and GenAI based on the business problem.
* Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong experimentation mindset with an ability to measure business and model impact.
* Curiosity to continuously learn and apply emerging AI technologies.
* Ability to independently own moderately complex projects while collaborating effectively with senior data scientists, engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Experience**

* Experience with retail, consumer products, manufacturing, or supply-chain domains.
* Experience building production-grade RAG or enterprise GenAI applications.
* Exposure to multimodal AI combining text, image, and structured data.
* Experience with optimization / operations research techniques.
* Experience with forecasting at scale across products, locations, or customers.
* Knowledge of responsible AI, explainability, privacy, and AI governance.
* Experience working in Agile product or AI development teams.

Amazon's Finance Technology organization (FinTech) is responsible for building and maintaining the critical finance technology applications that enable new business growth, ensure compliance with financial and tax reporting obligations, and provide deep analysis of Amazon's financial data. This function is of paramount importance to the company, as it underpins Amazon's ability to effectively manage its finances and drive continued expansion.
  
  
At the heart of FinTech's mission is the General Ledger team, which builds and operates the technologies to account for and post millions of financial transactions daily to support accurate internal and external financial reporting. This team processes on average 371MM+ transactions per month, servicing the accounting needs of Finance, Accounting, and Tax teams worldwide. The work of the General ledger team is absolutely essential to meeting Amazon's critical close timelines and maintaining the integrity of the company's financial data.
  
  
Amazon Financial Technology Team is looking for a results-oriented, driven software development engineer, who can help us create the next generation of distributed, scalable financial systems. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys the challenge of highly complex business contexts that are typically being defined in real-time. We need someone to design and develop services that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to be part of a mission-critical initiative with significant organizational visibility and impact.

You will be challenged to tackle complex problems related to data processing, queuing, and real-time analytics.

You will also be working directly with multiple Principal Engineers and presenting your work to Senior Principal Engineers. Help drive the architecture and technology choices for FinTech accounting products.
  
  
Design, develop and deploy medium to large software solutions for Amazon accounting needs.
  
  
Raise the bar on code quality, including security, readability, consistency, maintainability.

At the heart of FinTech's mission is the General Ledger team, which builds and operates the technologies to account for and post millions of financial transactions daily to support accurate internal and external financial reporting. This team processes on average 371MM+ transactions per month, servicing the accounting needs of Finance, Accounting, and Tax teams worldwide. The work of the General ledger team is absolutely essential to meeting Amazon's critical close timelines and maintaining the integrity of the company's financial data.

* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience

description:
**About Us**
DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.
  
  
There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join our Post Trade Engineering team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of our brokerage systems. You will work closely with our engineering team and other stakeholders to create scalable, low-latency, and highly available trading systems.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the technical architecture, design, and delivery of high-performance, low-latency brokerage systems using Java
* Assess the health and performance of software applications and databases, and provide software and technology solutions
* Design, develop, and maintain REST APIs and microservices
* Work with the Broker Dealer Operations teams to support and enhance the trading and back-end systems for multiple asset classes, such as equities, options, and mutual funds
* Define specifications, develop components, modify the existing software stack, prepare test data, and prepare functional specifications
* Analyze service and application performance using various programming languages, tools, and techniques
* Develop and maintain automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines
* Support applications with an understanding of system integration, test planning, scripting, and troubleshooting

**You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience
* At least 5 years of experience in Software Engineering with expertise in Java
* Understanding of Test-Driven Development and how to write effective unit and integration tests
* Strong understanding of CI/CD and automated testing frameworks
* Proficient in developing and maintaining robust REST APIs and implementing sophisticated event-driven architectures using Kafka, deployed on Kubernetes
* Background in financial technology or capital markets is required
* Proficient in NoSQL, SQL, and stored procedures, such as in PostgreSQL and MySQL
* Experience with Unix/Linux operating systems (writing scripts to extract and transform data)
* Knowledge of Jira, Git, and Jenkins
* Experience with a 24/7, highly available architecture
* Strong experience with Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure
* Experience with Scrum and other Agile processes
* Strong communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

**Special Knowledge (Nice To Have, But Not Required)**

* Multiple years of experience in fintech, specifically Post Trade, Payments, or SaaS

**Location**
This role is open to candidates in the following locations:
**Hyderabad, IN**

* This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
* If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.

**Working at DriveWealth**
We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.
  
  
To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.
  
  
**Work Authorization**
Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.
  
  
For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.
  
  
**How We Think About AI**
We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.
  
  
**Compensation**
Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience. If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

* Proactively identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and scalability risks, and drive initiatives to resolve them before they impact the business.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

Job Summary

* Basic understanding or experience with cloud platforms, preferably Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure (IaaS/PaaS).
* Understanding of no-schema (NoSQL) databases and local mobile data persistence.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Basic understanding of iOS development (Swift, Objective-C, XCTest) is a strong plus to help collaborate on cross-platform mobile initiatives.
* Working experience with Mobile Device Management (MDM) or Mobile Application Management (MAM) policies.
* Experience or interest in full-stack web development, Windows programming, or kernel-mode development.
* Exposure to global security compliance and privacy frameworks (e.g., GDPR, SOX, PII, and PHI data handling).
* Experience working in a fast-paced Agile/Scrum environment across geographically distributed teams.

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Software Engineer II
description:

This role is suited for an engineer who can independently deliver well-designed solutions, collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, and troubleshoot complex functional and performance issues in enterprise application environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise web applications and backend services using C#, ASP.NET, .NET Framework, and .NET 6 or later.

* Develop reliable, maintainable, and secure code that aligns with engineering standards, coding guidelines, and architectural direction.
* Work with SQL Server to design, optimize, and troubleshoot queries, stored procedures, data access logic, and database interactions.
* Debug and resolve functional issues across application, service, database, and deployment layers.
* Analyze and troubleshoot performance issues, including application latency, resource utilization, database performance, and scalability bottlenecks.
* Participate actively in Agile Scrum ceremonies, including planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups.
* Collaborate with QA, DevOps, product owners, architects, and other engineering teams to deliver high-quality product features and fixes.
* Contribute to unit testing, integration testing, code reviews, CI/CD readiness, and release validation activities.
* Support production deployments and assist in diagnosing issues reported from test, staging, or production environments.
* Create and maintain technical documentation for designs, implementation details, troubleshooting steps, and operational support needs.

**Primary Technology Stack**
C#, ASP.NET, .NET Framework, .NET 6 or later, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure App Service, SQL Server, REST APIs, cloud application development, debugging, performance troubleshooting, and secure software development practices.
  
  
**Secondary Technology Stack**
Angular or other modern web UI frameworks, Docker, Helm, CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, logging and monitoring tools, distributed application troubleshooting, and basic infrastructure or cloud operations knowledge.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 3–6 years of professional software development experience using the Microsoft technology stack.
* Strong hands-on experience with C#, ASP.NET, .NET Framework, and .NET 6 or later.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities into large-scale enterprise applications, including AI-assisted diagnostics, log analysis, intelligent automation, recommendation systems, or operational copilots.
* Experience building agentic AI solutions or multi-agent workflows.
* Experience implementing RAG solutions using vector databases and enterprise content sources.
* Knowledge of AI observability, evaluation, and governance practices.
* Experience building, deploying, or supporting applications on Azure App Service and Azure Kubernetes Service.
* Good understanding of RESTful APIs, backend services, web application architecture, and object-oriented design principles.
* Strong understanding of SQL Server, including database design fundamentals, query development, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Proven ability to debug functional defects and investigate issues across application code, service boundaries, configuration, and database layers.
* Experience troubleshooting performance issues using logs, traces, metrics, profiling tools, query analysis, and other diagnostic techniques.
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices and working knowledge of deployment pipelines in enterprise environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with Docker, Helm, Kubernetes manifests, or GitOps-style deployment models.
* Exposure to observability tools such as Application Insights, Open Telemetry, dashboards, centralized logging, or distributed tracing.
* Experience modernizing legacy ASP.NET or .NET Framework applications to .NET 6 or later.
* Working knowledge of Azure SQL, SQL Managed Instance, or cloud-hosted database environments.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, GitHub, or similar engineering collaboration tools.
* Exposure to financial services, self-service banking, ATM, or enterprise transaction processing domains.

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.
  
  
**EEO Statement**

title: Sr. CRM Developer
description:
***I. Role Overview***

The Salesforce Developer is a hands-on build role in A360's Managed Services practice, focused on insurance and financial services clients. This person delivers both declarative and custom solutions across Flow, Apex, and Lightning Web Components, tests their own work including regression testing, and uses AI agents and skills to accelerate development inside Salesforce. They work closely with the Technical Lead, Consultants, and the PC/BA/QA team throughout the life of an engagement.

***II. About You***

You understand financial services, particularly insurance, and you know when a request calls for declarative configuration versus custom development. You have a testing mindset, including regression testing, and you take pride in shipping work that doesn't break what already exists. You use agents and skills as part of how you work, and you verify what they produce. You're comfortable looping in the Technical Lead when a build gets complex, and you do well in collaborative, knowledge-sharing teams.

**What success looks like**

* Clean, on-time delivery of assigned builds with low rework
* Reliable regression coverage, so releases don't break existing functionality
* Sound declarative-versus-custom design choices for insurance and financial services workflows
* Effective use of AI to shorten build and test cycles without sacrificing quality

**Required qualifications**

**Technical expertise**

* Working knowledge of financial services, particularly insurance (for example policy administration, claims, underwriting, or agency and broker processes)
* 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce development, including custom work in Apex, Lightning Web Components, and other advanced platform features
* Strong declarative skills: Flow, validation rules, permission and security model, and data model design
* Background in software testing, including regression testing, with the ability to build test coverage for your own work
* Hands-on experience with real-time Salesforce deployments is required. Familiarity with Gearset is an added advantage.
* Should have experience working in an Agile environment and be familiar with sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and sprint reviews.

***Certifications & education***

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I (PD1) is required
* Claude Foundations Architect (highly recommended)
* Platform Developer II (optional)

***Specialized knowledge***

* Experience using agents and skills to augment development inside Salesforce, including checking their output before it ships
* Judgment on when a request needs custom development versus declarative configuration, and when to loop in the Technical Lead for validation on complex builds
* Preferred: Financial Services Cloud or insurance data model experience, test automation tools for Salesforce, and integration experience (REST/SOAP APIs, middleware)

***Soft skills & experience***

* Clear written and verbal communication, including short technical write-ups for the Technical Lead
* Proven ability to work in collaborative teams that drive knowledge sharing
* Experience with professional consulting or managed services organizations preferred
* Availability to work US Eastern Standard Time hours

***Growth Path***

Developers progress from Developer to Developer II to Senior Developer. Developers who show strong client-facing aptitude can opt in to the Consultant (technical track) branch and carry their technical seniority with them.

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We help to redefine lending practices, uncover and prevent fraud, simplify healthcare, create marketing solutions, and gain deeper insights into the automotive market, all using our unique combination of data, analytics and software. We also assist millions of people to realize their financial goals and help them save time and money. We invest in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. As a FTSE 100 Index company listed on the London Stock Exchange (EXPN), we have a team of 25,200 people across 32 countries. Our corporate headquarters are in Dublin, Ireland. Learn more at experianplc.com.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are looking for an enthusiastic Test Engineer to work at the forefront of our cloud modernisation, within our Credit & Verification Services. This is a hybrid role requiring travelling to Hyderabad office circa 40% days per month.
  
  
**Role Context**
We're predominantly a .NET focused engineering team, building modern, cloud-native applications using the latest in .NET 8+. All new services are developed with a forward-looking mindset, and we actively evaluate emerging features and tools to continuously improve our engineering practices.
  
  
Our architecture is built on Kubernetes (EKS), enabling us to run scalable, resilient microservices in the cloud. On top of this, we leverage a wide range of AWS services (Lambda, Kinesis, Dynamo and RDS to name just a few), to enhance performance, observability, and integration across our platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and execute manual and automated test scripts based on business requirements.
* Develop, maintain, and enhance automation frameworks for UI, API, and backend testing.
* Create and maintain test data, test environments, and automation scripts.
* Perform various types of testing: White Box testing, Black Box testing, Integration testing,UI testing, API Testing

**Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in a quality engineering, software testing, or test automation.
* Experience with SDLC, STLC, and Agile/Scrum processes.
* You will work collaboratively in cross-functional teams.
* Passion for quality, learning new technologies, and continuous improvement.
* Hands-on experience with UI, API automation tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, REST-assured or Postman.
* Proficiency in Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD) approaches.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data validation.
* Experience in at least one programming/scripting language: Java, Scala, Python, or JavaScript.
* Basic understanding of Containers (Docker) and CI/CD processes.
* Experience with version control systems like Git, Bitbucket, GitHub or Gitlab.
* Working knowledge of API testing, backend validations, and functional automation.
* You will report to manager.

**Additional Information**
Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first approach is award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site to understand why.
  
  
Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Innovation is an important part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, colour, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.
  
  
**Recruitment Fraud Awareness**
- Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.
  
  
**Benefits**
Experian care for employee's work life balance, health, safety and wellbeing. In support of this endeavor, we offer best-in-class family well-being benefits, enhanced medical benefits and paid time off.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
• SAI & HAL Development: Design, implement, and extend the Switch Abstraction Interface (SAI) and Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) to expose hardware capabilities to the SONiC control plane (Syncd, Orchagent).

• ASIC SDK Integration: Act as the primary software expert for integrating, upgrading, and troubleshooting silicon vendor SDKs (e.g., Broadcom SDKLT/OFA, Marvell, etc.) into our networking software stack.

• Feature Enablement: Implement advanced forwarding and hardware-accelerated network features (such as L2/L3 routing, ACLs, QoS, VxLAN, and telemetry) at the driver and abstraction layers.

• Performance Optimization: Profile and debug silicon-level software issues, resolving complex pipeline bottlenecks, packet drops, and memory leaks between the SDK and system software.

• Community Co-existence: Collaborate with the open-source SONiC community and semiconductor vendors to upstream extensions, implement new SAI APIs, and resolve architectural issues.

• Cross-Functional Execution: Work closely with on-site hardware engineering, platform validation, and QA teams in San Jose to bring up new hardware platforms from scratch.

Required Qualifications & Criteria

• ASIC SDK Experience: 6+ years of experience working directly with low-level networking ASIC SDKs (e.g., Broadcom, Marvell/Cavium, Barefoot/Intel).

• SAI & HAL Mastery: Proven, hands-on experience developing or extending the Switch Abstraction Interface (SAI) or custom Hardware Abstraction Layers (HAL).

• Advanced Systems Programming: Expert-level proficiency in C and C++ within a Linux development environment.

• Network OS Architecture: Deep understanding of data-plane forwarding architectures, open networking software, and specifically how SONiC/SAI architectures manage underlying silicon states.

• Low-Level Debugging: Mastery of debugging tools such as GDB, Valgrind, Wireshark, and hardware network testers (e.g., Ixia, Spirent).

• L2/L3 Networking Protocols: Strong conceptual and implementation knowledge of switching/routing mechanics (BGP, ECMP, EVPN, VLANs, LACP).

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

• Direct experience with the inner workings of SONiC daemons like syncd, orchagent, and Redis database states.

• Experience with Linux kernel network stack development or custom kernel drivers.

• Active contribution or working knowledge within open hardware/software forums (OCP, Linux Foundation).

**Senior Software Engineer**
to join our
**Hyderabad (Hybrid - 3 days from the office)**
team. In this role, you’ll help us improve code structure and architecture while leading team project planning to maximise efficiency and reliability across our production systems.

* Strong Engineering Principles: Deep pride in writing readable, well-designed, and well-tested software.
* Backend Expertise: Significant experience building web-based applications (we use Go, Ruby/Rails, Python, Scala, and Rust).
* Data Proficiency: Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and "NoSQL" backends like Redis, DynamoDB, or ElasticSearch.

Why Join Us?
  
  
At Deliveroo, You’ll Do Work That Matters—solving Real-world Problems In a Three-sided Marketplace That’s Constantly Evolving. Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
  
  
🌱

🧠
**Grow through challenge and ownership**
Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
  
  
🌎

High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.
  
  
💰
**Share in the success you help create**

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.
  
  
We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
