title: Sr Software Engineer Syseng
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
  
  
Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are seeking experienced
**Site Reliability Engineers (SREs)**
to build and operate an
**AI driven observability and reliability platform**
for enterprise-scale environments. This team will be responsible for
**monitoring LPL environments using Dynatrace**
, building
**intelligent agents**
that analyze logs, metrics, and traces,
**generating automated alerts based on dynamic thresholds**
, and implementing
**self healing recovery mechanisms**
to reduce MTTR and prevent outages.
  
  
This role blends
**SRE, platform engineering, and applied AI/ML**
, with a strong focus on
**automation, resilience, and operational excellence**
.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Observability & Monitoring**

* Design, implement, and operate enterprise observability solutions using Dynatrace, including logs, metrics, traces, and RUM.
* Define golden signals, SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets for critical applications and infrastructure.
* Create dynamic and adaptive alerting strategies to reduce noise and improve signal quality.
* Partner with application teams to embed reliability and observability standards into services from design through production.

**AI Agents & Intelligent Automation**

* Build and deploy AI/ML-powered agents that analyze:
* Dynatrace logs and metrics
* Historical incident data
* Behavioral and anomaly patterns
* Implement predictive monitoring and anomaly detection using statistical models or ML techniques.
* Automate alert triage, correlation, and root cause analysis (RCA) using AI-driven approaches.
* Continuously improve models based on operational feedback and outcomes.

**Self-Healing & Recovery**

* Design and implement self-healing systems that automatically:
* Restart or rescale services
* Redirect traffic
* Roll back failed deployments
* Trigger remediation workflows
* Integrate automated recovery actions with CI/CD pipelines, runbooks, and orchestration tools.
* Ensure recovery mechanisms are safe, auditable, and compliant with enterprise governance.

**Reliability Engineering & Operations**

* Lead incident response, post-incident reviews, and root cause analysis.
* Establish runbooks, automated remediation playbooks, and operational standards.
* Drive reductions in MTTR, incident frequency, and operational toil.
* Participate in on-call rotations and help build a sustainable on-call culture.

**Platform, Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Work with cloud and onprem infrastructure teams to improve reliability at scale.
* Build automation using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
* Ensure systems meet security, compliance, and resiliency requirements expected in financial or regulated environments.

**What are we looking for?**
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates
**pursue greatness**
,
**act with integrity**
, and are
**driven to help our clients succeed**
. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we
**win together**
and
**create and share joy**
in our work.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
**Core SRE & Platform Skills**

* 4+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Production Operations
* Strong experience designing and operating highly available, distributed systems
* Hands-on expertise with:
* Monitoring and observability platforms (strong preference for Dynatrace)
* Linux-based systems and networking fundamentals
* Deep understanding of SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, and reliability trade-offs

**Automation & Programming**

* Proficiency in at least one programming language such as:
* Python, Go, Java, or similar
* Strong scripting experience (Python, Bash, etc.) for automation and tooling
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar)

**AI / ML & Intelligent Systems**

* Experience building or integrating AI/ML models for operational use cases, such as:
* Anomaly detection
* Log analytics
* Predictive alerts
* Familiarity with:
* ML pipelines, feature extraction, and model lifecycle management
* Rule-based + ML hybrid approaches for production systems
* Experience integrating AI workflows into monitoring and alerting platforms is highly valued.

**Cloud, Containers & CI/CD**

* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Strong knowledge of:
* Kubernetes and container orchestration
* CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation
* Understanding of scalable architecture patterns and failure modes in cloud-native systems.

**Core Competencies**

* Ability to adapt, learn new technologies, develop new processes, and improve procedures.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to communicate and respond to communication effectively with client, associates, and stakeholders.
* Ability to perform problem-solving, use logic and creative thought processes to resolve complex technical problems.
* Ability to take responsibility for monitoring LPL environments using Dynatrace, building intelligent agents.
* Able to focus on automation, resilience, and operational excellence.

* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates

* Expertise in Docker containerization and Kubernetes (EKS, AKS) for deploying and scaling applications.
* Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, CosmosDB
* Additional Tools: Redis (caching), Elasticsearch (search), Kafka (eventing)
* Production-ready experience with monitoring, logging, and ensuring security in distributed systems.
* Tools: Logging/monitoring platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch.
* Excellent communicator who translates product/customer needs into robust technical solutions.
* Leverages AI tools to boost team productivity — uses AI-assisted development and automation to create multiplier effects across the org.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience.
* Strong skills in communicating with different roles in a scrum team.
* Strong knowledge and working experience in object-oriented programming

* Solve complex technical problems: Analyze user and product requirements, investigate technical challenges, and develop robust, maintainable solutions for complex engineering workflows.

* Support product adoption: Contribute to technical documentation, user tutorials, and other technical content that helps customers and internal users effectively utilize HMCFD capabilities.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong hands-on programming experience in C/C++, with the ability to develop maintainable and production-quality software.
* Proficiency in Python and/or Tcl scripting for automation, customization, and engineering workflows.
* Experience developing GUI-based applications, with a good understanding of user interface design and software interaction patterns.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex requirements and translate them into practical software solutions.

* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and common CFD workflows.
* Experience with Simcenter HyperWorks or other CAE/engineering software.
* Experience with CAD modeling or visualization software.
* Knowledge of Finite Element Method (FEM) and structural analysis.
* Experience developing software for engineering, scientific, simulation, or visualization applications.
* Familiarity with scripting-driven engineering workflows and application customization.

title: Software Engineer - Agent Development
description:
**Summary**
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.
  
  
Join us, the team that serves as Apple’s nerve center: Apple Information Systems and Technology group! We are looking for Software QE Engineers, who will work closely with other Software Engineers, Project & Product Managers, Product Designers, and other internal & external partners.
  
  
There are countless ways you can contribute here, from working on apple.com to software for digital & physical Apple Stores, from software for Apple Care to Apple-wide systems for identity, operations, recruiting, and people management, from software for Apple data centers to Apple-wide data processing & AI/ML systems.
  
  
Apple's IS&T team builds the tools, platforms, and services that power the people who build Apple. Our Customer Systems group is reimagining how Apple engineers work through intelligent, autonomous systems — and we're looking for an Agentic AI Developer to help lead that effort.
  
  
**Description**
We are looking for a talented Agentic AI Developer to join Apple's IS&T Customer Systems team. In this role, you will design, build, and operate intelligent autonomous agent systems end-to-end — both client-side and server-side. You will architect agents that reason, plan, remember, and act reliably across long-running workflows, with deep attention to memory design, multi-agent orchestration, observability, and maintainability.
  
  
This is a deeply technical engineering role with a high bar for production quality. You will own the full lifecycle of agentic systems: from agent architecture and memory design, to tool integration, observability, and safe deployment. While the primary focus is agent engineering, a solid understanding of the Java tech stack, React, and TypeScript is also important, as you will work across both server-side and client-side surfaces.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and platform teams across Apple to bring AI capabilities into the developer tools our teams depend on every day.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement multi-agent orchestration systems — including agent collaboration, task delegation, hand-offs, shared context management, role specialisation, and conflict resolution patterns
* Build agent memory architectures — episodic, semantic, and working memory — using vector stores (pgvector, Milvus) and hybrid retrieval strategies to enable agents to reason over past interactions and maintain state across sessions
* Develop tool and function-calling layers that expose internal APIs and services as agent-executable tools via MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or custom tool registries, with strong contracts and well-defined failure semantics
* Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines with vector stores and hybrid retrieval strategies to ground agent responses in authoritative internal knowledge
* Own the observability story for agentic systems — distributed tracing of agent runs, prompt and response capture, token and cost accounting, evaluation pipelines, replay and debugging, and regression detection using OpenTelemetry and LLM observability tooling
* Drive maintainability of agentic systems through versioning of prompts, tools, and agent graphs; deterministic test harnesses; evaluation suites; safe canary rollouts; and structured logging that makes non-deterministic behaviour debuggable
* Apply agent safety guardrails — input validation, prompt-injection defences, output schema contracts, and sandboxed code execution — to ensure systems are safe and reliable at production scale
* Architect and maintain server-side agent services using Java (Spring Boot, Spring AI) and client-side agent interfaces using React and TypeScript

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML systems, LLM integrations, or autonomous agent development
* Hands-on experience designing and implementing multi-agent orchestration systems and agent loop patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, or similar)
* Strong proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and TypeScript/React for building full-stack agentic applications
* Solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: prompt engineering, context window management, function calling, structured outputs, and tool use
* Experience building RAG pipelines and working with vector databases .
* Demonstrated ability to implement agent safety guardrails including prompt-injection defences and output schema enforcement
* Experience with observability tooling (OpenTelemetry or equivalent) applied to distributed, AI-driven systems
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field .

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing or consuming MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and clients
* Familiarity with model routing and fallback strategies across multiple LLM providers
* Reactive programming in Java — Project Reactor, WebFlux — for streaming LLM responses
* Python proficiency for agent prototyping and evaluation pipeline scripting
* Hands-on experience with cloud AI platforms .
* Experience with agent sandboxing and safe code execution environments
* Awareness of fine-tuning, LoRA, and small-model distillation techniques for agent specialisation

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.
  
  
Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

title: Builder Developer III
description:
**The Builder-3 Profile**
You are a systems engineer for non-deterministic systems. You are comfortable saying "no, not yet" to a working demo, and you can say exactly what would change your mind.
  
  

* Core DNA (shared foundation, at lead altitude)
* AI-Native Workflow. You don't just use AI tools fast — you set the squad's bar for what "fast and safe" looks like, and you remove the bottleneck when someone hits one.
* Agentic Architecture. You still build end-to-end agents yourself, and you do. But your leverage comes from designing the state management, tool interfaces and failure semantics that everyone else builds inside.
* Legacy-to-Modern Sequencing. You decide which legacy modules get modernized first, based on blast radius, data gravity and how cheaply success can be measured — not on which one looks most fun.
* Measured Reliability. You define what "reliable enough" means for each workflow: acceptance thresholds, regression suites, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, rollback paths. You know that "100% accurate" is a marketing phrase, and that the engineering version is a measured error rate with a defined containment strategy.
* The Three Things You Own
* The Guardrail Layer Input and output validation, tool-permission scoping, financial and PII data handling, sandboxed execution, human approval gates on irreversible actions, kill switches, blast-radius containment. You assume the agent will eventually do the wrong thing, and you design so that it costs us a log line instead of a General Ledger.
* The Eval Framework Golden datasets built from real ERP edge cases. Offline evals in CI as a merge gate, online evals in production. LLM-as-judge calibrated against human labels — and you know when that calibration has drifted. Regression detection when a model version, prompt or retrieval index changes underneath you. You move the squad from "prompt vibes" to a number that can fail a build.
* The Cost & Performance Envelope Model routing, caching, context budgeting, latency budgets. You track token cost per completed business transaction, not per call, and you can tell the CFO why a workflow costs what it costs and where the next 40% comes from.
* Elective Depth (be deep in one, fluent in all six)
* Agentic Architect (Systems) — state management and tool-calling interfaces for long-running business processes across complex ERP schemas.
* UX/Interaction (Product) — generative UIs and browser-use agents; designing where the human stays in the loop and where they don't need to be.
* Data & Context (Data) — RAG and knowledge-graph architecture: vector stores, chunking strategy, retrieval evals, and the relationship between a Purchase Order and a GL entry.
* Reliability & Eval (QA) — programmatic prompt optimization (DSPy), red-teaming agents, adversarial testing of financial logic.
* Infra & Agent-Ops (DevOps) — the factory where agents live: tracing, logging and monitoring the "thoughts" of the AI; deployment and rollback of prompts and models as versioned artifacts.
* Domain Logic Translation (Business) — turning 50 pages of accounting regulation into structured system prompts and agentic constraints.

**What You'll Actually Do**

* Set the definition of shippable. Write the standard for when an agent can touch production data, and enforce it in code, not in a wiki page.
* Build the eval harness and wire it into CI as a gate that can and does block merges.
* Design the guardrails around regulated and financial logic, including the human approval and rollback paths.
* Run design reviews. Kill bad agent architectures in week one instead of month four. Be specific about why.
* Own agent incidents. Pull the traces, find the root cause, and add the eval that makes that failure impossible to reintroduce.
* Make build-vs-buy calls on frameworks, vendors and models — and revisit them when the ground shifts, which it will.
* Grow Builder 1s and 2s through code review, design review and pairing. Not through ceremony.

**What Good Looks Like**
*(Targets to be agreed with the hiring manager — these are illustrative, not fixed.)*

* 90 days: Eval harness running in CI on at least two live agentic workflows, with a published reliability baseline. A written, enforced guardrail standard.
* 6 months: Every production agent has a regression suite, a cost-per-transaction number, and a rollback path. Agent-related incidents are down and post-incident evals exist for each.
* 12 months: The squad ships agentic modules on a predictable cadence without you in the critical path of each one.

**The Stack**
Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, pgvector/Qdrant, LangChain/LangGraph, DSPy, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Weights & Biases, OpenTelemetry — plus the orchestration layer you'll live in: eval and tracing platforms (LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust or equivalent), policy and guardrail tooling, model routing and caching. And any other tool that helps us achieve greatness.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* You've been burned. You have shipped an agentic system to real users, watched it fail in a way you didn't predict, and changed your architecture because of it. This is the single strongest signal for this level.
* Rigor over hype. You love new models and you still ask for the eval numbers first. You know the difference between a cool demo and a production-grade agent handling financial data.
* Agent-first thinker. You think in capabilities and failure modes, not functions.
* The manual-task hater. If you do a task twice, you've already started drafting the workflow that kills it.
* Technically fearless. A 500-table undocumented legacy schema is a puzzle, not a threat.
* A multiplier. Your best week is one where the squad shipped three things and you wrote one design doc and two brutal, useful reviews.

**Why Join Us**

* The Final Boss of complexity. ERPs are the hardest problem in software for AI. Automate a General Ledger and you've mastered the game.
* Agentic autonomy. We don't do tickets. We do missions. You choose the models, frameworks and architectures you believe will win.
* No red tape. If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. No Change Management Committee — a "Does It Work?" policy. Note that you are the person who defines what "works" means.
* The Builder Tribe. You will not be the only AI person in the room. You'll lead a squad of people as obsessed with moving 10x faster as you are.

title: Builder Developer II
description:
**Job Description**
**The Builder-2 (Dev) Profile**
You are a full-stack agent engineer. You can take a complex business requirement and build the multi-step AI workflow that solves it, end to end, without someone breaking it down for you first.
  
  

* Core DNA
* AI-Native Workflow. You use AI to accelerate development, testing and documentation as a default, not an experiment. You have opinions about which tools earn their place.
* Agentic Implementation. You build, debug and deploy autonomous agents (LangGraph, AutoGen, Playwright-LLM hybrids) that navigate complex ERP schemas and long-running business logic.
* Legacy-to-Modern Bridge. You treat 20-year-old systems as puzzles for AI-driven modernization, not as someone else’s problem.
* Evidence Over Confidence. You don’t ship an agent because the demo went well. You ship it because you can show what it does on the edge cases — and you know your own error rate rather than claiming there isn’t one.
* What You Own

**Your agent.**
Design, build, debug, deploy, and keep running. Including the unglamorous parts: retries, state recovery, timeouts, what happens when the model is down.
  
  
**The evidence it works.**
Before you refactor an undocumented module, you capture what it currently does — characterization tests, real inputs, real outputs. After, you show the behaviour matches. Your Builder 3 sets the standard; meeting it is your job, not theirs.
  
  
**Your blast radius.**
You know exactly what your agent is permitted to touch, and you build so a wrong answer costs a review comment rather than a bad ledger entry.
  
  

* Your Elective Specialty (lean into one)
* The Agentic Architect (Systems) — you don’t just build APIs, you build tool-calling interfaces and state management for agentic graphs that survive long-running business processes.
* The UX/Interaction Builder (Product) — the chatbox is just the beginning. You build generative UIs and browser-use agents that navigate existing portals to get work done.
* The Data & Context Engineer (Data) — master of the RAG pipeline. Vector stores, chunking strategy, and knowledge graphs that teach the AI how a Purchase Order relates to a GL entry.
* The Reliability & Eval Engineer (QA) — you move the team from prompt vibes to prompt engineering. DSPy for programmatic optimization, red-teaming agents to pressure-test financial logic.
* The Infra & Agent-Ops Builder (DevOps) — you build the factory where agents live: tracing, logging and monitoring the thoughts of the AI.
* The Domain Logic Translator (Business) — you take 50 pages of accounting regulation and turn it into structured system prompts and agentic constraints.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

* Build execution agents. Move beyond RAG into action — agents that navigate an ERP schema, find a data discrepancy and propose the fix.
* Automate the untestable. Wrap legacy business logic in modern tests and documentation using AI, starting with the modules everyone else has avoided.
* Prove parity. Capture what the old code does before you replace it, and show the new path matches — on the boring cases and the fiscal-calendar, multi-currency, partial-shipment ones.
* Prompt engineering and evals. Use frameworks like DSPy to move from vibes-based prompting to programmatic, optimized instructions.
* Rapid prototyping. Turn a “what if” into a working AI-driven feature in days, not months.
* Fix your own agents in production. Read the traces, find why it went sideways, make it not happen again.

**What Good Looks Like**
*(Illustrative — real targets agreed with the hiring manager.)*

* 30 days: Shipped your first agentic workflow into a real environment, however small.
* 90 days: Owning a legacy module end to end — parity evidence, tests, deployment — with minimal supervision.
* 6 months: Other Builders are reusing patterns you built. You’re the person people ask about one thing in particular.

**The Stack**
Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, agentic coding tools, LangChain/LangGraph, DSPy, pgvector/Qdrant, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Playwright, Weights & Biases, OpenTelemetry, eval and tracing platforms (LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust or equivalent). And any other tool that helps us achieve greatness.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* You’ve shipped one. You have built at least one autonomous agent or complex LLM workflow that real people used for real work — not a weekend demo. You know how it failed, because it did.
* The early adopter. You were using GPT-3 before it was cool and had a local model running the week it leaked. More time on r/LocalLLaMA, GitHub Trending and AI Twitter than on LinkedIn.
* Agent-first thinker. You think in capabilities and failure modes, not functions.
* The manual-task hater. You have a physical reaction to repetitive work. If you do it twice, you’ve already started drafting the automation.
* Technically fearless. A 500-table undocumented legacy schema isn’t complexity, it’s a puzzle about to get solved. You aren’t intimidated by spaghetti code — you’re the one who brings the sauce.
* Rigor over hype. You love the new models and you still ask for the numbers. You know the difference between a cool demo and a production-grade agent handling financial data.

**Why Join Us**

* The Final Boss of complexity. ERPs are the ultimate challenge for AI. Automate a General Ledger or a global supply chain and you’ve mastered the hardest problem in software.
* Agentic autonomy. We don’t do tickets. We do missions. You’ll have real freedom over the models, frameworks and agent architectures you think will win.
* No red tape. If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. No Change Management Committee — a “Does It Work?” policy.
* The Builder Tribe. You won’t be the only AI person in the room. You’ll be part of a small squad of people equally obsessed with moving faster, where your automation hacks are your biggest contribution rather than a hidden side project.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

insightsoftware is looking for a technically sharp, people-first Engineering Lead to lead our Financial Reporting team — a squad at the center of our most complex and high-stakes enterprise workloads. This is not a process-management role. We want a hands-on technical leader who codes when it counts, drives architecture decisions with conviction, and knows how to get the best out of engineers in an AI-accelerated development environment.

You'll lead a team building and maintaining mission-critical reports and dashboards that serve Fortune 500 financial enterprises. You think in systems, not just features. You hold the bar high on code quality, design integrity, and delivery discipline — and you coach your team to do the same.

If you've led high-performing backend engineering teams, are fluent in modern AI developer tooling, and thrive at the intersection of technical depth and people leadership — this role is built for you.

**The differentiator we're hiring for:**
This is not a role for someone who has moved away from the database. We need an architect-level Oracle SQL/PL-SQL practitioner who leads by example — writing and reviewing the hardest queries on the team, not just approving other people's designs.

**Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of Reporting and BI features: from technical design through sprint execution to production — with full accountability for quality and timelines
* Drive architectural decisions for scalable, high-performance dashboards using Oracle, BI Tools, Azure and .NET/C#— creating PoCs, reviewing PRs, and actively contributing code where it matters
* Champion AI-first development practices across the team — mandating and coaching effective use of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent AI coding tools as a standard part of the engineering workflow, not an optional extra
* Shape the technical roadmap in partnership with Product — ensuring long-term architectural health is never traded away for short-term velocity
* Run high-quality 1:1s, performance reviews, and growth conversations that move the needle on individual development and team retention
* Enforce engineering standards: code quality gates, branch policies, code freeze discipline, and release management protocols — with zero ambiguity
* Lead code reviews and architecture discussions as a teacher and a critic — raising the technical floor of every engineer on the team
* Translate complex data reporting requirements into clean, maintainable, production-ready software
* Partner with cross-functional teams — Product, QA, DevOps, and Customer Success — to deliver releases that enterprise clients can depend on

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent demonstrated engineering depth
* 10+ years of hands-on experience in designing and developing enterprise SaaS applications on the backend with deep understanding of Databases
* 2+ years of engineering team management with a proven record of growing senior engineers and retaining high performers
* Architect/Principal engineer level deep expertise in relational databases
  **- Oracle PL/SQL**
  — complex query optimization, stored procedures, performance tuning, and large-scale data handling
* Very strong command of SQL and data modelling
* Experience in
  **Reporting/BI**
  on Development side (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik etc.)
* Demonstrated, day-to-day use of AI developer tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) with the ability to coach teams on maximizing their impact
* Experience in building and consuming RESTful APIs using .Net/C# in distributed, enterprise-scale systems
* Solid grounding in Agile/Scrum delivery — sprint discipline, backlog ownership, and release management rigor
* Strong proficiency with Git, branching strategies, and CI/CD practices
* Experience in financial domain applications — FinTech or equity management — is a significant plus
* Experience with Azure Cloud will be a plus
* Exceptional written and verbal communication — you can explain a complex database design to a product manager and a deployment risk to an engineering Director with equal clarity

title: Staff Software Engineer, Shop (eCommerce)
description:
**About Crunchyroll**
Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
  
  
Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!
  
  
**About The Role**
In the role of
**Staff Software Engineer, Shop (eCommerce)**
, you will report to the Fan Experiences Engineering Organization.
  
  
We are considering applicants for the location of Hyderabad, India.
  
  
Crunchyroll is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our India Engineering Center and help build the next generation of our member-focused eCommerce platform.
  
  
The eCommerce platform is designed to create an exclusive experience for Crunchyroll members, including access to unique products and limited drops. An integral part of the member experience, the platform must be designed to deliver high-quality features, operate reliably at scale, and delight our fans.
  
  
As a Staff Software Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across the Shop team, helping define the architecture, engineering strategy, and execution approach for critical eCommerce capabilities. You will remain hands-on while operating with a broad perspective: solving complex technical problems, shaping durable platform investments, raising engineering standards, and enabling other engineers to deliver with confidence.
  
  
You will work closely with Engineering Managers, Product, Program Management, and other Engineering verticals to align on requirements, priorities, technical trade-offs, and dependencies. You will help turn ambiguous problems into clear technical direction and scalable solutions, while ensuring that features are delivered with strong operational ownership.
  
  
This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who can connect customer and business outcomes to pragmatic technical decisions, influence across team and organizational boundaries, and establish patterns that improve the quality, reliability, and velocity of the Shop platform.
  
  
**About You**
We get excited about candidates, like you, because...
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience building and operating cloud-native software, distributed systems, or consumer-facing platforms.
* Demonstrated experience providing staff-level technical leadership across multiple engineers, teams, or services.
* Experience defining and evolving technical strategy and architecture for platforms with meaningful scale, reliability, security, and customer impact.
* Experience with SaaS-based eCommerce platforms, with Salesforce Commerce Cloud preferred.
* Strong experience with backend services, APIs, microservices, databases, distributed systems, and modern cloud infrastructure.
* Hands-on knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and the practices required to build scalable, reliable, and secure systems, particularly infrastructure related to consumer-facing services.
* Experience designing systems for transactional correctness, data integrity, observability, and operational resilience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, evaluate trade-offs, and define pragmatic technical solutions.
* A track record of mentoring engineers, influencing technical decisions, and improving engineering practices across team boundaries.
* You excel in an agile and collaborative environment, where your insights and expertise will help create technical solutions loved by our fans.
* Excellent verbal, written communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

**About The Team**
The eCommerce team is building and operating a member-focused commerce platform that creates new ways for Crunchyroll fans to engage with the brand. The platform supports differentiated shopping experiences, unique products, and exclusive drops while connecting to broader Crunchyroll capabilities such as membership, identity, payments, entitlements, and customer operations.
  
  
This role is an opportunity to shape both the platform and the organization behind it: setting a durable technical direction, developing people, raising the bar for engineering excellence, and helping establish eCommerce as a trusted part of the Crunchyroll member experience.
  
  
Why you will love working at Crunchyroll
  
  
In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:
  
  

* Best-in class medical, dental, and vision private insurance healthcare coverage
* Access to counseling & mental health sessions 24/7 through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Free premium access to Crunchyroll
* Professional Development
* Company's Paid Parental Leave
* up to 26 weeks for birthing parents
* up to 12 weeks for non-birthing parents
* Hybrid Work Schedule
* Paid Time Off
* Flex Time Off
* 5 Yasumi Days
* Half-Day Fridays during the summer
* Winter Break

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value
  
  

* Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.
* Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.
* Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.
* Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion
  
  
Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

title: Software Development Engineer (SDE) - RunCode
description:
**About The Role**
At RunCode, we are building the next generation of connected mobility platforms that power corporate fleet sharing and digital vehicle management.
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer (SDE), you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining a telematics-integrated corporate car-sharing platform. You will work closely with clients and cross-functional product teams to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and efficient distributed systems.
  
  
This role is ideal for engineers who thrive in building IoT-driven systems, microservice architectures, and data-intensive applications that deliver real-time intelligence to enterprise users.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Build and optimize RESTful and event-driven APIs using Node.js and TypeScript.
* Design and manage PostgreSQL databases, implement schemas with Sequelize ORM, and integrate caching and messaging layers using Redis and NATS.
* Collaborate with frontend engineers to seamlessly integrate APIs into a Next.js-based web platform, ensuring rich user experiences.
* Implement robust monitoring and tracing solutions using Grafana, Jaeger, Prometheus, and Node-RED for system health and diagnostics.

Core Skills & Technologies
  
  

* Languages & Frameworks: Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, MoleculerJS, Next.js
* Databases & Messaging: PostgreSQL, Sequelize ORM, Redis, NATS
* IoT & Telematics: Telematics APIs, IoT data ingestion and processing
* DevOps Tools: Docker, Traefik, Grafana, Prometheus, Jaeger
* Monitoring & Debugging: Node-RED, distributed tracing, metrics-driven optimization

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven experience designing and scaling microservices or distributed systems.
* Strong understanding of real-time data pipelines, message queues, and container orchestration.

What Makes This Role Exciting
  
  

* Work at the intersection of IoT, telematics, and mobility-as-a-service (MaaS).
* Contribute to a core enterprise product impacting global fleet operations.
* High degree of autonomy and ownership — from architecture to deployment.
* Be part of an innovative, growth-stage company shaping the future of connected mobility.

**Skills And Attributes**

* Good communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Developer Productivity and Reliability Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Location: Hyderabad
  
  
**Experience**
BS and 5-8 years
  
  
MS and 3-6 years
  
  
PhD and 0-3 years
  
  
Primary Areas: Developer Productivity, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Automation, Reliability Engineering, Test Automation
  
  
Primary Stack: Azure, Terraform, Docker, Azure DevOps, Python, Go, Playwright, Angular/TypeScript, MySQL/PostgreSQL, Redis
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a hands-on Developer Productivity and Reliability Engineer to build the internal engineering platform, automation, and quality systems that enable teams to deliver software quickly, safely, and reliably.
  
  
The role will own reusable infrastructure patterns, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, environment provisioning, deployment workflows, observability, and developer self-service capabilities across our Python/Django, Go, and Angular/TypeScript applications running on Azure.
  
  
The engineer will help establish a modern platform-engineering model based on automation, Infrastructure as Code, measurable reliability, reusable golden paths, and fast developer feedback. This role will work closely with engineering, QA, architecture, security, and product teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Developer Productivity and Internal Platforms**

* Build and operate reusable developer workflows that simplify build, test, deploy, troubleshoot, and release activities.
* Create self-service workflows for project setup, environment provisioning, database initialization, test execution, deployment, and diagnostics.
* Develop reusable repository templates, pipeline templates, Terraform modules, container templates, and engineering tooling.
* Establish "golden paths" for common application types and deployment scenarios.
* Improve local development environments using consistent tooling, containers, service emulators, and documented workflows.
* Reduce developer cognitive load by standardizing common infrastructure, deployment, testing, and observability patterns.
* Provide clear feedback through pipeline reports, deployment status, test evidence, quality dashboards, and actionable failure diagnostics.

**Infrastructure as Code and Cloud Automation**

* Design and maintain Azure infrastructure through Terraform and version-controlled Infrastructure as Code.
* Build reusable, composable, and versioned Terraform modules for application, networking, identity, storage, databases, monitoring, and security services.
* Automate infrastructure validation, policy checks, drift detection, security scanning, and controlled promotion across environments.
* Implement environment provisioning and teardown workflows, including short-lived or ephemeral environments where appropriate.
* Automate application deployments using Docker and Azure services such as Container Apps, Functions, storage, networking, identity, and monitoring.
* Establish safe deployment patterns, including blue-green or canary releases, health checks, automated rollback, and progressive delivery.
* Manage configuration and secrets securely using appropriate Azure services such as Key Vault and managed identities.
* Improve infrastructure consistency across development, test, staging, and production environments.

**Reliability Engineering**

* Define and implement service-level indicators, service-level objectives, and reliability dashboards for critical applications and delivery systems.
* Establish production-readiness standards covering availability, performance, scalability, resilience, observability, backup, recovery, and operational ownership.
* Instrument applications, pipelines, infrastructure, and deployment workflows with logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and diagnostic context.
* Analyze incidents, recurring failures, deployment problems, flaky tests, and operational toil; drive permanent corrective actions.
* Support incident response, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and reliability improvement plans.
* Improve mean time to detect, mean time to recover, deployment success rate, and change failure rate.
* Introduce resilience and failure testing for important services and infrastructure.
* Automate health checks, smoke tests, rollback decisions, and post-deployment verification.

**CI/CD and Release Engineering**

* Design and optimize Azure DevOps pipelines for fast, reliable, repeatable builds and releases.
* Implement pipeline stages for validation, compilation, unit testing, API testing, security scanning, container image creation, infrastructure validation, deployment, and post-deployment verification.
* Use dependency and build caching, parallel execution, selective test execution, and incremental pipelines to reduce feedback time.
* Establish quality gates based on test results, coverage, security findings, code quality, infrastructure validation, and release risk.
* Support Git-based development workflows, pull-request validation, branch policies, artifact versioning, and release traceability.
* Automate release evidence, test reports, deployment records, and compliance-related documentation.

**Test Automation and Quality Engineering**

* Define a layered testing strategy across unit, integration, API, contract, component, and end-to-end testing.
* Build and maintain Playwright-based UI and regression suites with traceability, screenshots, videos, logs, and failure diagnostics.
* Improve test reliability through deterministic test data, service virtualization, isolation, parallelization, and environment management.
* Automate test data creation and cleanup for MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, and dependent services.
* Reduce flaky tests and ensure failures are classified as product defects, test defects, infrastructure issues, or environmental issues.
* Partner with engineering and QA teams to make applications easier to test and operate.
* Explore AI-assisted test generation, test maintenance, failure triage, and coverage analysis with appropriate human review.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Graduate with 5-8 years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, CI/CD, test automation, or developer-productivity engineering.
* Strong experience building internal developer platforms, delivery automation, or reusable engineering tooling.
* Advanced hands-on experience with Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, workspaces or equivalent environment strategies, policy validation, and infrastructure testing.
* Strong Azure experience with services such as Container Apps, Functions, storage, networking, identity, Key Vault, monitoring, and managed databases.
* Strong experience designing Azure DevOps pipelines and Git-based delivery workflows.
* Practical experience with Docker, container image lifecycle management, registries, health checks, and deployment automation.
* Strong understanding of SRE concepts, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, observability, incident response, resilience, and operational readiness.
* Hands-on automated testing experience with Playwright or a comparable framework across API and end-to-end layers.
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python and/or Go.
* Working knowledge of Python/Django, Go services, and Angular/TypeScript applications.
* Experience with MySQL/PostgreSQL and Redis for test data, environment setup, integration testing, and operational diagnostics.
* Experience implementing quality gates, security scanning, dependency checks, artifact promotion, and release traceability.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex failures across application code, pipelines, infrastructure, networking, and cloud services.

**Preferred Skills**

* Kubernetes, Helm, or other container orchestration platforms.
* GitOps and declarative deployment tools.
* OpenTelemetry and modern observability platforms.
* Performance, load, stress, and resilience testing.
* Ephemeral environments and preview deployments for pull requests.
* Backstage or similar internal developer portals.
* Policy as Code using tools such as Open Policy Agent, Checkov, or tfsec.
* Security engineering integrated into CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.
* AI-assisted development, test generation, failure triage, or agent-based engineering workflows.
* Experience defining developer-platform adoption metrics and engineering effectiveness metrics.
* Experience working in regulated or enterprise software environments.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong ownership of developer experience, platform reliability, and delivery outcomes.
* Clear communication and the ability to explain infrastructure and reliability concepts to application teams.
* Pragmatic approach to automation, balancing standardization with team flexibility.
* Bias for measurement, simplification, and continuous improvement.
* Strong troubleshooting and systems-thinking abilities.
* Ability to influence engineering practices without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Willingness to remain hands-on with code, infrastructure, pipelines, and production issues.

**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent practical experience with a strong record in platform engineering, automation, reliability, or developer productivity may also be considered.

**SUGGESTED SUCCESS MEASURES**

* Reduced CI/CD pipeline duration and time to meaningful developer feedback.
* Increased deployment frequency and deployment success rate.
* Reduced change failure rate and mean time to recovery.
* Increased adoption of reusable Terraform modules, pipeline templates, and golden paths.
* Reduced environment provisioning time.
* Reduced flaky-test rate and test-maintenance effort.
* Improved SLO compliance and production observability coverage.
* Reduced manual release, environment, and operational effort.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
  
  
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.

As a Senior AI Native Engineer (IC3) at Keyloop, you will be a technical leader within your team, owning complex, multi-sprint projects and setting the standard for engineering quality. You will design and implement robust, scalable solutions, mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and be a key driver of team culture and process improvements. This role is for engineers who combine deep technical expertise with strong ownership, collaboration, and the ability to influence technical direction at the team level.
  
  
**Competency Expectations**
Competency Expectations
  
  
Aligned with the Keyloop Engineering Career Framework, this role is assessed across five core competency domains:
  
  
**Competency Domain**
**What We Expect**
**Technical Mastery & Innovation**
Designs and implements robust, scalable solutions for complex, team-sized projects. Is a recognized technical expert within the team. Drives architectural decisions and champions engineering best practices.

Owns the delivery of large, complex, multi-sprint projects. Is accountable for the operational health of the team's systems. Proactively identifies and mitigates technical risks.

Consistently mentors and coaches IC1s and IC2s. Is a key driver of team culture and process improvements. Builds consensus around technical decisions and influences team direction.

Communicates complex technical ideas effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Facilitates technical discussions, design reviews, and cross-functional alignment.
  
  
**Product & Business Impact**
Deeply understands the team's product domain and user needs. Actively participates in product planning, shaping technical approaches based on business context and customer value.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Skills & Qualifications**
**Required:**

* .net AWS cloud .NET 8+, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API,Entity Framework
* Deep software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, design patterns, system design, and distributed systems principles
* Strong proficiency in at least one programming language, with a proven track record of picking up new languages, frameworks, and paradigms quickly
* Proven ability to design and implement scalable, maintainable, and well-tested software systems regardless of the underlying tech stack

We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Senior EDI Architect to join our team.
  
  
In this role, you will be the primary technical authority for our Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) strategy and infrastructure. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing robust data exchange solutions that connect Creation Technologies with our global customer and vendor base. This role requires a deep technical mastery of EDI platforms, specifically Oracle and Cleo, alongside a strong understanding of supply chain business processes. The successful candidate will lead the architectural vision for our B2B integrations, ensuring scalability, security, and seamless data flow across our enterprise ecosystem.
  
  
This is a full-time role, reporting to the IT Applications manager or higher.

* Lead the development of comprehensive test plans and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for all new partner integrations or system upgrades.
* Provide Tier 3 technical support for EDI failures and mentor junior analysts/developers on EDI best practices and standards.

**Personal Characteristics**

* Exceptional ability to troubleshoot complex integration failures and design long-term architectural fixes rather than temporary patches.
* Advanced ability to translate technical EDI concepts into business language for stakeholders and executives.
* Proven track record of building trusting relationships with cross-functional teams, including Supply Chain, Finance, and IT.
* Ability to work with a high degree of accuracy, specifically regarding data mapping and compliance with global messaging standards.
* Self-motivated individual who thrives on autonomy and takes ownership of the entire B2B integration lifecycle.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced EMS environment with shifting priorities and diverse customer requirements.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience in related field.
* 5+ years of experience in EDI architecture and development.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Oracle EDI/E-Business Suite and Cleo (CIC) is preferred.
* Deep knowledge of EDI standards (ANSI X12, EDIFACT) and communication protocols (AS2, FTP/S, API).
* Prior experience in the EMS (Electronics Manufacturing Services) or High-Tech Manufacturing industry is a must.
* Strong grasp of supply chain business processes, including Demand Planning, Manufacturing Operations, and Intercompany transactions.
* Familiarity with SQL, XML, and JSON; experience with ERP-integrated EDI is essential.
* Understanding of secure data transmission standards and B2B security best practices.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Unified Auth SDK
description:
**Description**
UnifiedAuth is the authentication and authorization backbone for Amazon's service ecosystem. We secure service-to-service communication, ensuring that every call between Amazon services is authenticated and authorized against the right identity and policy. As Amazon's systems evolve toward autonomous agents, we provide agentic authentication and authorization — establishing verifiable identity and scoped, policy-governed access for AI agents acting on behalf of users and services. We also own transaction token management, issuing, propagating, and validating the tokens that carry identity and authorization context across multi-hop request chains. Together, these capabilities let Amazon's services trust who is calling them, what those callers are permitted to do, and on whose behalf they act — protecting customer data and maintaining the integrity of every transaction across the fleet.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate components of our authentication SDKs and supporting services. You will own features end-to-end: design through production operations across Java, Python, NodeJS, and Rust client libraries. You will collaborate with security teams, service owners, and business teams to close authentication gaps at scale.
  
  
This role suits an engineer who wants to own ambiguous, high-impact problems in a domain where correctness and availability are non-negotiable.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and deliver features across Security SDKs, owning them from design document through production launch.
* Improve the static stability of authentication — ensure services continue operating through service outages via persistent caching, eager token refresh, and bounce-safe recovery.
* Build and maintain telemetry and compliance mechanisms that measure token propagation and detect gaps across the fleet.
* Diagnose and resolve production issues as part of the on-call rotation, and drive root-cause analysis and corrections for operational events.
* Own pipeline and release health for SDK components — keep pipelines fresh, unblock releases, and reduce time-to-deploy.
* Write clear design documents and participate in Operational Readiness Reviews (ORRs) and security reviews.
* Mentor SDE1s and interns; raise the technical bar through code reviews and design feedback.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

**About The Job**
Systems Development Engineering (SDE) at Google is a role where you manage services and systems at scale. SDEs creatively put their engineering discipline to use automating the mundane and reducing toil. We don’t just write code to fix bugs, but emphasize the development of tools and solutions that fix classes of problems. We know it’s hard to control what you can’t measure – so we focus on observability: instrumenting first, then turning data into knowledge, and finally knowledge into action. We know that the operational efficiency of Google systems, services, virtual compute environments and the operating systems that power them impact the environment, not just the bottom line. We know that working together we can do more, and that community matters.
  
  
Google brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.
  
  
Together we engineer and build the infrastructure, tools, access and telemetry for systems that enable orchestration of Google-scale services. Come build things that matter.

title: Sr. Alteryx Developer 5+yrs (Hyderabad)
description:
**Senior Alteryx Developer 5+yrs**

**Preferably Bangalore & Hyderabad location.**

**Full time permanent position with Vivid Edge Corp.**

We are seeking a Senior Alteryx Developer with deep specialization in Data Preparation and Wrangling to architect, clean, standardise, and enrich high-volume datasets across our enterprise data ecosystem. In this role, you will be the core technical authority responsible for turning messy, fragmented, and unstructured raw data into clean, highly structured, and business-ready data assets.

You will design production-grade data preparation workflows using Alteryx Designer, leverage In-Database techniques for massive scale, enforce data quality and governance standards, and feed pristine datasets downstream to BI platforms, machine learning models, and executive reporting systems.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Data Preparation & Cleansing

Design, build, and optimize enterprise-level Alteryx workflows dedicated to heavy data profiling, cleansing, deduplication, blending, and schema normalization from disparate, messy sources.

Standardize data inputs across structured (SQL, Snowflake), semi-structured (JSON, XML), and unstructured formats (PDFs, log files, multi-tab Excel sheets, web scrapes).

Implement advanced string manipulation, regex patterns, fuzzy matching, and parsing logic to resolve data discrepancies and unify identity records across platforms.

Architect automated data quality auditing frameworks within workflows to detect, isolate, and log missing values, schema drifts, outliers, and corrupted records before downstream consumption.

Enterprise Pipeline Development & Scalability

Build high-performance ETL/ELT data preparation pipelines utilizing Alteryx In-Database (In-Db) processing and SQL pushdown execution to process multi-terabyte datasets efficiently.

Develop reusable Batch, Iterative, and Standard Macros to standardize recurring data prep tasks (e.g., date standardization, currency conversion, schema mapping, dynamic multi-file ingestion).

Build robust error-handling, automated alerts, and logging protocols to ensure zero data loss and seamless pipeline recovery during failure events.

Manage workflow deployment, scheduling, credentials, and data connection pooling on Alteryx Server (Gallery).

Required Technical Skills

As a Lead Engineer – Embedded SW Development (LPB2), you will be a technical cornerstone in the development and evolution of the MarkVIe control platform. * Validation & Integration: Integrate new product designs and collaborate with firmware test teams to develop, perform, and oversee formal design verification and validation (V&V) plans.
* Quality Assurance: Lead high-quality technical reviews, including detailed design, source code, unit test frameworks, and requirement documentation.

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

+ Advanced C/C++ programming skills.
+ In-depth understanding of microprocessor architectures.
+ Hands-on experience with preemptive, multitasking Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS), with a strong preference for QNX.

* Methodologies: Proven experience in Agile development environments and automated unit testing for C/C++.
* Toolsets: Proficiency in software configuration management tools, defect tracking systems, and peer-review processes.

* Domain Expertise: Direct experience with MarkVIe control systems firmware development.

* Initiative: A self-starter mindset with the ability to navigate complex, cross-functional technical challenges autonomously.

description:

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing…**
As a Principal Engineer (Agentic & Applied AI), you will serve as a technical leader and individual performer, architecting and driving end-to-end solutions for complex AI and Agentic use cases across multiple concurrent projects. You will be hands-on in design and coding, while leading project pods with one or two junior engineers or data scientists.
  
  

* Leading the architecture, design, and end-to-end development of complex Agentic AI and traditional AI/ML solutions across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Working in a collaborative environment with global teams and managing cross-functional stakeholders across business and technical domains to deliver scalable solutions to high-impact business problems.
* Architecting, developing, and deploying LLM-driven applications, multi-agent workflows, autonomous agent systems, and traditional data science models into production environments.
* Translating complex business requirements into robust technical and system architectures, creating high-level and low-level design documents, and articulating architectural decisions and findings to leadership and stakeholders.
* Hands-on coding and system implementation using Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), REST/gRPC APIs, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka.
* Guiding, mentoring, and technical coaching of junior engineers and data scientists on project pods—conducting peer code and architecture reviews, sharing constructive feedback, and driving the team toward best-in-class technical execution
* Designing and implementing robust testing, validation, evaluation, and observability frameworks (e.g., LLM evals, hallucination mitigation, latency/token optimization, model governance) across the end-to-end AI lifecycle.
* Developing next-generation AI systems with built-in data privacy, ethical AI, bias mitigation, guardrails, and compliance with enterprise security and governance policies.
* Assisting in growing the AI practice by leading POCs, identifying new high-value opportunities, defining architectural blueprints, evaluating emerging tools/frameworks, and contributing to technical white papers and documentation.
* Staying informed on the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic frameworks, and related tech stacks, finding ways to deliver business value by customizing and applying them to our specific enterprise domain.
* Partnering with ecosystem partners, startups, and open-source communities to explore and integrate cutting-edge AI capabilities.

**What We’re Looking For...**
You have deep technical expertise in modern AI engineering and traditional data science, and you thrive as a hands-on technical lead who bridges architecture, coding, and stakeholder collaboration. You are energized by working in a dynamic environment, handling multiple complex projects simultaneously, and translating ambiguous business problems into reliable, production-ready AI systems. You take pride in technical excellence, enjoy mentoring junior team members, and are passionate about advancing state-of-the-art Agentic and LLM architectures within an enterprise scale.
  
  
**What we're looking for… ("You'll need to have…")**

* Bachelor's degree with six or more years of relevant experience.
* Five or more years of hands-on experience in software engineering, applied machine learning, or advanced data science in production environments.
* One or more years of hands-on experience architecting, building, and deploying Agentic AI and LLM-driven solutions (e.g., autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, tool calling/function calling, agent workflows).
* Strong hands-on proficiency with modern AI orchestration and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent agent frameworks.
* Deep familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture, tool integration standards, REST/gRPC APIs, and microservices design.
* Expert-level coding proficiency in Python and solid software engineering practices (OOP, design patterns, modular architecture, CI/CD, testing, code quality).
* Strong experience working with relational, analytical, and streaming data stores: BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka.
* Solid foundation and working understanding of traditional data science methodologies, predictive modeling, machine learning concepts (supervised/unsupervised learning, neural networks, ensembling), and evaluation metrics.
* Experience with all phases of an end-to-end AI project lifecycle: data ingestion/streaming, preprocessing, prompt engineering/fine-tuning, model validation/evals, containerization, deployment, operationalization, monitoring, and tracing.
* Demonstrated track record of leading technical implementation across multiple simultaneous projects and collaborating effectively with cross-functional business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience providing technical mentorship, conducting architectural and code reviews, and giving feedback to junior engineers and data scientists.

**What we're looking for… ("Even better if you have…")**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Experience architecting and deploying AI/ML and Agentic solutions in the Telecommunications domain or large-scale enterprise environments.
* Experience with Vector Databases and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques (hybrid search, reranking, contextual compression).
* Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and guardrail systems
* Experience with cloud AI platforms (GCP Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI) and distributed compute/data infrastructure.
* Experience in optimization, simulation techniques, or operations research applied to enterprise problems.
* Active contributions to open-source AI projects, agent frameworks, or authoring technical white papers and publications.
* Exceptional presentation, communication, and executive storytelling skills with a proven ability to influence technical and non-technical leadership.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Cloud Native NTN Applications)
description:
**About Us**
One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Viasat is developing a 3GPP NTN standards-based Low Earth Orbit (LEO) Network to support standard based devices across key use cases such as Direct to Device, Automobile and UAVs.
  
  
RAN Apps team is responsible for the development of an ecosystem of AI native, Cloud hosted intelligent applications to configure, monitor and optimize the performance of Viasat’s LEO based satellite network especially that of the RAN subsystem in it, and integrate the ecosystem with the complete satellite ground network. These applications interface with various components of O-RAN based NTN network – RU, DU, CU, RIC, SMO etc.
  
  
Team member responsibilities are end-to-end ownership of one or more intelligent RAN applications, from requirements refining to design, development and system integration.
  
  
This is a site‑based role, employees work 3+ days (60%+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five‑day workweek.
  
  
**The day-to-day**

* Refine initial requirements through brainstorming with peers in the team and external stakeholders.
* Develop Architecture and Design for AI native, Cloud hosted intelligent RAN applications utilizing O-RAN framework, system performance, scalability and maintainability aspects.
* Develop test plans covering configuration, performance, stability, interoperability
* Implement the design with the support of AI productivity tools
* Test the applications at various level – unit, module, subsystem, system
* Integration with other network components (DU, CU, RIC, SMO)
* Maintain and automate CI/CD pipelines for build/testing/deployments
* Support production & lab environments aligned with team’s responsibility
* Update and maintain existing production applications and networks

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent
* 6-10 years of hands-on experience building and operating large-scale cloud-native, microservices-based, event-driven, distributed applications.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts including scalability, fault tolerance, high availability, resiliency, consistency models, eventual consistency, and idempotent processing.
* Experience designing data-intensive systems using relational and NoSQL databases.
* Deep understanding of event-driven architectures, including asynchronous messaging, event streaming, pub/sub patterns, and event sourcing concepts.
* Strong experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and service-to-service communication patterns in distributed environments.
* Proven ability to build highly reliable and observable production systems, including monitoring, logging, tracing, disaster recovery, and incident resolution.
* Good understanding of Terrestrial and/or Satellite wireless system, SMO and RIC frameworks

Technical Expertise:
  
  

* Strong programming skills preferably in Golang or Python
* Containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.
* API design and integration, including REST APIs, API versioning, backward compatibility, contract-first development, API gateways, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and resiliency patterns.
* Event streaming and messaging technologies such as Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Google Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, or equivalent.
* Public cloud platforms such as GCP and/or AWS.
* CI/CD and DevOps tooling, including GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
* Deployment automation using Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, CloudFormation or similar.

**What Will Help You On The Job**

* Good understanding of O-RAN specifications, rApps,xApps development
* Hands on development experience with Golang/Python/Rust/Scripting/Cl-CD in public cloud environment

**EEO Statement**
Viasat is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic. If you would like to request an accommodation on the basis of disability for completing this on-line application, please click here.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:

5+ Years

Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud (Portals), Salesforce DevOps Center, Robust API Integrations, Custom UI Design (LWC), Agentforce Configuration, and Azure CI/CD Pipelines.

* Practical design and implementation experience with Salesforce Service Cloud and Experience Cloud (Community Portals).
* Solid experience designing tailored, responsive user interfaces (UI Customization) using SLDS and modern CSS/JS frameworks.
* Proven track record of developing custom web services and handling REST/SOAP API integrations.
* Direct experience deploying metadata and applications via Salesforce DevOps Center and Azure CI/CD platforms (or equivalent Git-based build pipelines).
* Practical exposure or functional training on Salesforce Agentforce architectures.

1. Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I (PD1) is required; Platform Developer II (PD2) is a strong advantage.
2. Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant or Experience Cloud Consultant.
3. Salesforce Certified Agentforce Consultant / Developer credentials are a major plus.

title: Technical Content Developer
description:
Job description:

*Location: (On-site) Hyderabad, India*

**What you'll own:**

* Distribution: Every piece starts with a plan for who will see it and where. You'll map the channels before you write, adapt the piece for each one and track how it performs.
* Long-form TOFU pieces: Write blog posts, newsletters, explainers and research write-ups that make our work appeal to people evaluating AI model training and deployment.
* BOFU content: Create landing pages, one-pagers and pitch for our datasets across modalities (audio, languages, coding RL, physical AI and more), our RL environments and our agent observability suite. Write landing pages, one-pagers and product descriptions across STARK, Helix, VoxClash and our physical AI line.
* SEO and AEO: Plan content around what our buyers search for. Structure pages so search engines and AI answer engines can find and cite them.
* Social media: Plan and write content for Deccan's LinkedIn, X, and more.
* Strategic case studies: Work with customers and our sales team to write case studies that capture why each customer chose Deccan and what it changed for them.
* Launches and announcements: Write for funding news, partnerships, product releases and conferences.

**You'll do well here if you**

* Shun AI slop: You take your writing personally, and you can't stand content that reads like it came off an assembly line and recognize a technical subject is never an excuse for flat, generic content.
* Pick up deep technical topics quickly: You need curiosity and the patience to ask experts good questions until you understand the subject well enough to explain it.
* Bring a point of view: You enjoy forming opinions about the industry and backing them up in writing.
* Obsess over quality: You edit your own drafts closely and use feedback to improve the work.
* Measure your work by results. You want to know whether a piece brought in traffic, leads or conversations, and you use that to decide what to write next.
* Use AI tools well. You use LLMs for research and first drafts, and you know how to edit the output so it reads like a person wrote it.
* Enjoy collaboration: You're comfortable working with researchers, product managers, sales and design to get what a piece needs.

**Experience**

* 1–3 years in B2B content marketing, editorial, journalism or product storytelling, ideally at a dev tools SaaS/technology company.
* A portfolio of your published writing for different channels
* Hands-on experience with SEO, and familiarity with how AI answers engines surface content.

If your experience falls slightly outside this range but your work makes the case, apply anyway.

Bonus points

* You've written about AI, data or developer tools.
* You've written for formats beyond text, like video scripting or visual content.

**Work Location: In person**
