title: Principal Engineer Software
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Job Summary
  
  
As a Principal Engineer in our Identity Security division, you will be the ultimate technical authority and go-to expert for our core Single Sign-On (SSO) and Federation capabilities. You will own the architectural integrity, security posture, and scalability of our SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC) implementations. In this role, you will balance deep technical execution with organizational leadership—driving best practices across microservices, mentoring engineering teams, representing our identity expertise externally, and pioneering the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to advance our identity security capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Write clean, highly secure, and performance-optimized code for critical authentication paths and build Proof of Concepts (PoCs) to evaluate new architectures.
* Architect resilient, low-latency microservices capable of handling millions of token validations, federation requests, and authentication flows globally.
* Drive engineering modernizations, including upgrading backend frameworks, implementing secure CI/CD pipelines, and integrating advanced security analysis tools.
* Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of critical bugs involving multi-tenant SSO setups, token encryption/signing, and token lifecycles.
* Partner with data science teams to integrate AI/ML models into authentication flows for real-time risk scoring and anomalous token behavior detection.
* Advocate for and embed generative AI development tools into the team's daily workflows to safely accelerate delivery and improve code quality.
* Lead large-scale features, protocol refactors, and microservice optimizations, ensuring alignment with the company’s Tech Radar and security baselines.
* Identify architectural gaps in SSO services, advocate for improvements, and implement robust solutions.
* Conduct rigorous reviews of complex protocol implementations and cryptographic designs to ensure strict adherence to RFC standards.
* Proactively identify and resolve cross-team technical dependencies for seamless integration.
* Teach, guide, and upskill developers, fostering a culture of deep identity security awareness.
* Represent the company in the cybersecurity industry by speaking at tech conferences, writing technical blogs, or contributing to open-source identity standards.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record in a Tech Lead or Principal Engineer role.
* The candidate should have experience in at least one of the following programming languages: C#/.NET OR Java OR Python .The candidate should be willing to work with the C#/.NET technology stack.
* Exposure or strong interest in applying AI/ML technologies within cybersecurity contexts.
* Strong background in modern cloud-native architectures, distributed microservices, and secure-by-design engineering principles.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven experience in public speaking, technical writing (blogs/whitepapers), or mentoring engineering communities.
* Broad understanding of the business context, connecting technical decisions to customer value.
* Ability to translate highly complex technical concepts for both engineering and business stakeholders.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Identity and Access Management (IAM) architectures, specifically building and securing SAML 2.0 Identity/Service Providers and OAuth 2.0/OIDC Authorization Servers.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Sr Applications Developer
description:
**About The Role And Team**
FinTech is part of the CFO's organization and is responsible for innovating and building Financial Products & Systems. Our DNA is customer obsession, high-quality products, teamwork, and transparency. We provide systems for compliance, data reliability, and audit, ensuring timely availability of business-critical data.
  
  
**This Role Has Two Halves, Split Roughly Evenly**

* Automation delivery (~50%) : lead a 15-20-member external vendor team that builds and supports our RPA (robotic process automation) bots.
* System controls & SaaS security (~50%) : keep our financial systems, including cloud ERPs such as Oracle Fusion, Coupa, etc secure, well-controlled, and SOX-compliant.

The two halves belong together. Automation is how we turn manual controls into automated, continuous ones. Strong controls are what make our bots safe to run on financial systems.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Lead Automation Delivery**

* Manage and mentor a 15-20 person vendor team across development and production support.
* Set development standards, review designs, and sign off on solutions before they go live.
* Own bot reliability: SLAs, escalations for critical failures, and root-cause fixes so problems don't repeat.
* Run the vendor relationship: scope, staffing, performance scorecards, and quarterly reviews.
* Choose the right tool for each job. Use an API or native integration where it will outlast a screen-based bot.
* Manage the MS Power Automate Platform, deployment pipelines, and licensing.

**SaaS ERP Security & Identity Management**

* Design and maintain user roles and access in FinTech applications and cloud ERPs (Oracle Fusion, Oracle EPM Cloud, Coupa), including role-based access (RBAC), so each person has only the access they need.
* Find and fix segregation-of-duties (SoD) conflicts, including conflicts that span two apps.
* Govern single sign-on, MFA, user provisioning and de-provisioning, access requests, access certifications, and privileged/emergency admin access (PAM).
* Track every system and bot account: who owns it, what it can access, and when its credentials rotate.
* Work with the IAM team on the integrations, APIs, workflows, rules, and reporting that FinTech applications need.
* Review vendor SOC reports and make sure we run the controls each vendor expects from us.

title: Software Engineer Manager (Database Observability)
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!
  
  
**Your opportunity**
At New Relic, we provide our customers real-time insights, so they can innovate faster. Our software delivers insightful observability tools across different technologies and distributed systems, enabling software engineering teams to quickly identify, understand and tackle issues, analyze performance and get the most of their software and infrastructure.
  
  
Database Observability is a critical pillar of New Relic's platform strategy. We are looking for an experienced
**Engineering Manager (M3)**
to lead a senior, high-performing team building next-generation Database Observability products. Your team will own the entire lifecycle of critical telemetry data flows from lightweight database agents and high-throughput ingestion pipelines to intelligent DB recommendation engines and autonomous DB AI Agents.
  
  
You will lead a team that includes senior and Lead-level engineers with deep domain expertise in distributed systems and AI. Your primary value will come from setting strategic technical direction, enabling their best work, and fostering a high-accountability culture while partnering closely with Product and Design to deliver features that directly drive New Relic's Database Observability.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Manage a full-stack engineering team (6–8 engineers) spanning backend systems, database telemetry, agent engineering, and UI workflows.
* Own end-to-end delivery sprint planning, roadmap execution, system quality, and operational excellence for critical database ingestion and recommendation pipelines.
* Guide the team in harnessing cutting-edge AI technologies including Agentic AI, MCP, and LLMs to evolve database observability from passive monitoring to automated, AI-driven diagnostics and remediation.
* Drive architectural discussions around high-throughput, low-latency ingestion, streaming telemetry (Kafka), and database agent development, holding the team to high engineering excellence standards.
* Partner closely with Product Management and Design to translate high-level vision into actionable, well-engineered execution plans..
* Hire, mentor, and grow engineers at every level. Set clear expectations, manage performance equitably, and build a visible talent pipeline.
* Build a strong DevOps culture where teams own what they ship ensuring robust monitoring, incident response, CI/CD automation, and high reliability.
* Champion modern engineering workflows, including AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to accelerate delivery and spec-driven development.

**This role requires**

* 10+ years of total software engineering experience with 2+ years directly managing engineering teams.
* Proven track record of coaching, guiding, and retaining individual contributors ,enabling domain experts rather than directing them.
* Deep technical background in backend and distributed systems (Go, Java, Python, or equivalent) with the ability to engage credibly in architecture discussions around high throughput, low latency, and data pipelines.
* Foundational understanding of database engines (Relational and NoSQL) and the challenges of safely collecting performance metrics under heavy production loads.
* Proven track record of delivering complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives on time with high quality, alongside experience managing team health, technical debt, and performance expectations.
* Clear, direct, and transparent communication style effective at aligning senior engineers, cross-functional partners, and executive stakeholders.
* Familiarity with modern practices including CI/CD, microservices, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and production observability.

**Bonus points if you have**

* Background in Observability, Database Engineering, SRE, or Performance Tuning domains.
* Exposure to Agentic AI, LLM application architecture, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience with real-time streaming architectures (Apache Kafka) and database collector/agent design.
* Hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) standards.
* Active experience guiding teams through AI-assisted development practices (e.g., spec-driven development using Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor).
* Track record of managing teams through rapid scaling or ground-up product launches.
* Familiarity with Kafka, GraphQL, or distributed data systems
* Exposure to AI-assisted development practices (spec-driven dev, Claude Code, Copilot)

**Why Join Us**

* Be part of a forward-thinking team working with cutting-edge technologies in a collaborative environment.
* Access to opportunities for professional growth and development, including mentorship, learning resources, and a culture that encourages continuous improvement.
* We believe in maintaining a healthy work-life balance with flexible work hours and remote work opportunities.

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.
  
  
If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com.
  
  
We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid.
  
  
**Our hiring process**
In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.
  
  
We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.
  
  
Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic.
  
  
New Relic develops and distributes encryption software and technology that complies with U.S. export controls and licensing requirements. Certain New Relic roles require candidates to pass an export compliance assessment as a condition of employment in any global location. If relevant, we will provide more information later in the application process.
  
  
Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
Review our Applicant Privacy Notice at https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/applicant-privacy-policy

title: Associate Operations Software Engineer - Operations ( Contract to hire )
description:
**About Signant Health**
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Associate Operations Software Engineer creates, enhances, and maintains business applications, configures custom code to support the company’s business needs, and moves those configurations through a standard SDLC progression. The Engineer is accountable for project deliverables in line with quality targets and SLAs, while adhering to best practices, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), company processes, and global industry regulations. The ideal candidate has basic product knowledge and basic knowledge of user applications.
  
  
**This is a 6-month contract role with the potential to convert to a full-time position (contract-to-hire).**
**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Function**
**Application Development / Study Configuration**

* Develop and maintain application components (under supervision)
* Support Global Technical Delivery in meeting business objectives outlined in Goals and Objectives
* Work with the Solutions team to understand business requirements for assigned tasks
* Support all phases of verification and testing by efficiently diagnosing and resolving defects
* Collaborate with the Delivery Manager/Lead to keep projects on time
* Coordinate with the Software Engineering team to understand design patterns, standards, customizations, and resource capacity planning
* Understand and follow all coding standards
* Create robust, well-documented code
* Design, create, and modify database objects as required
* Complete unit testing, create documentation, and execute peer reviews as required
* Adhere to source control, versioning best practices, and operational process requirements when executing study configuration tasks
* Regularly communicate status updates on assigned tasks to internal and external stakeholders
* Request requirements and design clarifications when necessary
* Willingly and openly adopt and support iterative process improvements
* Job performance is measured individually, as it pertains to team goals aligned with corporate objectives for Global Technical Delivery and the values of Signant Health

**Site Support Responsibilities (Rater Station Only)**

* Adhere to source control, versioning best practices, and operational process requirements
* Perform general site support in support of study configurations in the field, as required
* Diagnose and resolve defects as part of general site support
* Prepare and confirm all required change control documentation, including updates to design and other technical documents
* Deploy resolutions to testing and production environments as required

**Quality System Responsibilities**

* Perform all work in accordance with documented Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Working Instructions, and adhere to Good Clinical Practice (GCP), 21 CFR Part 11, and other regulatory requirements as required

**Knowledge, Skills & Attributes**
**Essential:**

* 0–2 years of experience developing software
* Conceptual knowledge of software development processes and practices
* Programming experience in any language (classroom or professional experience)
* Knowledge of application development, configuration, and support areas
* Ability to work independently and resourcefully toward quality, high-performance solutions
* Problem-solving skills and good decision-making, with the judgment to escalate when necessary
* Ability to provide concise, accurate status updates to the team on progress
* Ability to establish and maintain effective work relationships within and across functional areas
* Analytical skills, with the ability to comprehend business requirements

**Specific to IRT and Rater Station products:**

* Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio, SQL Server Reporting Services, and T-SQL
* Microsoft Visual Studio IDE, ASP.NET MVC, and C# with LINQ

**Desirable:**

* Agile Scrum methodologies
* Atlassian Suite tools such as Bitbucket, Confluence, Jira, Xray, and Jira Service Management
* Source control software such as Team Foundation Server, Bitbucket, or other Git-based tools
* Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and Reporting Services (SSRS)
* Microsoft Azure, Cosmos DB, and Kubernetes
* REST APIs
* Web code and data standards: HTML, JavaScript, XML, JSON, and REST
* Experience leading software design and development efforts on assigned projects
* Experience estimating project time for quoting development and support tasks
* Willingness to share knowledge openly with others, including lessons learned
* Willingness to work flexible hours
* Familiarity with GCP and 21 CFR Part 11
* Familiarity with defect tracking software

**Why Signant Health?**
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer to join our SRE-Linux team in Hyderabad (preferred) or Bengaluru, India. The team is responsible for the reliability, observability, and day-to-day operation of the core services and infrastructure that underpin our Linux-based environments. This includes owning the firm's observability stack end to end — metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting — as well as ensuring the stability, reliability, and efficiency of the critical Linux infrastructure that forms the backbone of our systems.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will design and develop robust, scalable, high-performance tools and automation solutions for Linux environments using Go and Python, leveraging distributed systems and modern orchestration platforms. You will also build and scale the firm's observability platform, including metrics (Grafana, Grafana Mimir), logging (ELK: Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), and high-throughput telemetry stores (ClickHouse). You will develop and advocate for robust observability and reliability practices: logging, metrics, tracing, SLIs/SLOs, alerting, and capacity planning. You will lead critical incident response and drive blameless postmortems that turn incidents into permanent fixes, with a standing mandate to engineer toil out of operations and support rather than absorb it. Additionally, you will develop innovative solutions and streamline day-to-day workflows, including enhancing the SDLC pipeline by leveraging the rapidly evolving GenAI landscape to improve efficiency, quality, and automation. You will also lead and collaborate within a cross-functional team, provide mentorship to junior engineers, and contribute to code and design reviews. Furthermore, you will troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to Linux infrastructure, core services, and the observability pipeline.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical discipline, with 4 to 8 years of software development and SRE experience
* Excellent proficiency in Go/Python for developing production-grade applications, services, and automation tooling
* Exceptional understanding of Linux internals; familiarity with Kerberos, TLS, Puppet, LDAP, DNS, DHCP, mail, and load balancers
* Solid grounding in observability and reliability principles (metrics, logs, traces, SLIs/SLOs, alerting, and capacity planning)
* Experience with observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Grafana Mimir, ELK)
* Familiarity with distributed systems, including experience designing and maintaining highly available systems
* Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Experience with GenAI and its application to observability and reliability (e.g., anomaly detection, alert-noise reduction, incident triage/summarization, log analysis, or AIOps)
* Experience with container orchestration and workflow systems (e.g., Kubernetes, Temporal)
* Hands-on experience operating ClickHouse or similar high-cardinality/high-throughput data stores

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/SrSELinuxSept26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

title: Software Engineer – AI CoE
description:
**About Redwood**
Redwood Software helps the world's largest enterprises automate mission-critical business processes. Our platforms support complex enterprise workloads across ERP systems, business applications, cloud infrastructure, and on-premises environments.
  
  
Redwood is building reusable AI infrastructure, agentic capabilities, developer tools, and platform services that enable enterprise-ready AI features across its product portfolio.
  
  
**Role Mission**
As a Software Engineer, you will lead the design and delivery of complex, production-grade AI and agentic capabilities that can be reused across Redwood products.
  
  
You will solve ambiguous engineering problems, establish standards for reliability and AI evaluation, and contribute to important technical decisions. This is a hands-on role with ownership of significant systems and platform capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver complex services, agentic workflows, and shared AI platform capabilities.
* Build multi-step agentic systems that combine reasoning, tool use, retrieval, memory, policy controls, and human oversight.
* Establish robust approaches for AI evaluation, observability, model selection, fallback behaviour, and failure recovery.
* Lead technical delivery across multiple contributors and coordinate dependencies with product and platform teams.
* Review designs and code for scalability, security, performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost.
* Resolve complex production issues and implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence.
* Create reusable frameworks, reference implementations, and engineering standards that accelerate development.
* Partner with Product, Architecture, Security, Data, and Operations teams to translate business problems into durable platform solutions.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend adoption based on technical evidence, enterprise requirements, and business value.
* Contribute directly to implementation while influencing important architectural and engineering decisions.

**Scope and Expected Impact**

* Own complex systems or platform capabilities that affect the immediate team and multiple partner teams.
* Operate independently when requirements, risks, or implementation approaches are not fully defined.
* Influence technical direction through architecture, working software, design reviews, and measurable outcomes.
* Drive improvements that reduce technical and operational risks across multiple services or product areas.
* Lead the technical execution of initiatives involving multiple contributors and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Balance short-term delivery requirements with long-term platform maintainability and scalability.

**Must Have Qualifications**

* 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems.
* Advanced programming skills in Python, Java, or another relevant production language.
* Strong experience building distributed systems, APIs, integrations, cloud services, and production-grade applications.
* Hands-on experience delivering generative AI or agentic systems into production.
* Experience with agent orchestration, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt management, or model integration.
* Experience implementing AI evaluation, tracing, monitoring, security controls, and reliability mechanisms.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, automated testing, CI/CD, cloud deployment, and production operations.
* Ability to lead complex technical work while remaining hands-on.
* Strong technical judgement and clear written and verbal communication.

**Strong Plus**

* Experience with LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or custom agent orchestration frameworks.
* Working knowledge of transformer architectures, model fine-tuning, inference strategies, or model evaluation.
* Experience with vector databases, model gateways, prompt lifecycle platforms, or AI observability tools.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, messaging systems, event-driven architectures, or distributed systems.
* Experience in enterprise middleware, workflow orchestration, ERP, or integration platforms.
* Experience building internal platforms, developer tools, or reusable capabilities used across engineering teams.
* Exposure to regulated, security-sensitive, or high-availability enterprise environments.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Delivers significant AI systems or platform capabilities with measurable adoption and operational reliability.

description:

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
  
  
**Sr Principal Software Engineer – Genesys Cloud AI & Industry Solutions**
**Role Overview**
At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer and employee experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data, and AI to deliver personalized experiences, automate complex business processes, and improve operational efficiency.
  
  
We are looking for a
**Senior Principal Software Engineer with deep, hands-on Genesys Cloud experience**
to design and build the next generation of
**AI-powered applications and industry solutions on the Genesys Cloud platform**
.
  
  
This is a highly technical, hands-on engineering role. The ideal candidate combines deep Genesys Cloud engineering expertise with hands-on experience building advanced conversational or agentic AI applications using Genesys AI, Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Kore.ai, or similar platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate has extensive experience developing applications and integrations on Genesys Cloud and understands how to combine Genesys Cloud APIs, Architect, AI capabilities, experience orchestration, data, and enterprise systems to create production-grade solutions.
  
  
A major focus of this role will be translating industry-specific business processes and customer challenges into reusable AI solutions. You will build AI applications, Digital Teammates, solution accelerators, and industry solutions for areas such as financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, telecommunications, and the public sector.
  
  
You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Innovations, customers, and partners to turn emerging Genesys AI capabilities, external AI technologies, and industry requirements into scalable, repeatable, and productized
**solutions**
that can be deployed across multiple customers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build production-grade applications and industry solutions on Genesys Cloud, leveraging Genesys Cloud APIs, SDKs, events, integrations, AI capabilities, and platform services.
* Develop AI-powered customer and employee applications using Genesys Cloud AI capabilities, including AI Studio, Virtual Agent/Agentic Virtual Agent capabilities, Copilot, Architect, knowledge, and Experience Orchestration.
* Translate industry-specific business processes and use cases into scalable AI applications, combining Genesys Cloud capabilities with enterprise systems, data, knowledge, AI models, and agentic technologies.
* Build reusable industry solution accelerators, Digital Teammates, AI agents, workflows, and application components that can be configured and deployed across multiple customers within an industry.
* Develop industry solutions addressing complex business challenges across financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, telecommunications, and public sector environments.

* Build integrations using Genesys Cloud Platform APIs, Data Actions, event-driven architectures, webhooks, and external APIs.
* Integrate Genesys Cloud with industry and enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft, AWS, CRM, ITSM, ERP, knowledge, healthcare, financial services, and workflow platforms.
* Build agentic applications and multi-agent workflows where AI agents can reason, retrieve information, invoke tools and APIs, execute business processes, and collaborate with human employees.
* Apply modern conversational and agentic AI patterns learned from platforms such as Genesys AI, Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Kore.ai, and similar technologies to build differentiated solutions on Genesys Cloud.
* Design AI applications that combine LLMs, enterprise knowledge, tool/API calling, workflow orchestration, business rules, and enterprise systems of record.
* Create reusable solution patterns that encapsulate industry workflows, business rules, integrations, AI capabilities, and best practices, accelerating time to value for customers.
* Work with industry experts, customers, Product, and Engineering teams to identify high-value use cases and convert them into repeatable, productized solutions.
* Build prototypes and MVPs using emerging Genesys Cloud AI and other AI technologies and rapidly convert successful concepts into scalable, production-ready industry applications.
* Design applications for enterprise-scale requirements including security, reliability, observability, scalability, performance, compliance, and governance.
* Provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, code reviews, and mentorship while remaining a hands-on builder and contributor.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of software engineering, application development, or solution architecture experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on Genesys Cloud experience, including designing, developing, integrating, and deploying applications on the platform.
* Deep understanding of Genesys Cloud architecture, APIs, Architect, routing, conversations, integrations, Data Actions, and event-driven capabilities.
* Strong hands-on experience developing enterprise applications using modern programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or similar technologies.
* Experience building AI-powered applications, conversational AI solutions, virtual agents, or agentic applications using enterprise AI platforms and modern AI technologies.
* Strong understanding of modern AI architectures including LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, orchestration, multi-agent systems, conversational AI, and agentic workflows.
* Demonstrated experience building reusable enterprise or industry solutions, rather than only one-off customer implementations.

* Experience integrating Genesys Cloud with enterprise applications such as CRM, ITSM, ERP, knowledge, and workflow platforms.
* Experience translating AI capabilities into production-grade applications and reusable solutions, including integrations with enterprise APIs, knowledge systems, workflows, and business applications.
* Experience taking solutions from prototype/MVP through production deployment and operation.
* Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership while remaining deeply involved in architecture, design, coding, prototyping, debugging, and implementation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud AI capabilities, including AI Studio, Virtual Agent/Agentic Virtual Agent, Copilot, Predictive Engagement, knowledge capabilities, and Experience Orchestration.
* Hands-on experience building production AI applications using Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Kore.ai, or similar enterprise conversational and agentic AI platforms.

* Experience with Genesys Cloud CX voice and digital channels, including routing, Architect flows, bots, messaging, and agent experiences.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
**About Soar and how we build**
Soar is building an AI-native home-financing platform for Saudi Arabia, and the AI-driven engineering system that builds it. Our product spans origination, credit decisioning, loan management, collections and investor products, all under SAMA regulation.
  
We build differently. Our engineers don't hand-write code; they specify, direct and review AI agents that do. If that sounds like where engineering is going, you'll fit here.
  
How we work :
  
Agents write the code. Engineers own the spec, the context, the tests and the review. DevOps doesn't hand-manage servers either.
  
Context engineering is the core skill. Agents work from a shared knowledge graph of business rules, architecture principles and money-movement rules that we keep current.
  
We build our own agents. Requirements, DevOps, PM and self-testing agents run on our MCP/A2A framework to automate the SDLC end to end.
  
Full stack by default. AI closes skill gaps, so engineers work across backend, frontend and infrastructure, with cross-domain reviewers.

* Collaborate with Product, QA, and other engineers; mentor teammates and document decisions and validation evidence in pull requests.

**Requirements**
**Requirements:**

* Typically 5+ years building and shipping production software, or equivalent demonstrated engineering depth and ownership.
* Strong proficiency in at least one production programming language and experience with application design, APIs, databases, version control, and automated testing.
* Substantial hands-on experience delivering software with AI coding tools or agents, supported by concrete examples of shipped work.
* Ability to reason about, debug, and explain code independently, including code generated by AI.

Experience with agent orchestration, MCP or API integrations, retrieval systems, evaluation suites, cloud platforms, or financial systems.

You ship reliable features with clear validation evidence, catch defects in generated code, improve delivery speed, and create reusable practices that raise the effectiveness of the wider team.

AMPS is looking for a Software Developer with deep experience in Elixir and the Phoenix framework to join our engineering team. You'll design, build, and scale backend services and APIs that power our core products, working closely with product, QA, and platform teams to ship reliable, high-performance software. This is a hands-on senior role for someone who enjoys solving hard concurrency and scalability problems and mentoring other engineers along the way.

## What You'll Do

- Experience with distributed systems, message queues, and event-driven architectures.

- Familiarity with testing frameworks (ExUnit), CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Experience with Phoenix LiveView for real-time UI features.

- Familiarity with other functional languages (Erlang, Haskell, Scala) or prior Erlang/OTP experience.

- Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code tools.

- F

amiliarity with Node.js and React.js. 

- Prior experience mentoring engineers or leading small technical initiatives.

* - Contributions to open-source Elixir/Phoenix projects.

description: Aliases: Principal Engineer, Senior Principal Engineer, Technical Architect, Principal Architect, Enterprise Architect (Engineering), Senior Technical Architect, Distinguished Engineer or Chief Architect at a smaller companyAbout TruvetaTruveta is the world's first health provider-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Sound judgment about build versus buy, migration risk, and technical debt at organization scale. Ability to influence senior engineering and product leadership across geographies and time zones. * Knowledge of CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation)
* Experience with MySQL 8.x, PostgreSQL 15+, or similar relational databases. NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB) knowledge is a plus
* Cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, GCP, or Pivotal/VMware Tanzu)
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, design principles, and Domain Driven Design (DDD)
* Proficient in unit testing (JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ), integration testing (Testcontainers, Spring Boot Test), and Test Driven Development (TDD)
* Experience with OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect (OIDC), JWT token handling, and API security best practices
* Familiarity with production support, observability tools, troubleshooting, and incident management
* Strong problem-solving skills, excellent communication and collaboration abilities, and continuous learning mindset

That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you'll do:**
**UX Architecture & Strategy**
— Define and own the long-term architecture for AI-native user experiences across the platform, making critical build-vs-buy decisions (design systems, agent-to-UI interaction patterns, real-time/streaming UX for AI-generated content) to ensure the experience layer stays resilient and coherent as the platform scales.
  
  
**AI-Native Intelligent Experiences**
— Design and build user-facing surfaces where agentic backends - recommendations, autonomous triage, generated fixes/insights, multi-step agent reasoning - are exposed to end users through fast, trustworthy, low-friction interaction patterns. Own the hard UX problems unique to AI-native products: progressive disclosure of agent reasoning, graceful handling of uncertainty/latency, human-in-the-loop review flows, and making autonomous system behavior legible and controllable to end users rather than a black box.
  
  
**UXC & Workspace Platform**
— Deep ownership of the UXC (User Experience/Workspace, UI16) surface — component architecture, design system consistency, and performance — as the primary canvas AI-native features are built on top of.
  
  
**Agentic Pipeline Awareness**
— Partner closely with platform/ML teams building the agent orchestration and tool-calling infrastructure underneath (multi-agent dispatch, MCP-style tool integration, reasoning traceability) — translating what these backends can do into UX patterns that make them usable, safe, and trustworthy for real users.
  
  
**Business Alignment**
— Align UX and technical architecture with business goals, ensuring engineering velocity, experience quality, and adoption of AI-native features directly support customer acquisition, retention, and time-to-market.
  
  
**Hands-on Engineering**
— Write high-performance, clean, production-grade code primarily across the frontend/experience stack (Lit.js, React/TypeScript, design systems, component architecture), with working fluency in backend/platform code (Java, Python, Postgres, K8s) to collaborate effectively with platform teams.
  
  
**Cross-functional Execution**
— Drive business-critical UX and platform outcomes in close collaboration with ML, backend platform, and product teams.
  
  
**Engineering Culture**
— Mentor senior engineers, champion UX and engineering excellence, and foster a culture of rapid, impact-driven innovation in AI-native product development.
  
  
**Ownership & Initiative**
— Proactively identify UX and platform gaps in the AI-native experience, propose solutions, align stakeholders, and drive execution with a high degree of ownership.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into engineering and platform work—AI-powered tooling, automated operational workflows, agentic systems for fleet visibility and operations, or reasoning about AI’s impact on how infrastructure is built and run.
* 15+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated progression into senior technical leadership, and a track record concentrated in user experience and frontend platform engineering.
* Deep UXC / AI-native UX expertise - has shipped intelligent, AI-driven user experiences (not just consumed an LLM API), with strong intuition for how agent/model output should surface to real users.
* Hands-on experience with agentic/multi-agent systems from the consumer side — understands agent orchestration, tool-calling protocols (MCP or equivalent), and reasoning traceability well enough to design UX around them, even if platform-layer implementation sits with another team.
* Strong hands-on coding ability with deep design thinking in the frontend/experience stack (React/TypeScript, component/design systems), working proficiency in backend fundamentals (K8s, Java, Python, Postgres) to bridge into platform architecture conversations.
* Demonstrated ability to connect UX and engineering decisions to business outcomes - adoption, retention, time-to-market, not just technical metrics.
* Self-driven with strong ownership, able to identify UX and system gaps, propose solutions, align stakeholders, and execute at startup pace.
* Experience integrating or critically evaluating AI tools/agentic workflows in product and engineering decision-making, particularly from a user-experience and trust/legibility angle.

**Good to Have**

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
**About the role**

You will build and maintain the site on WordPress and be accountable for its speed, uptime, security and SEO readiness. You will turn content and marketing needs into reliable features, manage hosting and releases, and keep the site compliant with Indian data-protection rules (DPDP Act, 2023).
 

**Key responsibilities**

**WordPress development**

 

* Build and maintain custom themes, child themes and Gutenberg blocks in PHP, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
* Develop custom plugins, custom post types, taxonomies and Advanced Custom Fields setups for articles, news, guides and landing pages.
* Integrate third-party tools: CRM and lead forms, analytics, newsletter, payment and API-based services.
* Write clean, documented, version-controlled code using Git.

**Website technical management**

 

* Own hosting, server, DNS, SSL, CDN and email-deliverability settings, and liaise with the hosting provider.
* Manage WordPress core, theme and plugin updates through a staging-to-production release process.
* Monitor uptime, errors and logs; run backups and a tested disaster-recovery plan.
* Maintain technical documentation, access control and an inventory of plugins and licences.

**Performance and technical SEO**

 

* Keep Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) in the "Good" range on mobile and desktop.
* Implement caching, image optimisation, lazy loading and database clean-up.
* Manage XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicals, redirects, schema markup, hreflang and site architecture with the SEO team.
* Fix crawl, indexing and coverage issues reported in Google Search Console.

**Security and compliance**

 

* Harden the site: firewall, malware scanning, 2FA, least-privilege roles and secure login.
* Patch vulnerabilities promptly and lead incident response.
* Implement cookie consent, privacy notices and data-handling controls in line with the DPDP Act, 2023.

**Analytics and tracking**

 

* Set up and maintain GA4, Google Tag Manager, Search Console and conversion tracking.
* Ensure forms, events and funnels are tracked accurately and report technical KPIs monthly.

**Collaboration and leadership**

 

* Translate requirements from content, SEO, design and marketing into scoped tasks and timelines.
* Review work from freelancers or agencies and enforce coding and accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) standards.
* Train editors on the CMS and recommend improvements to the site roadmap.

**Required skills and qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of WordPress development, with a portfolio of custom themes and plugins.
* Strong PHP 8, MySQL, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3/SCSS and the WordPress REST API.
* Hands-on Gutenberg block development and ACF; working knowledge of React.
* Experience managing Linux hosting or managed WordPress hosting, cPanel or similar, DNS, SSL and CDNs such as Cloudflare.
* Proven record improving Core Web Vitals and fixing technical SEO issues.
* WordPress security best practices and incident handling.
* Git, staging workflows and deployment tools.
* GA4, Google Tag Manager and Google Search Console.
* Clear written and spoken English; able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical teams.

**Preferred skills**

* Experience with news, media or content-heavy portals with large article archives.
* Headless WordPress, Next.js or WPGraphQL.
* AWS, Google Cloud or containerised hosting; CI/CD pipelines.
* Multilingual sites (WPML or Polylang) and international SEO.
* CRM integrations such as Salesforce or Zoho.
* Familiarity with the DPDP Act, 2023 and GDPR requirements for websites.

title: Lead Software Engineer - C# .net
description:
**Lead Software Engineer – C# .net**
**Location: Hyderabad**
Are you a passionate developer with an agile mindset? And would you like to be part of a strategically important product area in one of the world’s leading software providers within the Fintech industry? Then you should join SimCorp as a C# & APL Software Engineer!
  
  
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values – caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
  
  
We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer to join the Transactions product area and contribute to business-critical functionality used by our clients in their daily investment operations.
  
  
You will work as part of an experienced engineering team, contributing to backend development, component design, performance, reliability and maintainability. The work is technically interesting because it combines complex business logic, long-lived enterprise software and the need to keep improving how we build and deliver functionality.
  
  
Most of the current product logic is written in APL, while we are increasing our use of C#/.NET in new development, integrations, cloud enablement, and platform modernization. You do not need prior APL experience. We will provide training and support and we are looking for someone who is curious enough to learn what is needed while bringing strong engineering practices from C#/.NET.
  
  
You will work with experienced engineers across locations and have room to influence how we build, modernize and evolve the product.
  
  
**what You Will Be Responsible For**
As a Lead Software Engineer, you will help the team build reliable, maintainable and well-tested backend solutions. In practice, you will:
  
  

* Lead end-to-end design, implement, test and maintain backend functionality using APL and, where relevant, C#/.NET
* Drive technical discussions and decision-making aligned with long-term business goals
* Architect scalable, secure and high-performance solutions
* Contribute to code quality, performance and long-term maintainability
* Mentor and guide a team of engineers through code reviews, technical planning, and agile practices
* Ensure system reliability through unit testing, integration testing and CI/CD pipelines
* Work closely with product managers, engineers and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver client-relevant functionality
* Investigate technical issues, performance bottlenecks and bugs and help design sustainable solutions
* Share knowledge with colleagues and contribute to technical discussions within the team

**What We Value**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field
* 7+ years of hands-on experience with C# and .NET technologies
* Expert knowledge of C#, .NET Core/Framework and backend development
* Good understanding of object-oriented design, clean code, APIs, and integration patterns
* Experience with automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, and Git-based workflows
* Ability to work with complex business logic and collaborate with both technical and non-technical colleagues
* Interest in learning APL. Prior APL experience is not required
* Experience with Azure or cloud-based development is an advantage, but not a prerequisite

**NICE-TO-HAVE**

* Experience from fintech, financial services or another regulated industry
* Exposure to functional, array-oriented or vector-based programming languages
* Experience with Azure services or cloud-based development
* Experience mentoring other engineers or taking ownership of a component

**Benefits**
Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.
  
  
Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.
  
  
**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
For any questions you are welcome to contact Viswanath Tangella (viswanath.tangella@simcorp.com), Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
  
  
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with large and global investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 2,500+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients. While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Processing
description:
**Aliases:**
Staff Engineer, Senior Staff Engineer, Lead Engineer, Senior Technical Lead, Senior Architect, Platform Architect, Data Architect, Solutions Architect (Engineering), Principal Engineer at a smaller company
  
  
**About Truveta**
Truveta is the world's first health provider-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values.
  
  
**This opportunity**
Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early members, you will help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub.
  
  
The Data Platform group in India owns parts of the pipeline that ingests, processes, stores, and serves healthcare data at a scale very few organizations operate at. Patients, doctors, and medical researchers deserve the same engineering rigor that has transformed other industries, and that is the work: correctness under volume, reliability under failure, and speed without cutting the corners that regulated health data does not allow anyone to cut.
  
  
**Who We Need**
We are seeking engineers who think in platforms. You will own a processing domain or a multi-team data capability, define its architecture, and make that architecture legible enough that the teams building inside it can move quickly without asking permission. The problems at this level are the recurring ones: the class of data-quality defect that keeps returning, the chronic cost line, the incident that has a different proximate cause every quarter and the same root cause every time. You will remain hands-on, because the credibility of the architecture depends on it.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own a platform, a processing domain, or a multi-team data capability, including both its architecture and its technical roadmap.
* Define the architecture for your domain and write it down clearly enough that teams can build inside it without constant consultation.
* Drive modernization, reliability, scalability, and cost programs that cross team boundaries.
* Solve the systemic problems that show up as recurring incidents, cost escalations, or repeating data-quality defects.
* Influence the technical direction of several teams through design review, written architecture, and working prototypes.
* Set engineering standards for the domain and make them hold without relying on a reporting line.
* Mentor SDE2 and SDE3 engineers and raise the design bar of the whole group, not only of your own projects.
* Stay hands-on through prototypes, critical-path code, and the hardest debugging in the domain.

**Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 to 12 years of professional software engineering experience.
* Ownership of a platform or domain rather than a single system, with architectural decisions that outlived your involvement.
* Deep distributed systems and data-processing expertise at production scale.
* Strong hands-on coding ability that is current, not historical.
* Demonstrated cross-team influence, meaning architecture that other teams adopted because it was right rather than because it was mandated.
* Cloud-native architecture on Azure or equivalent, with real depth on cost, reliability, and security.
* Track record of mentoring senior engineers and improving how a group designs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Healthcare data, clinical informatics, or any other heavily regulated data domains.
* Experience standing up or scaling an engineering site, or a new platform area from zero.
* Governance, lineage, privacy-preserving processing, or large-scale de-identification.
* Public technical writing, conference talks, or sustained open-source contribution.

description:

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

**MTS SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER**
**THE ROLE:**
  
  
We are looking for a dynamic, energetic Lead / Staff Software Engineer to join our growing team in AI (Artificial Intelligence) group. In this role, the individual will be responsible for developing AI/ML specific C/C++ kernels and dataflow schedules for AMD Ryzen Processors built on XDNA Neural Processor Units (NPU) to map LLMs, Stable Diffusion networks on NPU. As a C++ Kernel Developer, you will play a crucial role in designing, optimizing, and implementing machine learning kernels specifically tailored for vector processors. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, speed, and accuracy of our machine learning models.
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Kernel Development:
* Design and implement highly optimized C++ kernel library for NPU/GPU.
* Collaborate with the research and software teams to integrate these kernels into the existing software stack.
* Vector Processor Optimization:
* Work closely with hardware engineers to understand the architecture of VLIW vector core units such as MAC, GeMM, and non-linear functions.
* Develop vectorized code that leverages SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data) and ILP (instruction level parallelism) for maximum performance.
* Performance Profiling and Tuning:
* Profile and analyze the performance of existing kernels.
* Identify bottlenecks and optimize critical sections for better throughput.
* Testing and Validation:
* Develop CPU models for the ML operators in C++/ Python to validate accuracy.
* Write unit tests and integration tests to ensure correctness and reliability.
* Validate kernel performance across different hardware platforms.
* Documentation and Collaboration:
* Document design specs for new kernels and the performance improvements.
* Follow coding guidelines, use tools like git to maintain code and create pull-requests, and documentation.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including machine learning researchers and software engineers.

  
  
**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**
  
  

* Excellent C/C++ and Python coding skills
* Good understanding of SIMD/Tensor/VLIW processor architecture to exploit parallelism.
* Experience with vectorized programming (SIMD) and parallel computing.
* Familiarity with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) is a plus.
* Experience with silicon bring-up and pre-silicon validation on Emulation platforms is a plus.
* Knowledge of low-level hardware details (cache hierarchy, memory access patterns) is desirable.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for performance optimization.

**Academic Credentials**
BS/Masters/PhD degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with around 10/8/5 year experience respectively.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About SkySpecs**

At SkySpecs, our mission is to simplify renewable asset management so that less can do more for the planet. SkySpecs is helping to make this possible by automating the operations and maintenance of wind farms using advanced robotics paired with our custom-built asset performance management software, Horizon.

SkySpecs launched the world’s first completely autonomous blade inspection product in 2016 with a custom-designed drone system. Since then, SkySpecs has inspected over 90% of the US wind turbines and expanded globally, becoming the world leader in understanding the health of turbine blades. Identifying issues with turbine blades is only the first step. In 2019, SkySpecs launched Horizon, a platform for SkySpecs to offer a multi-layered solution for customers that includes: data collection, wind turbine blade engineering expertise, and a place for all stakeholders to collaborate to manage and analyze massive amounts of data, spot trends, and create plans for high-cost repair campaigns. In 2021, SkySpecs acquired two companies specializing in wind turbine drivetrain monitoring and financial management, further expanding our asset management portfolio. Ultimately, this will help reduce the cost and risk of operations for the industry.

**What will you be getting into?**

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help shape the future of our Horizon platform and the way we build software. Horizon is the platform behind SkySpecs' wind and solar inspection and asset-management business, and the work is hands-on, building end-to-end.

As the cost of producing code falls, an engineer's impact comes more than ever from judgment, design, and outcomes, not volume. AI is central to how we work here, and we treat it as serious leverage: a force multiplier for engineers who already have strong instincts, not a substitute for them. We expect everyone to keep pushing what AI, automation, and agents make possible, and to bring the judgment that makes that leverage pay off.

We do not separate thinking from doing. You will be expected to independently take broad, highly ambiguous problem statements, formulate scalable technical solutions, and participate directly in delivery by writing and owning production code.
**We value a founder’s mindset; the people closest to the work are expected to challenge assumptions, optimize proposed approaches, and actively engineer high-impact business outcomes.**

This is a full-stack engineering role. While engineers may develop areas of deeper expertise, we expect everyone to be capable of working across frontend, backend, infrastructure, data, and developer tooling as needed to deliver outcomes. We value engineers who can understand the entire system, formulate end-to-end solutions, and contribute wherever the work requires.

Our platform is built using AWS, GitLab, Auth0, Grafana, Terraform, Kafka, Node.js, Nest.js, TypeScript, Apollo GraphQL, React, Ant Design, Vitest, Playwright, and PostgreSQL.

[

Work with product managers, customers, internal users, and other engineers to understand requirements, constraints, and desired outcomes.

**[10%]**
Formulate solutions, evaluate tradeoffs, and break work into executable milestones and implementation plans.

Build and ship software:

* Authoring and infrastructure as code.
* Designing and implementing new services and APIs.
* Building reusable user experiences and workflows.
* Improving reliability, performance, security, and developer productivity.
* Reviewing code generated by peers and by agents
* Leveraging AI tools and autonomous agents to accelerate delivery.

**[20%]**
Improve Horizon, our engineering systems, and the way we work. Examples include:

* Building internal tooling and automation.
* Improving documentation and architectural clarity.
* Reducing operational toil.
* Expanding AI and agent capabilities.
* Improving testing, observability, and deployment workflows.
* Exploring new ideas, experiments, and prototypes that could improve Horizon or the way we build software.

**Success is measured by outcomes delivered, not lines of code written.**

**Requirements/Core Expectations:**

* 7+ years of experience designing, shipping, and operating production software systems.
* A proven track record of operating with absolute self-direction—capable of taking a loosely defined, high-level mandate and driving it to production with minimal to no supervision.
* Experience navigating the fast-paced, evolving environments typical of early-stage companies, scaling startups, or operating as a founding engineer.
* Growth & Leadership Readiness: While this role begins as an elite Individual Contributor, you possess the communication skills, high emotional intelligence (EQ), and mentoring instincts required to anchor, build, and formally lead an engineering team as the organization scales.
* Mastery of modern backend systems (e.g., Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go) coupled with significant frontend architectural experience (e.g., React, Angular, Vue).
* Advanced Infrastructure Experience: Direct production experience provisioning cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* AI Integration Mastery: Deep familiarity with AI-assisted and agentic development workflows, with a strong internal compass for auditing, correcting, and securing agent-generated outputs.

**Bonus Points for:**

**What We Value:**
