title: Manager I - Senior Software Engineer, SAP Quality Management
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients’ lives through science. In oncology, hematology, immunology and cardiovascular disease – and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry – each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer. Join us and make a difference.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
At BMS, digital innovation and Information Technology are central to our vision of transforming patients’ lives through science. To accelerate our ability to serve patients around the world, we must unleash the power of technology. We are committed to being at the forefront of transforming the way medicine is made and delivered by harnessing the power of computer and data science, artificial intelligence, and other technologies to promote scientific discovery, faster decision making, and enhanced patient care.
  
  
The Senior Software Engineer, SAP Quality Management should have strong experience supporting and delivering SAP QM capabilities in an SAP S/4HANA environment, with working knowledge of manufacturing integration points across PP/PI, MM, IM, WM/EWM, MES, and LIMS. This role focuses on quality inspection processes, quality notifications, batch and material quality controls, master data, regulated validation expectations, and operational support in an FDA and GxP environment.
  
  
If you want an exciting and rewarding career that is meaningful, consider joining our diverse team!
  
  
🚀 Shape the Future of Quality Technology | SAP S/4HANA Quality Management Specialist
  
  
Are you ready to make an impact where Quality meets Innovation?
  
  
We're looking for a talented SAP Quality Management Specialist to join our global team and help drive the next generation of intelligent, compliant, and cloud-enabled quality solutions. If you're passionate about SAP QM, digital quality transformation, AI-enabled innovation, and regulated manufacturing excellence, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
💡 Delivering Smart Quality Solutions
  
  

* Design, implement, and support SAP S/4HANA Quality Management solutions across inspection planning, inspection execution, results recording, usage decisions, quality notifications, batch release, and quality certificate processes.
* Own end-to-end delivery across requirements, design, configuration, testing, deployment, validation support, and operational excellence.
* Provide scalable and compliant SAP QM solutions aligned with business and regulatory expectations.

🔗 Connecting the Dots
  
  

* Partners with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Warehouse, Laboratory, and Enterprise Platform teams to deliver integrated quality processes.
* Support integrations with MES, LIMS, Batch Release Hub, BTP/BIAP, and other enterprise platforms.
* Ensure seamless execution of quality processes across manufacturing, inventory, warehouse, and laboratory systems.

☁️ Driving Cloud & AI Transformation
  
  

* Support digital quality transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA and cloud technologies.
* Apply AI, GenAI, automation, process mining, reporting, and analytics to improve operational efficiency, accelerate documentation, strengthen quality compliance, and reduce manual effort across SAP QM processes.
* Identify and support AI-enabled use cases including quality anomaly detection, proactive incident prevention, automated root cause analysis, intelligent incident resolution, quality trend analytics, and process mining insights.
* Use AI/GenAI responsibly in regulated environments to support GxP documentation, test script preparation, validation evidence reviews, audit-readiness checks, and knowledge management while aligning with Information Technology Quality System (ITQS), Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) Teams, data integrity, and validation expectations.
* Contribute to enterprise modernization initiatives involving SAP RISE, BTP/BIAP, and digital manufacturing capabilities.

🛡️ Keeping Us Compliant
  
  

* Support FDA, GxP, Information Technology Quality System (ITQS), and Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) compliant solution delivery, documentation, and operations.
* Produce and maintain GxP documentation including SDLC deliverables, validation plans, requirements traceability, test scripts, testing evidence, deviations, approvals, and audit-ready records in alignment with Information Technology Quality System (ITQS) and Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) expectations.
* Ensure quality processes and system changes meet regulatory, validation, inspection readiness, and compliance requirements.

🤝 Collaborating & Innovating
  
  

* Build strong relationships with Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Validation, Enterprise Platform, IT Business Partners, and external partners.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote adoption of emerging technologies.
* Lead stakeholder communications and influence cross-functional decision making.
* Mentor team members and contribute to organizational capability development.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* ✅ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* ✅ 5–7+ years of SAP QM experience in SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments.
* ✅ Strong experience in Inspection Management, Quality Notifications, Batch Management, Quality Master Data, and Quality Certificates.
* ✅ Experience supporting FDA-regulated and GxP-compliant environments, including Information Technology Quality System (ITQS) / Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) documentation, validation evidence, traceability, change control, and audit readiness.
* ✅ Knowledge of SAP QM integration with PP/PI, MM, IM, WM/EWM, MES, and LIMS.
* ✅ Experience supporting SDLC, validation, testing, deployment, and operational support activities.
* ✅ Ability to apply AI, GenAI, automation, analytics, and process mining to improve SAP QM delivery, documentation quality, incident prevention, testing efficiency, and compliance outcomes.
* ✅ Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills.
* ✅ Passion for continuous learning, innovation, and adoption of emerging technologies.

Bonus Points If You Have...
  
  

* ⭐ Experience with SAP RISE, SAP BTP/BIAP, cloud transformation initiatives, or enterprise integration platforms.
* ⭐ Experience with Batch Release Hub and advanced quality release processes.
* ⭐ Hands-on exposure to AI/GenAI, Copilot-style productivity tools, automation, process mining, predictive analytics, anomaly detection, or intelligent operational support in SAP, Quality, Manufacturing, or regulated environments.
* ⭐ Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated manufacturing industry experience.
* ⭐ Experience supporting global SAP programs and enterprise-scale deployments.

What Makes You Stand Out
  
  
You combine deep SAP Quality Management expertise with a passion for innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. You thrive in complex environments, build trusted partnerships across business and technology teams, and proactively leverage modern technologies such as AI, GenAI, automation, process mining, analytics, and cloud platforms to improve quality processes, reduce manual effort, strengthen compliance, and support better patient outcomes. You bring a growth mindset, strong leadership capabilities, and a commitment to delivering compliant, scalable, and business-focused solutions in a regulated digital environment.
  
  
**Why You Should Apply**
Around the world, we are passionate about making an impact on the lives of patients with serious diseases. Empowered to apply our individual talents and diverse perspectives in an inclusive culture, our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues.
  
  
Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives.

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Responsibilities will include collaborating with the data team and working on both backend microservices & frontend interfaces, crafting solutions that ensure data is processed, analyzed, and visualized in real time.

By joining the CDI team, you will play a key role in shaping the data product application, building intuitive user experiences, scalable APIs, and robust platform capabilities that empower teams worldwide with timely, actionable insights. **Core Areas of Responsibility**

* Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end features across the product, spanning React/Next.js frontend applications and Java Spring Boot backend services.
* Build secure, scalable REST APIs using OpenAPI-first design principles and implement robust authentication and authorization using Okta OIDC, OAuth2, and JWT-based security.

* Manage integrations with Databricks and other data platforms, optimizing API performance, database connectivity, and concurrent processing for large-scale analytics workloads.

* Support cloud-native deployments using Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions, and GitOps practices, while maintaining observability through Datadog and production monitoring tools.
* Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, architectural discussions, performance optimization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

* 8+ years of experience building and delivering modern full-stack applications using Java and React-based technologies.
* Strong expertise in Java 21, Spring Boot, REST API design, and secure application development using OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT authentication.
* Hands-on experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks, including state management, API integration, and component-driven development.
* Solid understanding of SQL-based data platforms and API-driven integrations, with experience optimizing application performance and scalability.
* Experience working with containerized and cloud-native environments, including Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms such as GCP and/or AWS.
* Proven ability to write high-quality, maintainable code supported by automated testing frameworks and engineering best practices.
* Strong collaboration, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with Databricks, GitOps/Flux CD, observability platforms (Datadog), internationalization, or analytics applications is a plus.

title: Associate - Software Engineer Investment Systems and Integration (.Net Engineer)
description:
**Investment and Trading Technology**
**Job Description**
**Our Company**
As a part of Brookfield’s $416B credit platform, Oaktree is a premier credit manager emphasizing an opportunistic, value-oriented, and risk-controlled approach to investing across credit, equity, and real estate.
  
  
Oaktree is committed to cultivating an environment that is collaborative, curious, inclusive and honors diversity of thought. Providing training and career development opportunities and emphasizing strong support for our local communities through philanthropic initiatives are essential to our culture.
  
  
Oaktree is wholly owned by Brookfield, a leading global investment firm with more than $1 trillion in assets under management. Brookfield owns and operates high-quality businesses and real assets that provide essential services and form the backbone of the global economy. It invests on behalf of institutions and individuals around the world across infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity, real estate, and credit.
  
  
For additional information, please visit Oaktree’s website at http://www.oaktreecapital.com/
  
  
**Work Mode:**
Hybrid (3/2)
  
  
**Shift timings:**
1PM-10PM or 2PM-11PM
  
  
**Role purpose.**
We are seeking a senior engineer to build new applications, modernize existing platforms, and design integrations across our investment technology environment. The role will deliver cloud-based solutions on Microsoft Azure and will also help connect the Charles River Development investment management platform with internal and external systems.
  
  
**Core expertise**

* NET engineering, application development and modernization, systems integration, messaging, Microsoft Azure

**Domain**
Investment management, order management, trading, compliance, and investment data
  
  
**Platform Experience**
Broad investment technology experience; Charles River IMS or CRD experience is highly desirable
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support new applications for portfolio management, trading, compliance, risk, data, and other investment technology functions.
* Modernize existing applications by improving architecture, user experience, scalability, maintainability, security, deployment, and cloud readiness.
* Build secure and resilient applications and services using C#, modern .NET, REST APIs, SQL, and Azure-native technologies.
* Design and develop integration services connecting CRD and other investment platforms with security master, accounting, data, risk, reporting, and external service providers.
* Develop event-driven and message-based integrations using technologies such as Azure Service Bus, Event Hubs, Kafka, MQ, or comparable enterprise messaging platforms.
* Implement integrations using APIs, message queues, database interfaces, managed file transfer, SFTP, and batch processes when appropriate.
* Support investment-industry protocols and workflows, including FIX, SWIFT, trade and order messages, positions, cash, security reference data, allocations, and settlement instructions.
* Partner with investment teams, business analysts, CRD, implementation consultants, and internal engineering teams to translate business workflows into supportable technical solutions.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, data contracts, error handling, reconciliation, observability, and operational controls.
* Troubleshoot production issues across interconnected systems, identify root causes quickly, and implement durable fixes.
* Contribute to architecture reviews, code reviews, automated testing, CI CD pipelines, cloud security, and engineering standards.
* Use firm-approved AI-assisted development tools to accelerate solution design, coding, testing, documentation, application modernization, troubleshooting, and code review while maintaining security, data protection, and human oversight.
* Create clear technical documentation, interface specifications, support procedures, and transition materials.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* Eight or more years of software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on work with enterprise systems integration.
* Strong C# and .NET development skills, including service design, asynchronous programming, dependency injection, testing, performance tuning, and production support.
* Experience designing and delivering enterprise applications using sound architecture, reusable components, automated testing, and maintainable engineering practices.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including several of the following: App Service, Functions, Service Bus, Event Hubs, API Management, Key Vault, Azure SQL, SQL Managed Instance, Storage, Data Factory, Monitor, Application Insights, or Kubernetes.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, messaging patterns, event-driven architecture, integration security, identity, encryption, retries, idempotency, and fault tolerance.
* Experience with SQL Server, data modeling, query optimization, stored procedures, and high-volume transactional or investment data.
* Experience building CI CD pipelines and automated tests using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar tooling.
* Practical experience using AI coding assistants and agentic development tools across the software development lifecycle, with the ability to evaluate, test, secure, and take ownership of AI-generated code.
* Ability to diagnose complex issues that span applications, messages, networks, databases, and external vendors.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work directly with global technology and investment stakeholders.

**Preferred Experience**

* Hands-on experience with Charles River IMS or CRD, particularly interfaces, data services, order and trade workflows, compliance, positions, cash, security master, or downstream integration.
* Experience with another institutional investment platform such as Aladdin, SimCorp, Bloomberg AIM, Allvue, or a comparable OMS or PMS.
* Experience modernizing legacy desktop or monolithic applications into web-based, service-oriented, or cloud-native solutions.
* Experience using AI to analyze and modernize legacy applications, generate automated tests, improve technical documentation, identify defects, and increase developer productivity.
* Experience with React, TypeScript, AG Grid, or another modern web application framework is beneficial.
* Knowledge of public fixed income, bank loans, derivatives, foreign exchange, or private credit workflows.
* Experience integrating with custodians, accounting platforms, market data providers, trading venues, data lakes, or enterprise reporting platforms.
* Familiarity with Azure landing zones, infrastructure as code, containers, Kubernetes, and modern observability practices.
* Experience operating business-critical investment systems with global users and time-sensitive trading or compliance processes.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Rapidly develops a working understanding of the firm’s investment workflows, applications, data, and technology landscape.
* Delivers valuable new applications and practical modernization improvements to existing platforms.
* Delivers reliable, secure integrations that are observable, supportable, and reusable across the platform.
* Reduces manual file handling, point-to-point dependencies, and recurring production issues.
* Becomes a trusted technical partner to investment, trading, compliance, operations, and data teams.
* Raises engineering quality through strong coding practices, documentation, automation, and thoughtful technical leadership.

Candidate Profile
  
  
The strongest candidate will combine deep engineering ability with practical integration experience and an understanding of how investment systems exchange orders, trades, positions, cash, securities, and compliance data. This is a broad investment technology engineering role. CRD experience is highly desirable, but the candidate must also be capable of building new applications and modernizing existing ones using .NET and Azure.

title: Principal Application Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking an experienced Principal Platform Software Engineer to provide technical leadership within the AI Platform and Productivity Engineering team. You will drive AI innovation by architecting, developing, and delivering platform capabilities and applications that improve employee productivity across Oracle.
  
  
This role will lead the technical design and implementation of AI control plane and data plane services, Codex enablement, AI plugins and skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools, GPT integrations, memory capabilities, and model routing. You will design and develop backend services and APIs, integrate AI models with enterprise systems, and establish reusable patterns for employee support, knowledge discovery, task automation, and collaboration.
  
  
Working with engineers, product managers, security teams, and partner organizations, you will translate complex requirements into practical technical solutions and guide projects from prototyping through production operation. You will establish architecture and engineering standards, lead design reviews, resolve complex technical issues, and mentor engineers while remaining actively involved in implementation.
  
  
Lead the design of AI cost, token, and usage intelligence capabilities, including telemetry, cost attribution, forecasting, token budgets, threshold alerts, and model-cost optimization. These capabilities will help teams evaluate AI investment and scale adoption safely and efficiently.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture, development, integration, and operation of secure, scalable AI platforms, enterprise applications, backend services, and APIs.
* Drive technical delivery across multiple teams, clarify requirements, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, and resolve dependencies and technical blockers.
* Define and implement AI control plane and data plane architecture, Codex integrations, memory capabilities, and model routing.
* Architect and develop reusable AI plugins, skills, GPT integrations, MCP servers and tools, and enterprise AI workflows.
* Establish technical guidance for integrating AI models with enterprise applications, data sources, and services, including authentication, authorization, and access controls.
* Use AI development tools to accelerate engineering delivery and establish practices for validating generated code and maintaining software quality.
* Lead architecture and code reviews, contribute to complex implementations, and mentor engineers on design, debugging, testing, and operational practices.
* Define runtime, middleware, and API standards that support interoperability and multi-tenant scale, including versioning, compatibility, deprecation, and safe rollout practices.
* Establish automated testing and AI evaluation approaches that assess functionality, output quality, security, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Diagnose and resolve complex cross-service issues, guide performance optimization, and translate employee and stakeholder feedback into product improvements.
* Drive shared observability, service-level objectives, capacity planning, resilience, and operational improvements across AI workloads.
* Lead the design and delivery of AI usage telemetry, cost attribution, forecasting, token budgets, threshold alerts, and reporting that supports informed investment decisions.
* Define and implement model selection and usage controls that balance cost, quality, risk, and performance.
* Establish token and context optimization patterns, including caching, context management, and workload-specific routing.
* Create architectural guidance, migration plans, and adoption playbooks that improve platform consistency and make shared AI capabilities easier to adopt.

**Minimum Job Qualifications Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) or another bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Information Systems, Information Systems, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field, and at least 7 years of software development experience.
* 7+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable distributed systems, backend services, APIs, developer platforms, or cloud services.
* 7+ years of experience developing or operating applications on cloud platforms such as OCI, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* 7+ years of programming experience in one or more languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript or Go.
* 7+ years of experience with relational or NoSQL databases, including data modeling, querying, and integration with backend services.
* Experience leading technical design and delivery across teams, reviewing architecture, and mentoring engineers.
* Experience with API design and integration, automated testing, secure coding, complex debugging, and performance optimization.
* Experience operating production services, including observability, logging, monitoring, incident response, service reliability, and capacity planning.
* Experience collaborating with engineering, architecture, security, product, and business stakeholders to deliver shared platform capabilities.

**Preferred Skills: AI Engineering and Platform Development**

* Experience architecting, developing, or operating AI-enabled applications, generative AI platforms, developer tools, or enterprise productivity solutions.
* Experience using Codex or similar AI coding tools and establishing engineering practices for their effective use.
* Experience with LLM application patterns, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, agents, memory, evaluations, and model routing.
* Experience designing AI control plane and data plane services, reusable plugins, skills, GPT integrations, and enterprise AI enablement platforms.
* Experience designing and developing MCP servers and tools that connect AI applications and agents with enterprise APIs, backend services, and data sources, including authentication, authorization, testing, and observability.
* Experience implementing AI governance, security, privacy, model-access controls, and policy-based model selection.
* Experience establishing AI evaluation frameworks and production monitoring for quality, task completion, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Experience with AI cost optimization, including token and context management, usage telemetry, cost attribution, forecasting, budgeting, caching, and model-performance optimization.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

 Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for passionate engineers to help achieve that mission.
   

  

 Are you passionate about working on cutting edge new technology in a team that embodies the growth mindset? Are you hoping to join an organization which is built on a mission “To empower every person and organization on this planet to achieve more”?
   

  

 We are working on the next generation Hardware/Firmware for server, silicon, and rack infrastructure of Cobalt/Maia systems with a focus on innovation in firmware technology to secure Azure infrastructure for Microsoft and their customers.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Engineer who is passionate about system level thinking, deep debugging, and scalable validation, and who thrives in a cross\-functional, fast paced environment spanning silicon, firmware, GPU, OS, and manufacturing.
   

  

 \#SCHIE
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a Senior Firmware Engineer in the Firmware System Engineering team, you will own platform‑level firmware integration and validation across SoC firmware, GPU, BIOS, BMC, and OS interactions. You will contribute directly to early silicon bring‑up, de‑risking of firmware releases, customer issue debug, and continuous improvement of validation strategies, tooling, and automation—building on the foundations already established by the team.
   

  

* You will be involved with all phases of product development including pre\-silicon, post\-silicon, and platform deployment in the datacenter.

* You will define the Soc and platform validation methodology in terms of required test cases, faster debugging/triaging, reducing manual efforts, with enhanced coverage of concurrent/deployment scenarios
* You will be involved in debugging and solving complex hardware/firmware interface issues.
* You will own coordination, Integration, validation (including validation environment), and debugging of system software comprising of different domains within server architecture (such as SoC FWs, BIOS, BMC etc.)
* You will architect and/or submit requirements to define stimulus, test content, and frameworks that will be utilized to conduct testing and establish coverage.
* You will identify and address inefficiencies and gaps in architecture, testing, execution, etc.
* You will mentor, guide, and help peers and other team members.
* Ability to see system level “big picture” to validate that the integrated firmware/system software aligns to architectural goals of product.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or similar.
* 8\+ years of working experience in large scale system design \& architecture, development, testing, and release and performance tuning.
* Strong problem solving, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.
* Hands on experience in programming in Python or C or C\+\+
* Experience with Platform initialization, Board support package (UEFI/U\-Boot), integration, low level drivers for peripherals such as PCIe, I2C, eMMC, SPI, USB, UARTs as well as Memory Management, Scheduling, Interrupts, and multi\-threading.

* Track and evaluate new Workday integration features and product roadmap changes, assess potential impact to LiveRamp’s ecosystem, and lead experiments or POCs to validate value and feasibility.
* Define and track key success metrics (e.g., integration uptime, incident volume/MTTR, data defect rate, batch processing times, and audit findings) and regularly report progress to stakeholders.
* Act as a trusted advisor to HR, FINs, and business stakeholders on Workday data structures, integration constraints, and downstream impacts to reporting, controls, and compliance.
* Apply AI\-assisted development and troubleshooting tools (e.g., code copilots, log analyzers) to speed up integration design, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high quality.
* Analyze integration telemetry with AI/ML techniques to identify recurring failure patterns, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for smarter alerting and auto\-remediation.


******Your Team Will:******
* Partner with People Operations, Payroll, Finance, Security, and other Business Applications teams to build and maintain the core HR technology foundation that powers the full LiveRamp employee lifecycle—from hire to retire. The team owns the Workday platform roadmap for integrations and is responsible for ensuring data flows are accurate, compliant, and resilient across our global systems landscape.
* You will join a small, highly\-collaborative group of Workday and SaaS application experts who:
* Lead key cross\-functional initiatives such as new country/entity rollouts, M\&A onboarding, org restructuring, and global HR process standardization, ensuring Workday integrations are ready to support business change.
* Provide level 2/3 application and integration support, working closely with our internal help desk and operations teams to triage issues, resolve incidents, and continuously improve the stability and usability of our FIN \& HR technology stack.
* Maintain strong partnerships with vendors and implementation partners, coordinating technical work, managing release impacts, and ensuring external integrations adhere to LiveRamp’s security and privacy requirements.
* Continuously refine our operating model, development standards, and delivery practices (Agile/iterative) so the team can ship high\-quality changes quickly while protecting a mission\-critical production environment.
* Introduce and standardize AI\-enabled practices (log summarization, impact analysis, test generation) that make it easier for the broader team to operate and evolve complex integrations.
* Partner with security, data, and platform teams to safely adopt AI capabilities that improve observability, resilience, and developer productivity in the Workday integrations space.


******About You:******
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, building, and supporting Workday integrations in a production environment, using tools such as EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio, and Workday Web Services/REST APIs.
* Demonstrated experience owning end\-to\-end integration flows across at least two domains (e.g., HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Security, or Financials), including requirements, design, build, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
* You are deeply curious about how systems, data, and business processes fit together, and you naturally dig into payloads, mappings, and logs rather than treating integrations as black boxes.
* You are hungry to learn and a true lifelong learner—you actively seek out new Workday integration features, patterns, and best practices, and you enjoy sharing what you learn with others.
* You are a go\-getter who takes ownership of integrations end\-to\-end, follows through on commitments, and is comfortable driving work forward without needing constant direction.
* You are an experimenter who prototypes, tests, and iterates; you’re comfortable trying new integration patterns or tooling, measuring outcomes, and quickly adjusting based on what you learn.
* You are systems\-minded and enjoy thinking in terms of interfaces, dependencies, and edge cases; you naturally anticipate downstream impacts before changing mappings or schedules in production.
* You are detail\-oriented and disciplined, especially around documentation, testing, monitoring, and change control, and you understand that small integration changes can have big, cross\-system consequences.
* You are a strong collaborator and communicator, able to translate between business language and technical behavior so stakeholders understand both the “why” and the “how” of data flows and changes.
* You are calm under pressure and comfortable troubleshooting ambiguous or complex integration issues, methodically working through hypotheses until you find and fix the root cause.
* You are service\-oriented, finding energy in helping HR, Finance, and business partners be successful through reliable integrations, high\-quality data, and thoughtful support.
* Curious about AI and automation and comfortable learning new tools (e.g., copilots, log analyzers, or analytics platforms) to boost your impact even if you haven’t used them formally before.
* Confident in asking questions, running small AI\-assisted experiments (such as log summarization, test generation, or code suggestions), and using data/AI\-generated insights to challenge the status quo and propose better, safer ways of working.


******Preferred Skills:******
* Workday Pro or Workday Integration/HCM/Financials certification(s), or equivalent advanced hands\-on experience with Workday integration tools (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, REST/SOAP APIs) across both HCM and Financials domains.
* Experience integrating Workday with identity and access platforms (e.g., Okta / Azure AD), ATS/HR tools, payroll/benefits providers, and finance/data platforms (e.g., ERP, billing/collections, Snowflake or similar data warehouse) in a SaaS environment.
* Familiarity with other SaaS applications commonly integrated with Workday at LiveRamp, including ticketing/ITSM, HR service delivery, performance/engagement, learning, and finance\-adjacent tools (e.g., sourcing, CLM, or billing systems), and how they exchange data with Workday HCM and FINS.
* Experience with modern integration and automation tooling, ideally including an iPaaS/middleware platform such as Workato or SnapLogic, plus basic scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell, or Shell) to support data pipelines, file transformations, and operational tasks.
* Exposure to both HR lifecycle processes (hire\-to\-retire, org changes, compensation cycles, security/role lifecycle) and finance processes (Source to Pay, Contract to Cash, GL/close), and how these translate into Workday configuration and integrations.
* Prior participation in Workday bi\-annual releases and major projects, including impact analysis on HR and FINS integrations, regression testing of critical interfaces, and rollout of new capabilities with appropriate monitoring.
* Familiarity with SOX, GDPR, and other privacy/security frameworks that impact HR and finance data, and experience designing integration\-level controls, logging, and audit evidence to support compliance across both domains.
* Experience using AI copilots or automation tools in a development or integration context (e.g., generating code snippets, test cases, or documentation) or a strong desire to ramp quickly.
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms that leverage AI/ML to detect anomalies or predict incidents across integrations and data flows.


******More About Us:******
**LiveRampers are empowered to live our values of committing to shared goals and operational excellence. Connecting LiveRampers to new ideas and to one another is one of our guiding principles—one that informs how we hire, train, and grow our global teams across nine countries and four continents. title: EnergyIP System Engineer (MDM)
description:
**About Us**
 TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long\-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.
   

  

 TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow\-through of an industry leader.
   

  

 We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.
   

  

**Overview**
 The
 **EnergyIP System Engineer** 
 provides technical expertise to project, operations, integration, and product teams to ensure EnergyIP MDM solutions are designed, implemented, integrated, and supported in accordance with industry and MDM best practices.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide technical expertise for EnergyIP MDM implementation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Identify and evaluate industry innovations and best practices in the MDM and utility technology space.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of EnergyIP components including SAP, DTS, Activity Gateway, LVOMS, Framing, UAA, Gateway Services, and MultiSpeak adapters.
* Design, support, and troubleshoot integrations between EnergyIP and IT/OT, AMI, CIS/Billing, OMS, SAP, HES, and other enterprise systems.
* Analyze EnergyIP application logs, transactions, workflows, data errors, and system behavior to perform root\-cause analysis.
* Provide technical guidance on EnergyIP configurations, components, customizations, and solution design.
* Lead technical workshops and translate business/functional requirements into technical designs and integration solutions.
* Prepare technical specifications, configuration documents, interface specifications, GAP analysis, workflow/sequence diagrams, and operational documentation.
* Support EnergyIP customizations, enhancements, deployments, upgrades, patches, and release activities.
* Design and execute unit, integration, regression, functional, performance, and non\-functional testing.
* Provide technical knowledge transfer, training, and operational support documentation to project and client teams.
* Troubleshoot Kafka/Confluent Kafka including topics, partitions, replication, ISR, consumer groups, offsets, lag, message size, connectivity, authorization, and KRaft\-related issues.
* Provide working knowledge of Apache ActiveMQ, including queues, producers, consumers, message delivery, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Perform Oracle SQL/PLSQL analysis and basic\-to\-intermediate troubleshooting of database connectivity, sessions, locks, services, open cursors, tablespaces, and resource issues.
* Administer and troubleshoot RHEL/Linux environments including CPU, memory, disk, processes, services, networking, ports, and application logs.
* Troubleshoot Data refresh, security certificates and upgrade related issues.
* Develop and maintain monitoring and dashboards using Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, Splunk etc.
* Support EnergyIP deployments and integrations across AWS/Azure cloud environments and related services.
* Develop Shell/Python automation scripts, tools, and accelerators to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Provide L2/L3 production support, incident troubleshooting, RCA, performance analysis, and continuous improvement for MDM environments.
* Collaborate with functional consultants, architects, developers, infrastructure, database, integration, security, business, and product teams for end\-to\-end solution delivery.


**Qualifications**
**Qualification \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 7\+ years of experience in MDM, enterprise application engineering, utility technology, or production support.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on EnergyIP/MDM experience preferred.
* Experience in electricity, gas, or water utility environments is preferred.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of EnergyIP MDM platform and its components.
* Strong knowledge of Java with working knowledge of Python and Shell scripting.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle SQL/PLSQL and RDBMS concepts.
* Working knowledge of Kafka/Confluent Kafka, KRaft, and ActiveMQ.
* Strong RHEL/Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, web services, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Working knowledge of security certificate.
* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Kibana, and/or Elasticsearch.
* Working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure is preferred.
* Good understanding of enterprise architecture, design principles, integration patterns, scalability, high availability, and system troubleshooting.
* Experience with CI/CD and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools such as Git, Harness, Terraform, or CloudFormation is an advantage.

All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
   

  

 The complete job description and application are available on TRC’s career site.

title: Data Architect, Duck Creek/Guidewire
description:
**Job Description**
 This individual will collaborate closely with other Verisk teams, customers, and implementation partners to establish best\-in\-class data modeling standards, guide data persistence practices, define canonical structures, and ensure seamless integration with policy administration systems and related downstream applications. The ideal candidate combines deep P\&C industry knowledge with hands\-on technical expertise across data modeling, databases, React\-based UI integration, REST API design, and cloud\-native architecture.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Data Architecture \& Strategy
* Design, evolve, and maintain a canonical insurance data model (CIDM) that supports ISO ERC and proprietary carrier products, and custom extensions.
* Define and enforce standards for data capture, persistence, normalization, and extensibility, ensuring alignment with the FAST P\&C Platform’s architecture.
* Architect and govern effective dating, versioning, and historical tracking strategies across coverages, forms, schedules, exposures, and hierarchies.
* Model complex insurance relationships including 1\-1, 1\-many, many\-many, cross\-product linkages, and multi\-level policy structures.
* Establish and communicate best practices for product\-agnostic and highly extensible model design.
* Hands\-on Architecture \& Solution Design
* Define end\-to\-end technical architecture for integration with downstream systems (rating, analytics, reporting).
* Design and optimize relational schemas in SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including indexing strategies, partitioning approaches, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
* Partner with developers to build and refine .NET\-based services that implement business logic, data access patterns, and platform APIs.
* Define and maintain REST API contracts for consistent, secure, and scalable data interchange.
* Work with UI teams to align React components and workflows with underlying data structures.
* Contribute to end\-to\-end solution architecture including AWS cloud deployments, microservices, and integrations.
* Governance, Metadata, and Standards
* Establish and maintain data governance frameworks including data contracts, naming standards, lineage tracking, and data quality controls.
* Implement standards for extensibility (typed extension tables, JSON attributes) and enforce data quality rules.
* Drive compliance with ISO updates and carrier\-specific filings through version\-controlled mapping rules.
* Oversee management of product registries, mapping rules, configuration metadata, and product lineage.
* Platform, Implementation Partnership, and Stakeholder Collaboration
* Partner with business analysts, product managers, and insurance SMEs to translate business requirements into robust data structures.
* Serve as the data architecture authority for the FAST P\&C Platform team.
* Represent data architecture in customer implementations, conduct workshops, and validate technical assumptions.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex data issues during onboarding, testing, and internal and external deployments.
* Collaborate with Verisk product teams, enterprise architects, and data engineers to ensure seamless integration and operationalization of the data model.
* Communicate technical risks, trade\-offs, and opportunities to leadership in clear business terms.
* Leadership \& Mentoring
* Provide technical leadership to developers, modelers, DBAs, and data engineers.
* Mentor teams on data design principles, insurance concepts, API patterns, and cloud architecture.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders, client partners, and executives.
* Foster a culture of innovation, scalability, accountability, and performance.


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in data architecture, modeling, and solution design within the P\&C insurance domain.
* Deep understanding of policy, product, coverage, rating, and forms data structures.
* Proven expertise in canonical data models, handling complex hierarchies, and implementing effective dating/versioning.
* Experience working with or integrating major policy administration platforms (FAST, Guidewire, Duck Creek, etc.).
* Strong knowledge of SQL Server and PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, performance tuning).
* Hands\-on experience with .NET (C\#, ASP.NET) for enterprise\-grade services.
* Experience with React for building dynamic UI components.
* Expertise in REST API design, including security, versioning, and scalability.

title: QA Lead (Copado Robotic testing)
description:
**What You Will Do**
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.
 **Amgen is seeking a QA Lead – Salesforce \& Copado Robotic Testing** 
 to lead quality engineering and testing capabilities for enterprise Salesforce platforms, including OneCRM and its integrated ecosystem. This role will be responsible for ensuring high\-quality, reliable, and compliant application releases through a combination of
 **manual, functional, integration, regression, and automated testing using Copado Robotic Testing (CRT)** 
 .
   

  

 The QA Lead will own the end\-to\-end testing strategy and execution, lead cross\-functional QA teams, and partner closely with business, product, engineering, architecture, and production support teams to ensure releases meet functional, technical, and quality expectations while supporting Amgen’s mission to serve patients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**QA \& Testing Leadership**
* Lead end\-to\-end QA activities for Salesforce applications and their integrated ecosystem, ensuring high\-quality releases with minimal production defects.
* Define and drive the overall test strategy, test planning, execution, defect management, and reporting across releases.
* Lead testing activities across functional, integration, system, regression, end\-to\-end, and user acceptance testing phases.
* Ensure appropriate test coverage based on business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, technical designs, and integration specifications.
* Serve as the primary QA point of contact for product, business, engineering, and technology stakeholders.


**Manual \& Functional Testing**
* Lead comprehensive manual testing of Salesforce applications, including business processes, workflows, validations, security, profiles, permission sets, and user experience.
* Design, review, and maintain test scenarios, test cases, test data, and expected results.
* Ensure adequate coverage of positive, negative, boundary, exception, and end\-to\-end business scenarios.
* Validate complex Salesforce business processes spanning multiple objects, personas, applications, and integrations.
* Drive exploratory and risk\-based testing for business\-critical capabilities.


**Copado Robotic Testing \& Test Automation**
* Lead adoption and implementation of Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) for Salesforce test automation.
* Design and maintain reusable, scalable, and maintainable automated test suites using Copado Robotic Testing.
* Identify appropriate manual regression scenarios for automation based on business criticality, repeatability, and ROI.
* Establish and continuously improve the automated regression test suite to increase coverage and reduce manual testing effort.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD and release pipelines wherever applicable.
* Monitor automation execution results, investigate failures, and ensure timely maintenance of automated test scripts.
* Define standards and best practices for Copado Robotic Testing development, execution, and maintenance.


**Integration \& End\-to\-End Testing**
* Lead end\-to\-end testing across Salesforce and integrated enterprise platforms, including MuleSoft APIs, Databricks, and other upstream/downstream applications.
* Validate API integrations, data transformations, interface processing, error handling, and data reconciliation.
* Coordinate testing dependencies across multiple application and technology teams.
* Ensure critical business journeys are validated across the complete application and integration landscape.


**Defect Management \& Quality Governance**
* Establish and enforce standardized defect management, triage, prioritization, and closure processes.
* Lead defect triage sessions with business, development, and product teams.
* Ensure defects are appropriately categorized based on severity, priority, business impact, and release risk.
* Track defect trends, leakage, reopen rates, and recurring quality issues.
* Drive root cause analysis for escaped production defects and implement preventive actions.
* Establish appropriate quality gates and release\-readiness criteria before production deployment.


**Test Planning \& Release Management**
* Develop comprehensive test plans and testing schedules aligned with sprint and release timelines.
* Estimate QA effort and determine appropriate testing capacity based on release scope and complexity.
* Coordinate QA activities across Agile sprints, major releases, hotfixes, patches, and production maintenance releases.
* Assess testing risks and proactively communicate potential impacts to release timelines.
* Provide clear QA sign\-off and release\-readiness recommendations based on test results, open defects, and residual risks.
* Support post\-production validation and hypercare testing following major releases.


**Quality Engineering \& Continuous Improvement**
* Drive the transition from traditional testing toward a quality engineering and automation\-first approach.
* Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual testing through automation.
* Improve test efficiency through reusable test assets, automation, standardized processes, and optimized test data management.
* Establish QA standards, templates, metrics, and best practices across the delivery organization.
* Leverage defect and production incident trends to continuously strengthen regression coverage.
* Promote shift\-left testing, enabling early QA involvement during requirements, refinement, and solution\-design activities.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, Developers, Scrum Masters, and Production Support teams throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Participate in requirements and user\-story refinement to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are clear, testable, and complete.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream application teams to coordinate integration and end\-to\-end testing.
* Act as the bridge between business and technology teams for quality\-related discussions.
* Communicate testing progress, risks, defects, dependencies, and release readiness to leadership and key stakeholders.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead and mentor onshore/offshore QA and test automation teams.
* Drive appropriate allocation of QA resources based on release priorities and workload.

Knowledge of Administration, Polaris, Workflow, Anaplan Data Orchestrator would be a significant advantage. Strong grasp of planning processes such as forecasting, demand shaping, and S\&OP. title: Senior Software AIML Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
**AI Security Incubation \& Innovation**
**Security and Risk Engineering**
****About The Team****
 The Security and Risk Engineering organization builds scalable, AI\-powered security solutions that reduce risk and protect ServiceNow and its customers. We value AI\-first thinking, clean architecture, intuitive experiences, and a culture of continuous learning.
   

  

 This is a zero\-to\-one incubation. We’re building a new class of exposure analysis that ranks security work by exploitability—where an attacker could realistically get in—rather than raw severity. The architecture is evolving, and this role helps define what good looks like.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Senior Software Engineer – AI Native Development, you will design, build, and operate next\-generation AI\-powered applications and platforms. You will combine strong full\-stack software engineering fundamentals with hands\-on expertise in modern AI/ML technologies to build production\-grade experiences powered by LLMs, agents, retrieval, and intelligent automation.
   

  

 You will work across the technology stack—from user experiences and APIs to distributed services, data and retrieval systems, AI/ML workflows, and cloud infrastructure. You will be expected to use AI\-native development practices to accelerate engineering productivity while maintaining high standards for scalability, reliability, security, and quality.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex problems end\-to\-end and is excited about applying AI as a core engineering capability, not simply as an add\-on to traditional software.
   

  

****What You'll Own****
* Design and build end\-to\-end full\-stack applications, including frontend experiences, backend services, APIs, data layers, and cloud\-native infrastructure.
* Build production\-grade AI/ML\-powered capabilities using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, semantic search, agentic workflows, and intelligent decision\-making.
* Design and implement agentic architectures, including tool calling, orchestration, planning loops, memory, context management, and failure recovery.
* Develop reliable AI\-powered APIs and services that integrate frontier models and enterprise data securely and efficiently.
* Build retrieval and grounding pipelines using vector search, hybrid search, semantic retrieval, re\-ranking, and contextual enrichment.
* Establish evaluation and observability mechanisms to measure AI quality, accuracy, latency, cost, reliability, and safety.
* Take features from concept and prototype through production deployment and ongoing operation, with ownership of quality and reliability.
* Work with product, design, platform, data, security, and other engineering teams to translate ambiguous problems into scalable technical solutions.
* Contribute to architecture and design decisions, code reviews, engineering standards, and technical direction.
* Mentor engineers and help raise the bar on full\-stack engineering and production AI development practices.


****What You'll Do****
* Design and develop scalable, maintainable frontend applications and backend services using REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, event\-driven services, and distributed systems.
* Work with modern frontend technologies such as React, TypeScript, JavaScript, or equivalent frameworks.
* Build cloud\-native applications with strong focus on scalability, performance, reliability, and security.
* Own software delivery across development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production operations.
* Build applications leveraging LLMs, generative AI, embeddings, RAG, semantic search, and agentic workflows.
* Integrate frontier AI models and SDKs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or equivalent platforms.
* Apply prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, context engineering, and model selection to real\-world applications.
* Design agent workflows that can reason, use tools, retrieve information, execute actions, and recover from failures.
* Build AI evaluation frameworks and automated tests to measure model and application quality.
* Balance model capability, accuracy, latency, scalability, and cost when selecting and integrating AI models.
* Apply AI safety, security, privacy, governance, and guardrail practices to production AI systems.
* Explore and adopt emerging AI technologies and rapidly turn promising capabilities into production\-ready solutions.


**AI\-Native Engineering Practices**
* Use AI\-assisted development tools and coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, or equivalent tools as part of the software development lifecycle.
* Apply AI to improve engineering productivity across coding, testing, debugging, documentation, code review, and system design.
* Develop effective workflows for collaborating with coding agents while maintaining engineering quality and accountability.
* Help establish best practices for AI\-native software development across the engineering organization.


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production\-quality software.
* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Hands\-on experience developing full\-stack applications, with strength in both frontend and backend engineering.
* Strong programming experience in one or more of Python, Java, Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, or similar languages.
* Experience with modern frontend development, preferably React and TypeScript or equivalent technologies.
* Experience designing and building cloud\-native applications, scalable APIs, microservices, databases, and distributed systems.
* Hands\-on experience building or integrating AI/ML\-powered applications in production or near\-production environments.
* Practical understanding of modern AI concepts including LLMs, embeddings, RAG, vector databases/search, semantic search, agents, tool calling, and model evaluation.
* Experience integrating one or more frontier AI model platforms/SDKs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google.
* Ability to take an AI/ML prototype and turn it into a reliable, scalable, maintainable production solution.
* Strong debugging, problem\-solving, and system\-design skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, design, data, and platform teams.
* Demonstrated ownership of technical decisions and a track record of improving code quality and engineering practices.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience designing multi\-agent systems and agent orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with AI evaluation, observability, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience with vector databases, hybrid retrieval, re\-ranking, knowledge graphs, or enterprise search.
* Experience with ML pipelines, MLOps, model monitoring, or inference optimization.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Windsurf.
* Contributions to open\-source AI/ML or developer tooling projects.
* Experience working on cybersecurity, identity, risk, enterprise SaaS, or other complex domain platforms is a plus.


****Qualifications****
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience designing and delivering production software systems.
* Experience building or integrating AI/ML\-powered applications in a production or near\-production environment.
* Modern AI experience: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, agentic workflows, model evaluation, or AI observability.
* Strong programming experience in Python and/or Java, Go, or a similar language.
* Cloud\-native technologies, distributed systems, APIs, databases, and scalable architectures.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Cybersecurity or security\-product experience is a plus.


****What Success Looks Like****
 In this role, you will be successful when you can:
   

  

* Build end\-to\-end: Take a product requirement from UI and API design through AI services, data, deployment, and production operation.
* Build AI\-native: Understand when and how to apply LLMs, agents, retrieval, and other AI capabilities to solve problems effectively.
* Engineer for production: Move beyond prototypes and deliver systems that are scalable, observable, secure, reliable, and maintainable.
* Think across the stack: Understand the trade\-offs between user experience, application architecture, data, AI models, infrastructure, cost, and performance.
* Raise the engineering bar: Influence architecture, mentor engineers, and establish effective practices for building AI\-native software.


 FD21
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

**Work Personas**
 We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
   

  

**Accommodations**
 We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
   

  

**Export Control Regulations**
 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

description:

 If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Sub Value Stream Tech Lead.**
**The Opportunity**
 Group Functions Technology is a Global Function encompassing platforms that are vital to the bank’s operation. Our mission is to “ Enable, Protect and Delight ” HSBC’s global businesses.
   

  

 Within Group Functions Technology, Risk and Compliance Technology is building a real\-time decisioning capability that can evaluate transaction events, coordinate multiple detection techniques and select the right preventative action within strict sub\-second latency budgets. Sitting above HSBC's real\-time data feeds, the platform will orchestrate rules, machine\-learning models, graph capabilities, foundation models and approved bounded agent functions across real\-time, near\-real\-time and asynchronous execution tiers.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Define and build HSBC’s real\-time decisioning and model\-orchestration platform for financial crime prevention
* Translate financial\-crime policy and customer\-outcome requirements into deterministic, explainable and auditable technical decisions
* Architect a resilient runtime that selects execution capabilities, sequences and parallelism and calibrates outputs into a traceable decision
* Engineer low\-latency, highly available distributed systems with explicit time budgets, fallbacks, circuit breakers and safe degradation
* Own the technical direction across model execution orchestration and decision strategy while keeping them as clearly separated platform capabilities
* Emphasize Java and Python, event\-driven architecture, Kafka or equivalent streaming platforms, containers, Kubernetes and cloud\-native engineering.
* Champion AI\-enabled engineering and an agentic SDLC by embedding approved AI coding assistants and autonomous engineering agents with human oversight, traceability and governance
* Partner with CIOs, business leaders, architects, model owners, risk management, cybersecurity and engineering teams across Risk and Compliance to deliver safely at scale
* Mentor engineer teams and share knowledge through production code, design reviews, reference implementations and cross\-team technical standards.
* Automate delivery and operation from the outset, including CI/CD, policy and model versioning, performance testing, failure injection, decision replay, rollback and controlled production releases.


**What you will need to succeed in the role** 
 :
   

  

* As a Senior Technologist you should have hands\-on engineering experience delivering critical production code and reference implementations
* Demonstrate deep mastery of Java or Python including high\-performance services, concurrency and distributed workflow or orchestration engines
* Proven experience in designing low\-latency distributed systems including API and event contracts, schema evolution, idempotency, back\-pressure, load shedding, timeouts, retries and graceful degradation
* Experience in cloud native engineering, Kakfa or equivalent streaming platforms, containers, Kubernetes
* Experienced and comfortable operating in a highly regulated environment and the security and control framework this necessitates.
* Ability to communicate technology ideas clearly to business / senior leaders
* Ability to build trusted relationship \& collaborate well beyond their immediate team (including model risk owners, architecture / platform / security / engineering teams, cross ‑ organization and at times external stakeholders / industry)


**You’ll achieve more at HSBC.**
 HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. **Job Description**
 The Core Engineering
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Core Engineering builds and operates the platforms, applications, data solutions, models, and analytics that power critical processes for The Core divisions of the firm (e.g., Risk, responsible for the risk profile of firm activities; Controllers, responsible for the financial control and reporting obligations; Compliance, responsible for the firm’s compliance, regulatory, and reputational risks; Corporate Treasury, responsible for the firm’s liquidity, funding, balance sheet, etc.; and Human Capital Management, responsible for attracting, developing, and managing a global workforce). A centralized engineering structure in support of The Core enables a common platform model and operating framework that promotes consistent governance and scalable solutions, leveraging cloud, AI, and machine learning for innovation and efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000\+ engineers and strats deliver engineering, data, analytics, and quantitative capabilities within six business units:
   

  

* Metrics \& Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions
* The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
* Financials \& Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
* Non\-Financial Risk \& Controls: responsible for non\-financial risk and control processes
* Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk


**What We Do**
 At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.
   

  

 We are looking for an senior engineer who is passionate about software development, technology and building solutions to enable critical financial businesses to function and optimize their effectiveness. We need someone with the experience to build cloud based applications and has the ability to grow into leadership roles to lead a team of engineers who can deliver solutions that delight our clients.
   

  

 Payment processing has recently become one of the key areas of focus for financial services and fintech industry. It is at the center of innovation for automating and streamlining flows to meet the needs of a variety of clients across the globe.
   

  

 Our Payments Engineering team builds and supports the systems that provide a comprehensive payment solution to the firm’s needs across institutional, consumer (Marcus) and internal (treasury) clients. These systems manage the entire payment lifecycle – from initiation to execution \- of all inbound and outbound cash flows for the firm across 60 currencies spanning multiple payment electronic networks and platforms globally.
   

  

 Governing these critical flows is not a responsibility we take lightly. We, therefore, are seeking capable engineers who are up to the task of designing, building, testing, deploying and supporting these systems with a special focus on scale, resiliency and high availability. Our technology stack includes Java, Hibernate, Spring Boot, Angular, DB2, MongoDB, Oracle, GS Search (proprietary search tool), Elastic search, and Kafka, ECS, AWS cloud application developers.
   

  

 Our global team is well\-balanced in size and experience levels, enabling you to maximize your potential. We have both the senior and junior developers who will work with you, challenge you, and teach you along the way. Our engineers often blur the lines between front end, back end, DevOps, and product management, and we value developers who can cover a breadth of skills while also cultivating areas of expertise. A willingness to learn new languages, technologies and the business will be key to your success.
   

  

**How Will You Fulfill Your Potential**
* You will build and develop with a team of world\-class engineers.
* Hand on – initially more focus on delivery and show the potential to grow into a team lead.
* You will forge strong relationships with our clients in Operations, Trading and Sales as we deliver solutions that are critical to our business.
* The team you will join is a large community of like\-minded technologists in a very flat structure.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Degree in any STEM subject (or equivalent work experience).
* 5\.5 \- 8 years of experience.
* Excellent technical, analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills, with proven ability to build and motivate a team.
* Experienced stakeholder manager.
* Professional experience coding in Java.
* Cloud development – AWS


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Degree in computer science.
* Experience working in financial services industry.
* Experience with payment systems.
* Experience with database technologies.
* AWS Certified Developer – Associate


**Goldman Sachs Engineering Culture**
 At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don’t just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a world of opportunity at the speed of markets.
   

  

 Engineering is at the critical center of our business, and our dynamic environment requires innovative strategic thinking and immediate, real solutions. Want to push the limit of digital possibilities? Start here!

description:
**The Next Level of Fire \& Life Safety Leadership**

Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With industry\-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting\-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. **About This Role**
 The Researcher will play a critical role in developing innovative, early‑stage (early TRL) technologies that support Kidde’s long‑term leadership in residential fire and life safety. This role focuses on strategic, emerging, and disruptive technologies, contributing foundational research that enables future product platforms. This is a hands‑on, highly technical role ideal for someone who thrives in exploratory research, rapid prototyping, and cross‑disciplinary experimentation
