title: Software Engineer 2
description:
**Overview**
 Commercial Engineering \& AI (CEAI) partners closely with stakeholders to accelerate the transformation of Microsoft’s commercial business into a frontier organization. We bring together AI\-native engineering, modern platforms, and deep commercial insight to reimagine how work gets done—at scale and with impact.
   

  

 Within this context, the Scale and Partner AI Experiences (SPAI) organization is at the forefront of transforming Microsoft’s sales ecosystem through AI\-first innovation. Our mission is to build intelligent, scalable platforms that power partner and customer success, accelerating Microsoft’s commercial growth through modern, AI\-driven experiences.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer, you will design and build AI\-native systems that go beyond supporting workflows—they intelligently transform them. You will work across data, systems, and agentic workflows to enable faster insights, smarter decisions, and higher productivity across the global sales ecosystem.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Understand end\-to\-end business processes, workflows, and data flows across the Microsoft sales ecosystem, and identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and agentify those experiences.
* Rapidly prototype and deliver POCs and iterate on solutions using an experimentation\-driven engineering approach.
* Design, build, and ship scalable, production\-quality features and intelligent services using modern engineering practices.
* Collaborate across teams to integrate systems, data, and signals into cohesive AI\-powered workflows.
* Debug, troubleshoot, and improve system reliability and performance using telemetry and diagnostics.
* Build secure, compliant, and responsible AI solutions ready for production scale.
* Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and engineering excellence.


**Qualifications**
**Required (Basic):**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science engineering, or related field.
* 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience with hands\-on coding in languages such as C\#, Java, Python, or React.
* Proficiency in AI\-native development — working within Agent Harnesses (GitHub Copilot CLI, Coding Agents), authoring Markdown specs/ADRs and YAML configs as Agent\-consumable inputs, orchestrating multi\-step Agentic workflows across the SDLC, and reviewing Agent\-generated code and PRs with production\-grade rigor.
* Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, and scalable systems.
* Experience building, testing, debugging, and maintaining production\-quality software, following established engineering practices as well as leveraging large language models (LLMs).
* Solid problem\-solving and technical judgment skills, with the ability to design scoped solutions, debug complex issues, and improve service performance.


**Preferred**
* Experience with cloud platforms and distributed/service\-oriented architecture.
* Familiarity with reliability, monitoring, and performance optimization practices.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience in design reviews.
* Passion for building impactful, user\-facing AI solutions.

title: Sr Associate Software Engineer
description:
**What You Will Do**
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. As a Senior Associate Software Engineer at Amgen, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Salesforce applications to meet business needs. You will collaborate with a team of software engineers, participate in the full software development life cycle, and ensure the delivery of high\-quality code and solutions. Your strong programming skills, problem\-solving abilities, and attention to detail will contribute to the development of robust and scalable software solutions.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Design and implement Salesforce Lightning components using LWC and Aura frameworks to enhance platform functionality and user experience.
* Configure roles, profiles, permission sets, and region\-wise security and sharing settings to ensure appropriate access control across user groups.
* Create and customize standard and custom objects, page layouts, validation rules, record types, and formula fields to meet business requirements.
* Develop and maintain Apex classes, triggers, Visualforce pages, and custom controllers as needed.
* Design and implement integrations between Salesforce and external/internal systems using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware.
* Utilize Copado to manage source control, deployments, pipeline automation, and environment management in support of release processes
* Apply Salesforce development best practices to ensure code reusability, maintainability, and compliance with performance and scalability standards.
* Collaborate with quality and validation teams to develop test scripts and execute functional and system testing in regulated environments.
* Troubleshoot and resolve development or configuration issues during QA, UAT, and production support cycles.
* Participated in design reviews, sprint planning, and code reviews, contributing to Agile/Scrum ceremonies and delivery cycles.
* Maintain documentation including technical design, solution architecture, and release notes for enhancements and projects.
* Ensure all development work adheres to GxP, CSV, and compliance requirements, including documentation traceability and audit readiness.
* Collaborate with business analysts, QA, validation, and infrastructure teams to deliver reliable and compliant Salesforce solutions.
* Stay up to date with Salesforce platform releases, new features, and emerging technologies to drive innovation and platform optimization.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications:**
* Master’s degree and 4 to 7 years of Computer Science, IT or related field experience OR
* Bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of Computer Science, IT or related field experience OR
* Diploma and 7 to 9 years of Computer Science, IT or related field experience


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field
* 5\+ years of experience in Salesforce development including Lightning Components, Apex, Visualforce, and platform configuration
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce security models, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field\-level access
* Solid hands\-on experience of implementing Salesforce Configurations, Apex, LWC, Aura
* Strong understanding of Salesforce object model, workflows, validation rules, and triggers
* Experience with Salesforce integrations using RESTful and SOAP web services
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD tools, and version control systems like Git
* Proven experience working with Copado for deployment automation, CI/CD pipeline configuration, and release management
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot issues across multiple environments
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams supporting enterprise applications
* Salesforce platform certifications are a strong plus


**Must\-Have Skills:**
* Proficient in developing custom solutions using Salesforce Lightning Components (Aura and LWC), Apex classes, Visualforce pages, and Apex triggers, including batch classes and schedulers with exception handling.
* Experience configuring standard/custom objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, roles, profiles, permission sets, and region\-specific sharing and access models.
* Hands\-on experience integrating Salesforce with internal and external systems using REST and SOAP APIs; familiarity with middleware for system interoperability.
* Familiarity with DevOps tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines beyond Copado, contributing to efficient and traceable deployments.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot platform issues, optimize performance, and explore emerging Salesforce features for continuous improvement.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills:**
* Skilled in using Copado for deployment automation, CI/CD pipeline configuration, source control management, and environment management across multiple sandboxes.
* Experience participating in Agile/Scrum teams, with knowledge of sprint planning, retrospectives, and iterative development workflows.
* Deep understanding of Salesforce object model, workflows, formula fields, and Apex triggers customizing and extend platform functionality.
* Exposure to pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare industries with an understanding of compliance and patient safety requirements.


**Professional Certifications**
* Salesforce Platform Developer I (required)
* Salesforce Platform Developer II (preferred)
* Salesforce Administrator Certification (plus)
* Certified Scrum Developer or SAFe Agile (optional)
* Certified CSV or Validation Professional (optional)


**Soft Skills:**
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Strong communication and interpersonal abilities
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Ability to prioritize tasks and work under pressure
* Team\-oriented with a proactive and collaborative mindset
* Willingness to mentor junior developers and promote best practices
* Adaptable to changing project requirements and evolving technology

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**
 As part of this team, you will work on mission\-critical platform services that power GitHub's global developer ecosystem. The team owns and operates high\-scale distributed systems, including GitHub Packages, GitHub Pages, Email Services, and other foundational developer experience tools and platforms. These services support billions of requests, stringent reliability requirements, and developer workflows used worldwide.
   

  

 As a Senior Software Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for some of GitHub's most challenging scale, reliability, and operational excellence initiatives. You will lead design and implementation, make sound architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and collaborate across GitHub and Microsoft to deliver durable platform capabilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the design, development, and operation of highly available distributed systems that power critical GitHub platform services.
* Drive architecture and technical direction for scalable backend services and platform capabilities using modern engineering practices, automation, and observability.
* Define and deliver improvements to service reliability, performance, latency, capacity, security, and operational efficiency for mission\-critical workloads.
* Own complex features and services throughout their lifecycle, from requirements and design reviews through implementation, rollout, production support, and live\-site excellence.
* Build automation and reusable platform capabilities that reduce operational overhead and improve engineering productivity across teams.
* Lead investigations of complex production issues across distributed systems, storage, networking, and service infrastructure, and drive durable corrective actions.
* Partner with engineers and stakeholders across GitHub and Microsoft to align technical strategy and deliver large\-scale platform investments and modernization efforts.
* Mentor engineers, raise engineering standards through design and code reviews, and leverage AI\-assisted workflows to improve software delivery, testing, incident response, and operational excellence.


**Qualifications**
 Required
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems.
* Expert coding skills in one or more programming languages such as C\#, Java, Go, C\+\+, Python, Ruby, or similar, with a track record of delivering maintainable production software.
* Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, concurrency, API design, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Proven experience designing and operating large\-scale backend services, cloud systems, or platform infrastructure with high availability and reliability requirements.
* Strong experience with databases, caching systems, messaging technologies, service\-oriented architectures, and observability practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead ambiguous technical projects, influence architecture across teams, mentor engineers, and communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred**
* Experience with public cloud platforms, Kubernetes, and containerized services in production.
* Experience architecting high\-throughput, highly available internet\-scale systems and planning for capacity, resilience, and disaster recovery.
* Strong knowledge of observability, incident management, reliability engineering, security, and production operations.
* Experience with GitHub, CI/CD systems, developer platforms, package management ecosystems, or internal platform products.
* Familiarity with Go, Ruby, MySQL, Kubernetes, distributed storage, service infrastructure, and large\-scale system migrations.


 What Makes This Role Exciting
   

  

* Lead work on services operating at hyperscale, with billions of requests and global developer impact.
* Own production systems where reliability, performance, security, and operational excellence directly affect millions of developers.
* Shape technical direction and drive end\-to\-end engineering outcomes across complex, multi\-team initiatives.
* Collaborate with and influence GitHub engineering teams worldwide while mentoring other engineers.

**Role Overview** 




 As Senior Software Engineer you are responsible for ensuring the stability, reliability,
 



 and continuous improvement of Manufacturing and Laboratory Systems for ConvaTec. You will be providing support, maintenance, and enhancements for global systems including Maximo CMMS, Critical Manufacturing MES, Labvantage LIMS, Labelling \& Artwork Management Systems and Delmia Apriso MES.
 



 This is to enable efficient production operations and rapid issue resolution. The ideal candidate combines technical troubleshooting skills with a strong understanding of manufacturing processes and a commitment to delivering excellent service to business users.
 



  





**NOTE: Role will support EU/US time zones. Flexibility in working hours will be expected** 




  





**Key responsibilities and authority** 



* Deliver second\-line support for key manufacturing and laboratory platforms, addressing incidents, service requests, and user queries in a timely manner.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve system issues, escalating complex problems as needed.
* Perform routine system maintenance, upgrades, and patches to ensure optimal performance and compliance.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (Production, GQO, QA, IT) to analyze and resolve issues.
* Support System Owners with Application Delivery project activities, ensuring project timelines are met.
* Document support activities, solutions, and system modifications for traceability reporting and compliance.

* Provide training and support to users and support teams, promoting best practices and system adoption.
* Stay updated on the latest vendor software developments and recommend improvements and upgrades.

* Assist in task estimation, planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Apply agile methodologies and principles to manage projects and deliver value quickly and efficiently.

* At least 5 years of experience in applications of IT support, with a focus on regulatory and Quality Solutions.
* Hands on experience with Critical Manufacturing System, Maximo CMMS or Delmia Apriso is preferred
* Experience supporting and maintaining manufacturing or laboratory platforms
* Proficient communication skills to align with Business Users

* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and workflows.

* Bachelor's in Engineering, Software development, Information technology, or a related field. Advanced degrees or certifications are a plus.

title: Senior SWE Manager
description:
**Overview**
 The Windows \+ Devices Fundamentals team is responsible for the reliability, compatibility, performance, battery life, and sustainability of Windows devices. Our work spans hardware and OEM partners, the operating system, and application layers – helping protect, manage, and enhance the fundamentals of the Windows ecosystem.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Software Engineering Manager** 
 to lead a team developing the next generation of Windows device optimizations. As advances in AI, silicon, and software create new opportunities, you will guide technical direction, develop engineering talent, and drive execution that helps make exceptional device fundamentals a defining feature of Windows PCs.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an engineering leader who combines strong systems expertise with a passion for developing people, solving complex technical problems, and delivering innovations that improve how people live, work, and play.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Guide the team in using telemetry, experimentation, and trace analysis to understand software and hardware behavior, identify opportunities, and measure impact at scale.
* Lead complex, cross\-stack investigations involving low\-level debugging, performance analysis, reliability, and power optimization.
* Own the team's technical roadmap for Windows Fundamentals improvements, contribute to architecture, and align priorities with customer and business needs.
* Manage the design and delivery of well\-defined solutions spanning hardware, firmware, operating\-system, service, and application layers.
* Maintain a high engineering bar for quality, security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational excellence while driving predictable execution.
* Use data and customer insights to evaluate tradeoffs, manage risk, prioritize the team's work, and deliver measurable outcomes.
* Hire, coach, and retain a diverse team of engineers while collaborating with Windows teams, OEMs, silicon vendors, and hardware partners across the ecosystem.


**Technologies**
**The Team Works With Technologies Including**
* C, C\+\+, C\#, Python, scripting and automation tools
* WinDbg, Windows Performance Analyzer, and ETW tracing
* Cosmos, Kusto, Asimov, and Azure\-based trace\-processing systems
* Power BI, statistics, and large\-scale telemetry analysis
* Machine learning and AI models


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 10\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
+ OR equivalent experience.

* 2\+ years of people\-management experience leading software engineers, including coaching, performance management, and career development.
* Experience leading the design, development, and optimization of complex system software or platform capabilities.
* Demonstrated success leading a team and delivering reliable products or services at scale.
* Solid technical judgment in software architecture, systems design, debugging, and engineering tradeoffs.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize work using data, and influence technical and product decisions across teams.
* Experience managing a team responsible for operating\-system architecture, system\-level development, or platform engineering.
* Solid knowledge of Windows internals, performance, reliability, or power optimization.
* Experience coordinating initiatives across hardware, firmware, operating\-system, service, and application boundaries.
* Experience using large\-scale telemetry, experimentation, statistical analysis, or Azure data platforms to guide engineering decisions.
* Track record of contributing to architecture and product direction while collaborating with multiple teams and senior stakeholders.

description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** 
 It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Oracle ERP Developer who will play a critical role in the design, development, customization, and implementation of Oracle ERP systems (e.g., Oracle E\-Business Suite, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, or Oracle NetSuite) to meet organizational business requirements. This role involves working closely with business analysts, functional consultants, project managers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, efficient, and robust ERP solutions. The developer will be responsible for creating custom solutions, integrating systems, and ensuring the ERP platform supports end\-to\-end business processes during implementation projects. This role requires close collaboration with onshore teams and stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and delivery of technical solutions. The candidate must be willing to work on site 4 days a week in Hyderabad, during US EST time zone.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 ERP System Development and Customization
   

  

* Design, develop, and customize Oracle ERP modules (e.g., Financials, Supply Chain, Procurement, HRMS, or Manufacturing) to align with business requirements.
* Develop custom forms, reports, interfaces, workflows, and extensions using Oracle tools such as PL/SQL, Oracle Forms, Oracle Reports, OAF (Oracle Application Framework), and APEX.
* Create and modify Oracle ERP APIs, web services, and integrations to support seamless data flow between Oracle ERP and third\-party systems.
* Build and enhance Oracle Fusion Middleware components, including SOA, BPEL, and ADF, for Oracle Cloud ERP implementations.


 ERP Implementation Support
   

  

* Collaborate with functional consultants to translate business requirements into technical specifications for ERP implementation.
* Participate in all phases of the ERP implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support.
* Configure and customize Oracle ERP modules to support business processes, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
* Assist in data migration activities, including data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) using tools like Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) or FBDI (File\-Based Data Import).


 Integration and Middleware Development
   

  

* Develop and maintain integrations between Oracle ERP and external systems (e.g., CRM, HCM, or legacy applications) using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST/SOAP APIs, or other middleware platforms.
* Ensure data integrity, security, and performance in all integrations and data flows.
* Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues during implementation and post\-go\-live phases.


 Testing and Quality Assurance
   

  

* Perform unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure solutions meet functional and technical requirements.
* Debug and resolve issues identified during testing phases, ensuring high\-quality deliverables.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including design specifications, test scripts, and user guides.


 Performance Optimization and Maintenance
   

  

* Optimize Oracle ERP applications for performance, scalability, and reliability during and after implementation.
* Monitor system performance and implement tuning strategies for database queries, reports, and workflows.
* Provide ongoing support for production issues, bug fixes, and enhancements post\-implementation.


 Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement
   

  

* Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, functional consultants, DBAs, and project managers, to ensure successful ERP implementation.
* Communicate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders, providing clarity on solutions and timelines.
* Participate in project planning, status meetings, and go\-live activities, ensuring timely delivery of milestones.


 Compliance and Security
   

  

* Ensure all development activities adhere to organizational policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements (e.g., SOX, GDPR).
* Implement security best practices in Oracle ERP solutions, including role\-based access control (RBAC) and data encryption
* Communication  Facilitate effective communication between offshore and onshore teams, ensuring transparency and alignment on project status, risks, and issues.
* Problem Solving  Proactively identify and resolve technical and operational challenges to ensure smooth project execution.
* Stakeholder Management  Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, providing regular updates and addressing any concerns or requirements.


**Qualifications**
* Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience
* 3\-7 years of experience in Oracle ERP development, with at least 2 years focused on ERP implementation projects.
* Hands\-on experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) R12 or Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.
* Proven expertise in developing custom solutions using PL/SQL, Oracle Forms, Oracle Reports, OAF, or APEX.
* Experience with Oracle Fusion Middleware tools (e.g., SOA, BPEL, ADF) and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) for cloud\-based implementations.
* Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., ODI, FBDI) and integration technologies (e.g., REST/SOAP APIs, XML, JSON).
* Technical Skills
* Proficiency in Oracle Database (SQL, PL/SQL) and related tools (e.g., SQL Developer, TOAD).
* Strong knowledge of Oracle ERP modules such as Financials, Procurement, Inventory, Order Management, or HRMS.
* Experience with Oracle Workflow, AME (Approvals Management Engine), and BI Publisher for reporting.
* Understanding of ERP implementation methodologies (e.g., Oracle AIM, OUM, or Agile).
* Knowledge of cloud technologies and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to address complex business and technical challenges.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Detail\-oriented with a focus on delivering high\-quality, error\-free solutions.
* Problem\-Solving  Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
* Cultural Awareness  Ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment and manage teams across different time zones.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Oracle certifications such as Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) or Oracle Cloud ERP certifications.
* Experience with Oracle NetSuite or other ERP platforms is a plus.
* Knowledge of DevOps practices, including version control (e.g., Git), CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Familiarity with Agile or Scrum project management methodologies.
* Experience with performance tuning and optimization of Oracle ERP systems.

You will also participate in the design and implementation of modular, maintainable, and high\-performance microservices that power our platform. **IT Governance:** 



* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high\-performance web applications and reusable component libraries using React, TypeScript, and Next.js.

* Participate in and lead code reviews, ensuring adherence to engineering best practices, coding standards, security guidelines, and maintainable software design principles.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex production issues through structured root\-cause analysis, while continuously improving application stability, reliability, and performance.
* Mentor and coach junior engineers by promoting engineering best practices, modern frontend development techniques, effective use of AI\-assisted development tools, and continuous learning.
* Stay current with emerging frontend technologies, cloud\-native architectures, AI innovations, and industry best practices, proactively recommending improvements that enhance engineering capabilities.
* Foster strong collaboration and maintain effective communication with engineering teams, product stakeholders, business partners, and leadership to successfully deliver high\-quality software solutions.
* Follows all defined IT standards and processes (i.e. IT Governance, SM\&G, Architecture, etc.), and provides input for improvements to the appropriate process owners as needed
* Maintains a proper balance between business and operational risk
* Follows the defined project management standards and processes



  





**Skill and Experience:** 



* 6\+ years of professional experience in software design and development, with strong expertise in modern web technologies including JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Next.js, and Node.js.
* Proven experience designing and developing scalable, cloud\-native microservices using micro\-frontend and distributed architectures.
* Hands\-on experience leveraging GenAI\-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI\-assisted engineering platforms to improve developer productivity and code quality.
* Strong experience building and integrating GraphQL and RESTful APIs to develop robust, scalable, and secure enterprise applications.
* Deep understanding of React fundamentals, including Hooks, component lifecycle, state management (Redux, MobX, Zustand, React Context), Server\-Side Rendering (SSR), asynchronous programming, and modern frontend architecture patterns.

* Experience building enterprise\-scale web applications using Micro\-Frontend architecture and integrating frontend applications with Headless CMS platforms such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) or similar CMS solutions.
* Strong hands\-on experience developing responsive, reusable, and maintainable user interfaces using React and modern frontend frameworks.
* Experience configuring and optimizing Webpack, Vite, or other modern build tools, including custom bundling strategies and plugin development where applicable.
* Strong understanding of frontend and backend performance optimization, including Core Web Vitals, rendering performance, API optimization, bundle size reduction, lazy loading, caching, and scalability best practices.
* Experience writing and maintaining unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests using frameworks such as Jest, Jasmine, Mocha, JUnit with Mockito, Cypress, or Playwright.
* Solid understanding of application performance bottlenecks, production troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and implementing sustainable performance improvements.
* Excellent analytical, debugging, problem\-solving, communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills, with experience working in Agile/Scrum environments to deliver high\-quality software solutions.



  





**Education and Certifications:** 



* Graduate degree in Computer Science or Engineering



  





**Work location:** 
 Hyderabad, India.
 



**Work mode:** 
 Hybrid

 At Marriott, our make us who we are. We believe that success is never final. As we change and grow, the beliefs that are most important to us stay the same—putting people first, pursuing excellence, embracing change, acting with integrity, and serving our world. Being part of Marriott Tech Accelerator means being part of a proud history and a thriving culture.

title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Description
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Sr Staff Software Engineer (IC5\)** 
 to help build and evolve the foundational platform capabilities that power our products and engineering organization.
   

  

 As a Sr Staff Engineer, you will own significant technical domains and critical platform capabilities, defining their architecture, technical direction, and roadmap. You will design and build highly reliable, performant, secure, and scalable platform building blocks that can be leveraged across multiple engineering teams.
   

  

 This is an
 **AI\-native engineering role** 
 . You will use AI, LLMs, coding agents, and agentic development workflows as first\-class engineering tools across the software development lifecycle—from understanding problems and designing solutions to implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and operations. You will also help establish the engineering practices and platform capabilities required to build and operate AI\-powered products at scale.
   

  

 You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, driving months\-long initiatives that span multiple teams and have complex technical dependencies. You will identify problems before they are assigned, challenge the status quo, and continuously improve the platform and how engineering teams build software.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities Platform Architecture \& Technical Ownership
   

  

* Design, build, and evolve highly reliable, performant, secure, and scalable platform building blocks.
* Own the technical direction and evolution of multiple platform areas.
* Define and influence the platform team's technical roadmap in partnership with engineering and product leadership.
* Lead architecture and design for complex distributed systems, services, APIs, and platform capabilities.
* Evaluate architectural patterns, technologies, and tooling and make pragmatic decisions based on scalability, reliability, security, performance, and developer experience.
* Establish reusable engineering patterns, standards, frameworks, and tooling that can be adopted across teams.
* Continuously identify opportunities to simplify architecture, eliminate technical debt, and improve platform capabilities.


 AI\-Native Engineering
   

  

* Treat AI as a first\-class engineering capability across the software development lifecycle.
* Use LLMs, coding agents, AI\-assisted development environments, and agentic workflows to increase engineering velocity, quality, and effectiveness.
* Apply AI across problem discovery, design, implementation, testing, debugging, code review, documentation, and operational troubleshooting.
* Develop effective human\-AI collaboration patterns and establish guardrails for AI\-assisted engineering.
* Evaluate emerging AI\-native development tools and incorporate those that provide meaningful engineering leverage.
* Help engineering teams evolve from traditional development practices toward AI\-native software engineering.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering activities and enable AI agents to independently execute well\-defined engineering workflows.


 AI Platform \& Product Capabilities
   

  

* Design and build platform capabilities that enable teams to integrate and operate AI\-powered experiences at scale.
* Lead technical design for LLM integrations, agent workflows, tool calling, RAG, orchestration, and related AI capabilities where applicable.
* Establish reusable patterns for AI reliability, security, observability, evaluation, scalability, latency, and cost management.
* Partner with product and engineering teams to identify opportunities where AI can meaningfully improve product capabilities or engineering workflows.


 Cross\-Team Technical Leadership
   

  

* Partner within and across engineering teams to provide cross\-cutting technical solutions.
* Lead initiatives involving multiple teams, systems, and technical dependencies.
* Consistently deliver deadline\-sensitive work that is interdependent with other engineering teams.
* Drive technical alignment across teams without requiring management escalation.
* Resolve architectural conflicts, technical dependencies, and integration challenges.
* Communicate complex engineering and architectural concepts clearly and concisely to engineers, product managers, and other cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Influence product and engineering roadmaps through strong technical judgment and demonstrated outcomes.


 Continuous Improvement \& Engineering Excellence
   

  

* Challenge the status quo and continuously improve the platform, architecture, processes, and engineering practices.
* Identify systemic problems proactively and drive them to resolution.
* Improve platform reliability, performance, security, developer experience, and operational efficiency.
* Introduce new tooling and standards that reduce engineering friction and increase developer productivity.
* Regularly participate in and lead peer code reviews, engineering design reviews, architecture reviews, and technical discussions.
* Establish and promote engineering best practices across teams.


 Ownership, Execution \& Mentorship
   

  

* Operate independently on ambiguous, high\-complexity problems with minimal direction.
* Own initiatives from problem definition through architecture, execution, delivery, and adoption.
* Anticipate risks and dependencies and proactively establish mitigation strategies.
* Work effectively in a startup\-paced environment with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
* Mentor IC1–IC4 engineers and help raise the technical capabilities of the broader engineering organization.
* Share knowledge, encourage experimentation, and foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement.


**Qualifications**
 Qualifications Required Qualifications
   

  

* 11\+ years of experience designing, building, shipping, and maintaining software products or platforms.
* B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building reliable, scalable, performant, and secure platforms or distributed systems.
* Experience building and integrating with API\-based platforms, with a strong understanding of REST and other RPC\-based systems.
* Strong experience building and maintaining microservices using one or more of Python, Golang, Java, or C\+\+.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, service design, APIs, databases, observability, security, and reliability.
* Demonstrated experience owning significant technical domains and influencing technical roadmaps.
* Proven ability to lead complex, cross\-team initiatives with significant technical dependencies.
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently, identify problems proactively, and drive ambiguous projects to completion.
* Ability to communicate complex engineering concepts concisely and clearly to both technical and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Strong experience participating in peer code reviews, engineering design reviews, and architecture discussions.


 Additional Information

Learn more here.  We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals.  Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This role requires a blend of technical expertise, leadership skills, and the ability to foster a collaborative and innovative environment. We are looking for a Project Lead familiar with cloud\-native and AI\-native development practices. Our software is built around AI at its core—LLMs, agents, and retrieval systems—and runs on IaaS (Google Cloud/AWS/etc.), so familiarity with these environments and their managed AI services is a plus. Full ownership of your code will be encouraged, including deployment, testing, evaluation, and validation of both traditional and AI components. You will lead a team of software and AI engineers, coaching and mentoring them. Familiarity with CI/CD, test\-driven development, and evaluation\-driven development (eval harnesses for AI features) will be a benefit.
   

  

**Responsibility Area: Software Development**
* Develop intuitive AI\-native software that meets and exceeds the needs of the company
* Development of technical specifications and planning, including model selection, prompt/agent design, and data/retrieval architecture
* Analyze and automate tests for software components prior to delivery, and build evaluation harnesses (accuracy, regression, and hallucination checks) for AI features
* Troubleshoot coding and model\-behavior problems quickly and efficiently to ensure a productive workplace
* Follow secure software coding practices, including AI\-specific safeguards (prompt\-injection defense, data privacy, PII handling, and responsible\-AI guardrails)
* Professionally maintain all software and create updates regularly to address customer and company concerns, including monitoring model performance and drift in production
* IaaS procedures and practices, including managed AI/ML services (e.g., Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI)
* Experience with Kubernetes and containerization is welcome; experience serving models or deploying inference/GPU workloads is a plus


**Responsibility Area: Communication**
* Communicate effectively and professionally in all forms of communication with internal and external customers
* Liaise with team members, management, and clients
* Be transparent about challenges, failures, and successes, including the limitations and non\-deterministic nature of AI systems
* Deliver presentations and write progress reports for stakeholders, translating AI capabilities and trade\-offs for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Actively seek ways to improve business software processes and interactions, including where AI and automation can add value


**Responsibility Area: Leadership**
* Manage individual contributors' daily tasks

* Perform detailed code reviews, including reviews of prompts, agent logic, and evaluation results
* Evaluate performance, provide feedback and constructive criticism to team members
* Set and track quarterly goals for all team members
* Assist with training and recruitment activities
* Provide status updates, weekly reports, and issue details to senior leadership as needed
* Participate in Root Cause Analysis for customer\-reported issues, including failures rooted in model behavior, hallucinations, or data/retrieval quality
* Aid and support the coaching and training of other team members to ensure all employees are confident in the use of software applications and AI tooling
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams including product management, domain specialists, and engineering to define requirements and develop scalable AI\-driven solutions
* Stay current with the latest advancements in AI and related technologies (new models, frameworks, and techniques), and proactively identify opportunities to apply them to our products and services


**Qualifications**
* 8\-12 years of practical Java experience
* 2 years of experience with prompt engineering and prompt/agent scripting
* 2 years of hands\-on experience integrating third\-party AI/ML services and platform APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Salesforce and other SaaS)
* Proven ability to design and manage domain\-specific languages, prompt templates, and agent instruction frameworks
* Develop and optimize microservices that power high\-performance data and embedding pipelines, handling up to 10 million rows and feeding vector stores

 At New Relic, you will architect and build the massive\-scale streaming data platform that powers our industry\-leading observability ingestion pipelines. Join us in our mission to revolutionize observability by engineering systems that process massive data volumes with extreme throughput and low latency.

* Define and drive the architectural roadmap for our core observability ingestion pipelines, ensuring high availability, resilience, and operational excellence.

* Advanced Java Engineering: Expert\-level proficiency in Java, including deep knowledge of JVM tuning, garbage collection optimization, concurrency, and multithreading under extreme load.
* Distributed Streaming: Mastery of Apache Kafka (or AWS MSK), including deep understanding of partition strategies, consumer group rebalancing, and high\-throughput tuning.
* Cloud Architecture: Extensive hands\-on experience with AWS compute and data services (EKS, S3\) and strong architectural knowledge of Kubernetes and Docker.
* System Design: Exceptional problem\-solving skills with a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and resilient microservices design.

* Experience establishing and improving CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps best practices.

* Observability Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of the MELT stack (Metrics, Events, Logs, Traces) and OpenTelemetry (OTel) standards.
* High Cardinality Solutions: Proven experience designing systems capable of handling high\-cardinality time\-series data at massive scale.
* Significant contributions to open\-source projects in distributed systems, stream processing, or observability domains.

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline and 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including 6\+ years of full\-stack web application development using Python.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise\-scale microservices and distributed systems architectures.
* Experience developing cloud\-native applications utilizing Amazon Web Services (AWS) and container technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker.
* Experience with PostgreSQL database development, API design, event\-driven architectures, and real\-time data processing solutions.
* Experience developing front\-end applications using React or Angular, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience developing software products within the medical device industry or another regulated industry.
* Experience applying object\-oriented design principles and established software design patterns.
* Experience with networking and communication protocols used in distributed systems.
* Experience performing security assessments, risk analysis, and secure software development activities.
* Experience working within Agile software development environments and leading technical initiatives across engineering teams.


**Physical Job Requirements**
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

 Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.
   

  

 Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

 Application Security \& Authentication

* Implement secure random salt generation and eliminate static or hardcoded salts.

 Code Review \& Technical Governance

* Identify security vulnerabilities, poor coding practices, technical debt, and architectural deviations.
* Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, branching practices, and development guidelines.
* Review and validate database changes, API contracts, authentication implementations, encryption mechanisms, and third\-party integrations.
* Guide junior and mid\-level developers on technical implementation and troubleshooting.
* Ensure Critical/High findings from SonarQube and vulnerability scans are appropriately addressed.


 Azure, DevSecOps \& Reliability
   

  

* Work with Azure Key Vault, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Azure monitoring, Application Insights, and related Azure services.
* Ensure secure configuration and deployment practices across environments.
* Support removal of hardcoded secrets/keys from application resources and configuration.
* Implement appropriate retry, timeout, error\-handling, and dependency\-failure strategies.
* Contribute to resilience and redundancy considerations for security\-sensitive components.
* Support repository security, Git history cleanup, secret scanning, and .gitignore protection.
* Implement correlation IDs, structured logging, security\-event logging, monitoring, and observability across modified flows.
* Support dead\-letter/error handling for applicable asynchronous operations.
* Participate in vulnerability scanning, static code analysis, remediation, and security verification.


 Testing \& Quality
   

  

* Develop and maintain high\-quality, testable backend code.
* Write and review unit and integration tests for authentication, credential, API, and security\-sensitive flows.
* Support performance testing of login and authentication flows following credential\-storage changes.
* Work closely with QA to identify and resolve defects and improve test coverage.
* Review regression results and ensure all affected authentication and security flows are validated.
* Ensure implementation evidence, test results, scan results, and remediation details are properly documented in Azure DevOps.


 Team Leadership \& Delivery

* Review estimates and technical feasibility of proposed solutions.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Compilers
description:
**Who We Are**
 This role is part of the
 **Kinara Group at NXP Semiconductors** 
 , combining the agility and innovation of a startup with the scale, stability, and global reach of a leading semiconductor company.
   

  

 Kinara was founded on
 **patented technology developed during the founders’ Ph.D. research at Stanford University** 
 , with a mission to redefine AI inference at the edge through tightly integrated hardware and software. Following Kinara’s acquisition, this mission continues within NXP, with the Kinara team operating as a
 **dedicated AI accelerator and software group** 
 focused on pushing the boundaries of edge AI.
   

  

 The team has delivered
 **two generations of AI silicon shipping in volume** 
 , supported by a
 **mature and production** 
 ‑
 **ready software stack** 
 , making it one of the most proven edge AI platforms in the industry. Kinara technology is used by
 **marquee customers** 
 , including GAFA‑class companies, a leading global e‑commerce provider, and Tier‑1 PC OEMs.
   

  

 As part of NXP, the Kinara Group now benefits from
 **world** 
 ‑
 **class silicon execution, manufacturing scale, and customer access** 
 , while retaining its startup culture, deep AI expertise, and compiler‑driven engineering mindset. Joining this team offers the
 **best of both worlds** 
 : the opportunity to work on cutting‑edge AI compiler and silicon technology, with real‑world impact and long‑term stability.
   

  

**What We Do**
 We build
 **game** 
 ‑
 **changing edge AI solutions** 
 that enable faster, smarter, and more power‑efficient decision making where every millisecond matters.
   

  

 At the core of our platform are
 **Ara AI inference processors** 
 , purpose‑built to deliver
 **unrivaled deep learning performance per watt at the edge** 
 . Paired with our
 **comprehensive SDK and software toolchain** 
 , these processors enable developers to deploy and optimize complex AI models for real‑time inference under tight latency and power constraints.
   

  

 Kinara’s hardware–software co‑design approach allows high‑performance AI to be
 **seamlessly embedded into edge devices** 
 , enabling applications across vision, industrial automation, consumer electronics, and intelligent systems. Our solutions focus on
 **performance, efficiency, and scalability** 
 , helping customers bring advanced AI capabilities out of the cloud and into the real world.
   

  

 Edge AI is at an inflection point, and the Kinara Group within NXP is uniquely positioned to play a
 **leading role in its growth** 
 , delivering production‑proven silicon, a robust compiler and SDK stack, and a clear roadmap for next‑generation intelligent edge devices.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Front\-End Compiler Engineer** 
 with 10\+ years of experience to lead the design and development of our
 **AI/ML compiler front\-end** 
 . The role focuses on building scalable
 **model conversion pipelines** 
 that translate models from
 **ONNX, TensorFlow, and PyTorch** 
 into our internal
 **Intermediate Representation (IR)** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in
 **compiler design** 
 ,
 **graph\-based optimizations** 
 ,
 **machine learning frameworks** 
 , and modern AI architectures including
 **Transformers** 
 and
 **Large Language Models (LLMs)** 
 . You will collaborate with compiler backend, runtime, performance, and hardware teams to deliver a high\-performance and production\-ready AI compiler stack.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and develop compiler front\-end architecture and model conversion frameworks.
* Build and maintain Python\-based converters for ONNX, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.
* Implement graph construction, graph transformation, IR lowering, and optimization pipelines.
* Develop graph optimization passes including operator fusion, canonicalization, simplification, and decomposition.
* Design scalable pattern\-matching and graph\-rewrite frameworks.
* Enable support for modern AI architectures such as CNNs, Transformers, and LLMs.
* Drive validation, testing infrastructure, regression testing, and CI/CD integration.
* Debug and resolve issues across model conversion, optimization, and IR generation stages.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and collaborate across teams.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in compiler development, ML systems, or AI infrastructure.
* Strong Python programming and software architecture skills.
* Deep understanding of:
+ Intermediate Representations (IRs)
+ Graph\-based computation models
+ Compiler transformations and optimizations
+ Pattern matching and graph rewriting

* Hands\-on experience with ONNX, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.
* Experience in graph parsing, graph transformations, and ML model optimizations.
* Strong understanding of CNNs, Transformers, and LLM architectures.
* Excellent debugging, problem\-solving, and technical leadership skills.


**Good to Have**
* Experience with MLIR, TOSA, StableHLO, or Torch\-MLIR.
* Familiarity with AI compiler stacks such as IREE, TVM, XLA, TensorRT, or ONNX Runtime.
* Experience targeting GPUs, NPUs, DSPs, or custom AI accelerators.

title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
description:
**Summary**
**Job Description**
 We are seeking an immediate joiner for the role Senior ServiceNow Developer to take ownership of our platform, providing expertise in ITOM, HR Service Delivery (HRSD), Field Service Management (FSM), finance, and platform development, CSM, SSM. In this role, you will be responsible for translating complex business requirements into solutions, maintaining the platform, and driving our technical strategy forward.
   

  

**Senior ServiceNow Developer**
 Platform Development
   

  

* Finance
* HRSD
* Field Service Management
* Serval AI
* ITOM


**About The Role**
 ServiceNow is central to how work gets done across our IT, HR, finance, and field operations. Teams depend on it every day, and the roadmap continues to grow. We are looking for a senior developer to take end\-to\-end ownership of the platform — someone equally at home designing a clean data model, guiding solution architecture, and resolving complex issues under release pressure.
   

  

 You will serve as the technical anchor across several product lines — core platform development, Financial Management, HR Service Delivery, Field Service Management, our emerging Serval AI capabilities, and IT Operations Management — while keeping the instance healthy, current, and maintainable. This is a role with genuine ownership and influence: we value engineers who challenge assumptions and recommend the right approach rather than simply delivering to spec. Our platform strategy will continue to evolve, and should our direction shift toward a TypeScript\-based AI platform, we want someone who can help lead that transition and any migration away from ServiceNow.
   

  

**Platform development \& architecture**
 Building is at the heart of this role. You will translate complex business requirements into supportable solutions and set the engineering standards the wider team follows.
   

  

* Design and build across Flow Designer, UI Builder, scoped applications, Business Rules, Script Includes, client scripts, and the IntegrationHub.
* Own the data model and CMDB relationships — decide what belongs in a scoped app versus the global scope, and keep custom work from fighting the platform.
* Build and maintain integrations to external systems over REST, SOAP, and MID Server, including error handling and retry logic that survives real\-world outages.
* Set and enforce coding standards, run peer code reviews, and mentor mid\-level developers and admins.
* Build with modern tooling where it fits — TypeScript and the ServiceNow SDK (Fluent) for source\-controlled, IDE\-based development, plus custom UI Builder components.
* Champion out\-of\-the\-box first: reach for configuration before customization, and document the reason whenever you do have to customize.


**Financial Management (Finance module)**
 Finance is one of our fastest\-moving areas. We need someone who understands both the ServiceNow tooling and how finance teams think about and manage cost.
   

  

* Configure and extend ServiceNow Financial Management — cost models, cost transparency, budgeting, chargeback and showback, and allocation rules.
* Partner with finance stakeholders to map general\-ledger data, cost pools, and business services so that reporting is accurate and defensible.
* Build dashboards and reports that give leaders clear, trusted visibility into where IT spend is going.
* Support integrations between Financial Management, the CMDB, and upstream ERP or procurement systems.


**HR Service Delivery (HRSD)**
 You will help HR deliver employee\-facing services with the same rigour as IT — well\-structured processes, clear SLAs, and an intuitive employee portal.
   

  

* Build and maintain HR services, case types, and Lifecycle Events (onboarding, offboarding, transfers) with the right approvals and tasks.
* Design Employee Center experiences, knowledge, and guided journeys that reduce inbound questions.
* Apply strong data segregation, scoped access, and privacy controls to keep sensitive HR records secure.
* Partner with HR operations to automate routine casework while preserving a considered, human experience where it matters most.


**Field Service Management (FSM)**
 Our field teams rely on ServiceNow to reach the right location with the right parts. Reliable scheduling and dispatch directly affect service quality and customer experience.
   

  

* Configure work order management, dynamic scheduling and dispatch, and technician assignment based on skills, location, and availability.
* Support the mobile experience so technicians can work offline and sync cleanly when they reconnect.
* Integrate FSM with inventory, asset, and parts management so that scheduling reflects real\-world availability.
* Refine SLAs, entitlements, and territory rules as the field organisation grows and evolves.


**Serval AI**
 Serval AI is an early and high\-potential area for us. We are looking for someone curious and rigorous, who will pilot AI capabilities responsibly and apply them where they deliver real value.
   

  

* Implement and tune Serval AI across service workflows — case summarisation, resolution suggestions, and generative responses in conversational assistants.
* Extend Serval AI through its TypeScript capability — building custom logic, connectors, and integrations in a type\-safe, source\-controlled codebase.
* Design and refine conversational assistant flows, improving them using real conversation data and deflection metrics.
* Apply Serval AI for classification, similarity, and routing so that work reaches the right team automatically.
* Apply Serval AI over CMDB and asset data — reasoning across Configuration Item and Asset relationships and their lifecycle state to deliver accurate, context\-aware insight.
* Monitor Serval AI quality, guardrails, and cost, and validate that each capability delivers measurable value before rolling it out broadly.


**IT Operations Management (ITOM)**
 A trustworthy CMDB underpins everything else on the platform. You will help keep it accurate and ensure the platform reflects the estate as it truly is.
   

  

* Configure and troubleshoot Discovery and Service Mapping, including MID Server setup, credentials, and custom patterns.
* Maintain CMDB health — identification and reconciliation rules, data certification, and remediation of duplicate or stale CIs.
* Understand and maintain the relationship between Configuration Items (cmdb\_ci) and Asset records (alm\_asset), and map hardware and software lifecycle stages to the corresponding CI operational status.
* Work with graph connectors to ingest and relate external data, keeping CI and asset status accurate and consistent alongside ITOM Discovery and Service Mapping.
* Configure Event Management and alert correlation to reduce noise into a small set of actionable alerts.
* Support Service Mapping so business services are modeled well enough to drive impact analysis and change decisions.


**Platform maintenance \& operations**
 Delivery is only part of the role. Equally important is keeping the instance stable, current, and well\-documented, so that it remains maintainable for the whole team.
   

  

* Plan and execute family upgrades and patching, including impact assessment, skipped\-updates review, and regression testing.
* Run instance health scans, address technical debt, and manage update sets and CI/CD promotion across environments.
* Monitor performance — slow queries, long\-running jobs, and table growth — and address root causes rather than symptoms.
* Manage ACLs, roles, and security so that access is appropriately scoped, and maintain clear documentation so that knowledge is shared across the team.


**Requirements**
**Job Requirements**
 You do not need to be an expert in every module on day one. We value genuine depth in several of these areas, sound platform judgement, and the drive to grow into the rest.
   

  

**Must have**
* Five or more years building on ServiceNow, including senior or lead responsibility on production delivery.
* Strong JavaScript (and ideally TypeScript) with hands\-on command of the core platform: Flow Designer, scripting, ACLs, the data model, and integrations.
* Production experience in at least two of: Financial Management, HRSD, FSM, or ITOM.
* Experience owning upgrades and general platform maintenance on a live, business\-critical instance.
* Adaptable and forward\-looking — comfortable adopting a new TypeScript\-based AI platform should the strategy shift, and able to help plan and lead the migration of workloads away from ServiceNow.
* Certified System Administrator (CSA), plus at least one Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in a relevant module.
* A clear communicator who can engage effectively with senior stakeholders and technical teams alike.


**Preferred**
* Hands\-on work with Serval AI or comparable AI/LLM platforms and conversational assistants.
* Additional CIS certifications, or Certified Application Developer (CAD).
* Experience with CI/CD tooling, automated testing (ATF), and source control for ServiceNow.
* TypeScript and the ServiceNow SDK (Fluent) for building and versioning scoped apps in code.
* Exposure to ITOM Discovery patterns, Service Mapping, or Event Management at scale.
* Background integrating ServiceNow with ERP, IdP/SSO, or monitoring tools.

description:
**About The Position** 




 Aqua Security enables enterprises to secure their container\-based and cloud\-native applications from development to production, accelerating container adoption and bridging the gap between DevOps and IT security. We are building a state\-of\-the\-art security platform for large enterprises in the exciting and innovative new field of software containers. Our systems are deployed on thousands of customer servers around the world. A distributed system to watch over distributed systems!
 


* We are looking for a talented Technical Lead to join our server team, in charge of developing Aqua's management console \- a multi\-component system with many responsibilities, performing various background jobs and large\-scale data processing; supplying REST APIs, a web based UI and more.
* In this role, you will take part in further development of our management console, writing features across the entire application stack: SQL queries, business logic, background processes, REST APIs and web\-based user interfaces.
* At Aqua, you will not be writing code for in\-house applications. You will be writing code for large technology companies, banks, government agencies and multi\-national chains.
* Our product is composed of multiple components, mostly installed on\-premise in our customer's cloud environments, but also has SaaS components, plugins for various CI/CD systems and many more. Almost everything runs inside containers. It is written in Go \- an exciting new language from Google, and heavily depends on free software/open source components. Our web UI is currently written in VueJS. We are primarily a Linux company, but our software also supports Windows and Mac.



  





**Working from Aqua Hyderabad office a minimum of 4 days per week (Mon\-Thu)** 




**Requirements** 



1. 9\+ years of hands\-on engineering experience delivering features for large\-scale, distributed applications.
2. Proven experience designing and building multi‑component systems / microservices with efficient inter‑service communication patterns.
3. Strong programming background in Go, Node.js, Java, or similar high\-level languages — extra credit if you’ve used Go in production or survived a weekend debugging a catastrophic memory leak.
4. Experienced in building and maintaining APIs (REST or RPC) while owning the lifecycle of backward‑compatibility decisions (including the ones you regret).
5. Passionate about modern engineering practices, open\-source ecosystems, and developing software that runs reliably at scale in real customer environments.



  





**AI \& GenAI Expertise**

2. Comfortable writing complex queries (yes, including multi‑join monsters) and having strong opinions on integer vs UUIDprimary keys.
3. Bonus points for familiarity with Graph Databases.



  





**Cloud, Infra \& DevOps** 



1. Solid, production\-grade experience on AWS (required).
2. Strong knowledge of IaC tooling, automated provisioning, and cloud\-native infrastructure design.
3. Experience building cloud\-native apps using Serverless (Lambda), SNS, SQS, S3, EC2, and event\-driven architectures.
4. Understanding of AI\-supported IaC, automated configuration checks, and intelligent cloud monitoring is a plus.



  





**Containers, Linux \& Ecosystem** 



1. Strong Linux fundamentals — you should feel at home in \*nix environments.
2. Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes (required); OpenShift is a bonus.
3. Knowledge of event streaming platforms like Kafka is a plus.



  





 Aqua Security is the pioneer in cloud native security. Founded in 2015, Aqua Security is a global late\-stage scale\-up and the largest pure play cloud native vendor. Aqua helps enterprises see and stop threats across every phase of the software development lifecycle, from dev to cloud and back.
 



 If you’re ready for an exciting opportunity to dive into the hottest cybersecurity category, now is the perfect time to join Aqua! We are a global organization where every Aquarian can make a difference and make a big impact. Aqua also offers great company culture, amazing colleagues, international travel, and lots more!
 



 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Compilers
description:
**Who We Are**
 This role is part of the Kinara Group at NXP Semiconductors, combining the agility and innovation of a startup with the scale, stability, and global reach of a leading semiconductor company.
   

  

 Kinara was founded on patented technology developed during the founders' Ph.D. research at Stanford University, with a mission to redefine AI inference at the edge through tightly integrated hardware and software. Following Kinara's acquisition, this mission continues within NXP, with the Kinara team operating as a dedicated AI accelerator and software group focused on pushing the boundaries of edge AI.
   

  

 The team has delivered two generations of AI silicon shipping in volume, supported by a mature and production\-ready software stack, making it one of the most proven edge AI platforms in the industry. Kinara technology is used by marquee customers, including GAFA\-class companies, a leading global e\-commerce provider, and Tier\-1 PC OEMs.
   

  

 As part of NXP, the Kinara Group now benefits from world\-class silicon execution, manufacturing scale, and customer access, while retaining its startup culture, deep AI expertise, and compiler\-driven engineering mindset. Joining this team offers the best of both worlds: the opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI compiler and silicon technology, with real\-world impact and long\-term stability.
   

  

**What We Do**
 We build game\-changing edge AI solutions that enable faster, smarter, and more power\-efficient decision making where every millisecond matters.
   

  

 At the core of our platform are Ara AI inference processors, purpose\-built to deliver unrivaled deep learning performance per watt at the edge. Paired with our comprehensive SDK and software toolchain, these processors enable developers to deploy and optimize complex AI models for real\-time inference under tight latency and power constraints.
   

  

 Kinara's hardware\-software co\-design approach allows high\-performance AI to be seamlessly embedded into edge devices, enabling applications across vision, industrial automation, consumer electronics, and intelligent systems. Our solutions focus on performance, efficiency, and scalability, helping customers bring advanced AI capabilities out of the cloud and into the real world.
   

  

 Edge AI is at an inflection point, and the Kinara Group within NXP is uniquely positioned to play a leading role in its growth, delivering production\-proven silicon, a robust compiler and SDK stack, and a clear roadmap for next\-generation intelligent edge devices.
   

  

**This Is What You Are Responsible For**
* Implement compiler modules within defined subsystems: MLIR dialects, lowering passes, operator fusion strategies, and target code generation components for our NPU.
* Participate in design and deployment of quantization flows and numerical\-correctness verification for assigned features.
* Develop and ship production\-grade compiler passes and runtime integration components that are stable, debuggable, and performant.
* Perform low\-level optimizations and collaborate with kernel teams to address HW/SW performance gaps.
* Contribute to compiler CI pipelines, test suites, profiling, and release processes.
* Debug and root\-cause performance and correctness issues on customer models; produce reproducible fixes.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to design reviews.
* Provide feedback to product and silicon teams on compiler\-driven feature opportunities and tradeoffs.


**Necessary Qualifications**
* 7\-8 years of software engineering experience with hands\-on compiler and systems work.
* Experience with graph lowering, IR design, operator fusion, scheduling, and code generation for accelerators.
* Strong systems programming skills \-\- proficient C\+\+ and solid Python for tooling and infrastructure.
* Track record of shipping compiler components or systems software used in deployed products.
* Solid debugging and profiling skills with common performance toolchains.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work cross\-functionally with hardware architects and kernel teams.
* Willingness to mentor junior engineers and contribute to team engineering practices.


**Good to Have**
* Familiarity with MLIR\-based frontends and dialects, such as TOSA, StableHLO, TorchMLIR.
* Exposure to AI compiler stacks, hardware backends, or accelerator targeting.
* Experience working with large\-scale models or production ML inference pipelines.

Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. title: Senior Software Engineer (ERP Developer)

Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e\-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in\-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
   

  

 At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day \- building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
   

  

 As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Software Engineer will play a critical role in maintaining and modernizing legacy Order Fulfillment and Light Manufacturing systems for the Miramar Supply Chain Tech team.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Fanatics is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Miramar Supply Chain Tech team in Hyderabad, focused on sustaining and evolving critical ERP and fulfillment systems built on Microsoft Dynamics SL and a portfolio of .NET applications. This role is central to ensuring the stability of Order Management, Inventory, and Fulfillment workflows while driving integration with modern platforms such as Manhattan Active and enabling a thoughtful transition away from legacy architecture. The Senior Software Engineer delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI\-enabled insights.
   

  

**How Will You Drive Impact**
 Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
   

  

 Team \& Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
   

  

* Lead and participate in design reviews and peer code reviews, setting a standard for engineering quality across the Miramar Supply Chain Tech team.
* Collaborate closely with business analysts, cloud and on\-prem partner teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders to align technical solutions with operational requirements.
* Coordinate and synchronize all changes across QC and production environments, ensuring reliable delivery and minimal disruption to critical supply chain operations.


 Fan \& Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
   

  

* Support ERP workflows through Dynamics SL that directly power Order Management, Inventory Control, and Fulfillment — capabilities that underpin the on\-time delivery of merchandise to fans globally.
* Provide incident resolution and break\-fix support for all Miramar systems, minimizing downtime and maintaining a seamless fulfillment experience.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions that improve order accuracy, inventory visibility, and fulfillment speed for fans and retail partners.
* Integrate legacy systems with platforms like Manhattan Active to enable a more modern, reliable, and scalable customer fulfillment experience.


 Innovation \& Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
   

  

* Build APIs and wrapper services that bridge legacy ERP functionality with modern cloud and on\-prem platforms, extending system capability without disrupting live operations.
* Document legacy business logic and contribute to migration planning, helping chart a clear path from current\-state systems to next\-generation solutions.
