* Deliver full\-stack solutions across the entire lifecycle — from inception through UAT to production — using modern frameworks and containerization practices.


 Ownership \& Execution (Determined \& Relentless Mindset)
   

  

* Maintain version control for all custom applications and ensure all code is archived, documented in GitHub, and tracked through Jira and Confluence.
* Manage SQL Server stored procedures and optimize SQL views and queries, troubleshooting and resolving job or runtime errors as they arise.
* Take ownership of existing workflows and support them using the tools already in place, learning rapidly and acting decisively to keep systems stable.
* Operate effectively under pressure, solving complex problems in mission\-critical environments while maintaining clear documentation and communication throughout.


 AI \& DIGITAL CAPABILITY
   

  

 We are building a future\-ready organization. This role is expected to:
   

  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement


**Required Qualifications**
 CAPABILITIES \& EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
   

  

* Five or more years of software development experience using agile methodology, with at least five years supporting legacy ERP and fulfillment software.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP domains including Order Management, Inventory Control, and Fulfillment — preferably within Microsoft Dynamics SL or comparable platforms.
* Proficiency with SQL Server stored procedures, query optimization, and troubleshooting SQL job or runtime errors.
* Experience writing production software in one or more of the following languages: C\#, Java, Go, or Python, with access to relational databases.
* Familiarity with GitHub or GitLab, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines; experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka, Pulsar, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, or SQS is strongly preferred.
* Understanding of APIs, integration patterns, and batch\-driven workflows, with demonstrated ability to build wrapper services connecting legacy and modern systems.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to solve problems effectively under pressure across cross\-functional teams.


**Education**
 Bachelor’s in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field required.
   

  

 WORK LOCATION
   

  

 Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in Hyderabad, India, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in\-office presence 3 days per week i.e., Tuesday, Wednesday \& Thursday.
   

  

*At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset \- We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast\-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.*

We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. title: Service Now Developer - Software Engineer II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**National Consulting Services**
 The National Office, a key Strategic Enabler in our new model, is comprised of professionals with various areas of focus that collectively provide mission critical services to support Deloitte’s overall success. Whether focused on project financial, quality and risk management, methods and tools, sales excellence, talent, leadership support, or other activities these professionals ensure that our Firm operates efficiently, and our people are able to effectively serve clients every day.
   

  

**Position Summary:** 
**Service Now Developer**
**Level: Consultant**
 As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
   

  

 As a ServiceNow Developer, you will be responsible for development, core configuration, and ongoing technical enhancement of Deloitte’s ServiceNow implementation. You’ll bring a solution\-focused mindset, a passion for customer service, and thrive in a dynamic, high\-velocity environment. You will also have opportunities to build foundational skills in ServiceNow’s AI and automation capabilities.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
* Translate functional specifications into logical technical designs; design and develop new ServiceNow workflows and processes.
* Develop and customize ServiceNow solutions (primarily ITSM) using JavaScript, Jelly, MySQL, XML, HTML, CSS, and REST/SOAP web services.
* Build and maintain custom Service Portal pages and widgets to support diverse business needs.
* Assist system administrators with incident resolution and ad\-hoc platform troubleshooting.
* Guide, support, and conduct code walkthroughs for less experienced developers as needed.
* Ensure ServiceNow development and customization align to best practices to maintain compliance.
* Create, maintain, and execute comprehensive unit and integration test plans; coordinate and perform regression testing.
* Document, track, and resolve software defects; participate in UAT and incorporate feedback from business stakeholders.
* Manage Update Set creation and migration; assist with ServiceNow platform maintenance, upgrades, and vendor coordination.
* Participate in requirements gathering, maintain technical solution documentation, and collaborate with business/IT teams.
* Integrate ServiceNow with other enterprise applications using Integration Hub or standard APIs, following secure and scalable practices.
* Develop skills in leveraging ServiceNow’s GenAI features, such as Virtual Agent, NLP\-driven ticket categorization, or AI Search, to enhance automation and workflow effectiveness.
* Assist with basic setup or integration of ServiceNow AI modules and participate in piloting small\-scale AI\-driven solutions with guidance from senior team members.


**The team**
 Our Finance Transformation practice develops and licenses a growing family of proprietary software products (see http://www.deloitte.com/ft) to assist financial institutions with a number of complex topics, such as accounting for credit deteriorated assets and the administration of investments in leveraged loans.
   

  

 We are looking to add dedicated software engineers to our team. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we provide excellent opportunities for growth and learning and invest in our talent development.
   

  

 We are looking for people who share our passion for translating ideas into relevant and innovative products in the OP to solve business problem.
   

  

**Qualifications –**
**Must have Required skillset:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related technology/business discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* 3–5 years of IT industry experience, including 3\+ years of ServiceNow development.
* Strong experience configuring ServiceNow ITSM Modules using Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Workflow Editor, ACLs, Script Includes, JavaScript/GLIDE, and HTML5\.
* Hands\-on experience integrating ServiceNow with other IT applications or data sources.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow best practices, solution documentation, and update set management.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills; ability to work as part of a team.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist or Certified Application Developer (preferred but not required for entry).
* Adaptable, detail\-oriented, and motivated to learn new ServiceNow and Gen AI/automation features as they emerge.


**Good to have skillset Preferred:**
* Experience implementing additional ServiceNow modules such as Customer Service Management (CSM), Integrated Risk Management (IRM), HR Service Delivery (HRSD), or Security Operations (SecOps).
* Exposure to or direct experience working on real\-time AI or automation solutions within ServiceNow or related IT platforms.
* Familiarity with Agile or SDLC testing cycles.
* Experience with day\-to\-day ServiceNow platform administration.
* Awareness of ServiceNow’s AI capabilities (e.g., Virtual Agent, Predictive Intelligence) and enthusiasm for developing expertise in this area.
* Experience using source control tools (e.g., GitHub) for collaborative code development and maintenance.
* Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills with strong motivation for continuous skill development and learning.


**Education:**
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree (3 Year) within a technical field.


**Location:**
* Hyderabad/ Bengaluru/ Chennai/Pune


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**

 We are seeking a hands\-on SeniorDigital Developer who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with modern AI\-assisted development practices.  Architect and implement scalable backend services using C\#, .NET 8\+, ASP.NET Core, and EF Core, together with responsive Angular applications using TypeScript, Angular Material, HTML, and SCSS.

 Translate business requirements into maintainable technical designs, APIs, data models, integrations, and reusable components. Contribute to architecture reviews and document key decisions and trade\-offs.

 Build and support secure Azure solutions using services such as App Service, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Storage, Functions, Logic Apps, Application Insights, and managed identities where appropriate.

 Design and optimize SQL Server data models, queries, stored procedures, indexes, and EF Core mappings, migrations, and Fluent API configurations.
* **Quality Engineering:** 
 Develop unit, integration, and frontend tests. Use automation and AI assistance to improve coverage while ensuring tests validate meaningful behavior and edge cases.
* **DevOps \& Automation:** 
 Manage Git and GitHub workflows, pull requests, branching, reviews, and CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions. Support repeatable deployments across environments.
* **Production Reliability:** 
 Troubleshoot defects and performance issues using logs, telemetry, profiling, and root\-cause analysis. Improve observability and preventive controls following incidents.

 Mentor juniors, lead design discussions, provide constructive code\-review feedback, share effective AI\-assisted practices, and promote continuous improvement.



  





**Qualifications**

* Strong Angular and TypeScript experience, including component design, reactive programming, forms, routing, state management, performance, and reusable UI patterns.

* Hands\-on use of GitHub Copilot or comparable AI\-assisted programming tools within day\-to\-day software delivery.
* Ability to assess AI\-assisted output for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and suitability before adoption.
* Experience integrating Azure OpenAI or other approved AI services into enterprise applications or building AI\-enabled business features.
* Understanding of responsible AI, privacy, security, transparency, human oversight, and governance.
* Strong debugging, problem\-solving, communication, collaboration, ownership, and stakeholder\-management skills



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile**

You are comfortable using AI as an engineering accelerator, but you understand that accountability stays with the developer. You can explain technical decisions clearly, challenge weak assumptions, support colleagues, and deliver secure, maintainable solutions in a collaborative enterprise environment.

* Experience contributing to Linux open\-source projects and collaborating with upstream communities is highly desirable.

title: Lead Software Engineer – Python, AI/Agent

 Leading AI\-driven Global Supply Chain Solutions Software Product Company and one of Glassdoor’s “Best Places to Work”.

* Experience developing AI agents and LLM\-based applications.
* Hands\-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or AutoGen.

 Python, FastAPI, Git, REST API, OAuth, Snowflake Agent development frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen), Prompt Engineering, RAG, Agent Memory, Token/Cost Optimization, LLM Evaluation, Agent Observability/Logging \& Monitoring, Multi\-Agent Orchestration Azure, OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry

title: Tableau Developer
description:
Person should be very strong in migration
   

  

 Majorly look for resources who has handled migration projects \- Tableau to PBI. They should also have a decent grasp of PBI.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to work on a broad range of data analytics, data visualization, and business intelligence initiatives across multiple industries. The role requires strong analytical skills, frequent client interaction, and the ability to translate business problems into effective analytical and BI solutions while collaborating closely with Data Engineering teams.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on expertise in Tableau, along with a good understanding of Power BI and DAX, and practical experience in migrating Tableau dashboards and reports to Power BI.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Work on a wide range of data analytics, data visualization, and business intelligence problems across various industries.
* Engage with clients and business stakeholders to understand business context, objectives, and challenges.
* Analyze and document business processes, mapping end\-to\-end workflows using visual formats such as process flow diagrams.
* Translate business problems into analytical solutions by defining metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and reports.
* Develop, publish, and maintain interactive dashboards and visualizations using Tableau and Power BI.
* Perform Tableau\-to\-Power BI migration, including assessment of existing Tableau dashboards, reports, data sources, calculations, and business logic.
* Translate Tableau functionality such as calculated fields, LOD expressions, filters, parameters, and data models into equivalent Power BI implementations.
* Develop and optimize Power BI reports, data models, measures, and DAX expressions.
* Perform storyboarding to structure analytical insights and present clear, compelling narratives to stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams by providing clear and detailed requirements.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and adherence to best practices in reporting and analytics delivery.
* Perform QC checks and validation of reports and dashboards before client delivery, particularly during migration projects.
* Participate in regular client and internal meetings and prepare clear MoM (Minutes of Meeting) documentation.
* Maintain proper documentation for dashboards, metrics, data logic, business rules, and migration activities.
* Track work items, enhancements, and issues using JIRA.


**Mandatory Skills \& Requirements**
* 3–6 years of relevant Data Analytics / BI experience with a strong focus on problem\-solving and advanced BI solutions.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Tableau, including:
+ Dashboard development and publishing
+ Calculated fields, filters, parameters, and LOD calculations
+ Data blending and joins
+ Row\-Level Security (RLS)
+ Replacing and managing data sources

* Hands\-on experience in Tableau\-to\-Power BI migration projects is mandatory.
* Good hands\-on understanding of Power BI, including:
+ Report and dashboard development
+ Data modelling
+ Measures and calculated columns
+ Power Query
+ RLS
+ Report publishing and workspace management

* Strong understanding of DAX, including writing and optimizing measures, filter context, calculated tables/columns, and commonly used DAX functions.
* Ability to assess existing Tableau dashboards and translate their business logic, calculations, data models, and visualizations into Power BI.
* Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, validation, and analysis.
* Ability to perform QC checks and validation on dashboards and reports.
* Experience preparing MoM, requirement documents, functional documentation, and migration\-related documentation.
* Hands\-on experience working with JIRA for task tracking and project management.


**Desired Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to handle complex business problems.
* Proven experience interacting with clients and business stakeholders for requirement gathering and solution design.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights clearly through effective storyboarding and data narratives.
* Ability to independently manage multiple stakeholders, priorities, and deliverables.
* Experience in BI modernization, dashboard rationalization, or visualization migration initiatives.
* Understanding of best practices for Power BI performance optimization and DAX optimization.

title: Forward Deployed Senior Software Engineer
description:

 teams.

 This is a forward\-deployed engineering role — highly technical, impact\-driven, and closely aligned to real\-world customer migration challenges.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop scalable migration tooling, scripts, and automation frameworks to accelerate onboarding into RunMyJobs.

* Identify migration bottlenecks and develop technical solutions to streamline data transformation and validation.

**Forward Deployed Engineering**

* Support Professional Services during complex or high\-impact migration engagements.
* Troubleshoot migration\-related production issues and resolve edge cases.
* Occasionally, engage directly with customer technical teams to understand source environments and validate solutions.


**Platform \& Product Collaboration**
* Provide structured feedback to Product and Core Engineering teams to improve RMJ migration capabilities.
* Contribute to architectural discussions, ensuring scalability, security, and performance.
* Advocate for automation best practices in enterprise migration scenarios.


**Engineering Excellence**
* Write clean, maintainable, well\-documented code.
* Implement automated testing (unit, integration, end\-to\-end).
* Contribute to CI/CD improvements for migration tooling.
* Mentor team members and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.


**Your Experience**
**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent combination of practical experience. Overall experience 8\+ years.
* Strong professional experience in Java (Java 11/17\+)
* Experience with AI\-driven automation use cases.
* Experience building backend services, APIs, and automation tooling.
* Experience with XML and JSON types, libraries like Jackson, Lombok
* Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL). Experience with scripting and automation (e.g., Shell scripting, Gradle).
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker), strong debugging and troubleshooting skills in complex environments.
* Experience with automated testing (JUnit, AssertJ, Mockito).
* Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally across engineering, architects, and delivery teams.
* Experience with AI\-driven automation use cases


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience migrating enterprise systems or schedulers to modern SaaS platforms.
* Background in automation, workload scheduling, or ERP environments.
* SAP knowledge (ABAP, HANA).
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
* Experience in customer\-facing or forward\-deployed engineering roles.


**SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE LOOKS LIKE**
* Reduced migration time and manual effort through reusable tooling.
* Improved reliability and predictability of RMJ onboarding.
* Strong collaboration across Migration Architects and Professional Services.
* Proactive identification of platform gaps and contribution to product evolution.
* Successful onboarding of complex enterprise customers onto RunMyJobs.


**WHY JOIN US?**
* Direct impact on strategic customer onboarding and revenue acceleration.
* Opportunity to shape migration frameworks for a category\-leading automation platform.
* Work in a collaborative, cross\-functional environment.
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.
* “One Redwood” culture focused on ownership and customer success.


*If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

title: Content Developer
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a skilled content developer to support a range of training programs and digital learning initiatives. This role will assist in instructional design to enhance e\-learning content, analyze learning data, and work closely with key stakeholders to improve the effectiveness of digital learning. This position will also be responsible for managing and delivering new hire onboarding and department specific trainings to employees through the Learning Management System (LMS), ensuring a seamless and user\-friendly experience for learners, instructors, and administrators.
   

  

 This position works in the Talent Management and Learning COE and reports to the Senior LMS Team Lead who is based in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
**E\-Learning Development \& Instructional Design:**
* Design and develop end\-to\-end courseware, including interactive eLearning modules, instructor\-led training materials, simulations, videos, and assessments aligned with defined learning objectives, using tools like Articulate Storyline, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, and similar platforms.
* Create and refine clear, engaging instructional content—including scripts, storyboards, assignments, and assessments—by converting SME\-provided content and technical documentation into learner\-ready training materials aligned with established learning frameworks such as ADDIE and Bloom’s Taxonomy. Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop, implement, and maintain e\-learning courses and training materials.
* Conduct rigorous quality reviews of training content to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with instructional design and industry standards.
* Maintain and manage content updates, version control, and archival processes to ensure training materials remain current and relevant.


**LMS Administration And Support**
* Administer and maintain the Learning Management System (LMS) for a large user base, ensuring smooth operation and a user\-friendly experience.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for global new hires, managing the end\-to\-end onboarding training process and implementing automation to enhance efficiency.
* Coordinate and manage Instructor\-Led Training (ILT) sessions, including scheduling, attendance tracking, learner record updates, and communication with instructors and learners.
* Provide prompt and responsive technical support to learners, instructors, and stakeholders, resolving LMS\-related issues.
* Maintain and organize learning content within the LMS, SharePoint, and content repositories and ensure alignment of content structure across sites, programs, and folders
* Monitor enrollments, completions, and system usage metrics for accuracy and to ensure data integrity within the LMS.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Create detailed reports and dashboards to measure learner engagement, track course completions, and evaluate training effectiveness.
* Assist with compliance tracking and meet regulatory reporting obligations through accurate data analysis and documentation.
* Keep abreast of emerging trends and best practices in instructional design and e\-learning technologies.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by incorporating learner feedback and performance data to introduce creative and innovative solutions that enhance engagement and optimize the overall learning experience.


**Innovation and Continuous Improvement**
* Keep abreast of emerging trends and best practices in instructional design and e\-learning technologies.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by incorporating learner feedback and performance data to introduce creative and innovative solutions that enhance engagement and optimize the overall learning experience.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Instructional Technology, Information Systems, or a closely related discipline.
* 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in training, instructional design, learning experience design, or content development, ideally in a global or multicultural work environment.
* Proficient in using eLearning development tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise, Camtasia, Adobe Creative Suite, Vyond, or other instructional technologies.
* Strong understanding of adult learning theories and instructional design principles.
* Familiarity with e\-learning standards including SCORM and xAPI.
* Proficient in data analysis and report generation using Microsoft Excel.
* Experience working with enterprise learning management systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms (i.e. Cornerstone, Docebo).
* Strong graphic design and multimedia development skills, supported by hands\-on proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and video editing tools, are highly desirable.
* Proficient in writing clear and engaging instructional content, including copy, video/audio scripts, and learning materials.
* Ability to develop storyboards and design visual layouts for instructional content and user interfaces.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders across the globe.


**Key Competencies**
* Innovation: Creative and innovative mindset, capable of designing engaging and impactful learning solutions.
* Adaptability: Adaptable and responsive to evolving priorities and constructive feedback in a fast\-paced environment.
* Problem Solving: Strong problem\-solving abilities with an analytical approach to identifying and addressing learning challenges.
* Planning and Organizing: Effective time management and organizational skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects and meet tight deadlines.
* Work Standards / Details Quality: High attention to detail in reviewing content for quality, accuracy, and alignment with learning goals.


**Working Conditions**
* The role may require attendance in meetings outside the site's standard business hours, as stakeholders and business representatives are located across multiple time zones.
* This is a hybrid position which requires working in the office 3 days a week.


**About Us**
 Coherent is a global leader in lasers, engineered materials and networking components. We are a vertically integrated manufacturing company that develops innovative products for diversified applications in the industrial, optical communications, military, life sciences, semiconductor equipment, and consumer markets. Coherent provides a comprehensive career development platform within an environment that challenges employees to perform at their best, while rewarding excellence and hard\-work through a competitive compensation program. It's an exciting opportunity to work for a company that offers stability, longevity and growth. Come Join Us!

 We will not pay for unsolicited resumes from recruiters and employment agencies unless we have a signed agreement and have required assistance, in writing, for a specific opening.
